items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Data is a raw fact with no meaning attached. 78 on its own tells you nothing. The other three have been processed and given meaning, which makes them information.
items.ne: Data भनेको अर्थ नजोडिएको काँचो तथ्य हो। ७८ एक्लैले केही बताउँदैन। बाँकी तीनलाई प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको छ, त्यसैले ती information हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: MySQL is a DBMS: the software. The database is the collection of data it manages. Calling the DBMS "the database" is the most common slip in this unit.
items.ne: MySQL एउटा DBMS हो — सफ्टवेयर। डाटाबेस भनेको त्यसले व्यवस्थापन गर्ने data को सङ्ग्रह हो। DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Storing the same fact three times is redundancy; the copies disagreeing after one is updated is inconsistency. The question asks about the result of the update, so the answer is inconsistency.
items.ne: उही तथ्य तीन पटक राख्नु redundancy हो; एउटा बदलेपछि प्रतिलिपिहरू बाझिनु inconsistency हो। प्रश्नले अद्यावधिकपछिको नतिजा सोधेकाले उत्तर inconsistency हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The external (or view) level is the top of the diagram, nearest the user. The conceptual level says what data exists overall; the internal level says how it is stored on disk.
items.ne: External (view) तह चित्रको सबैभन्दा माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक। Conceptual तहले समग्रमा कुन data छ भन्छ; internal तहले डिस्कमा कसरी राखिएको छ भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The instance is the data in the database right now, so inserting a row changes it. The schema is the structure — the table name, columns and keys — and adding a student does not change any of those.
items.ne: Instance भनेको अहिलेको data हो, त्यसैले पङ्क्ति थप्दा बदलिन्छ। Schema भनेको संरचना — तालिकाको नाम, स्तम्भ र कुञ्जी — र विद्यार्थी थप्दा ती बदलिँदैनन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The DBA has complete control of the database: creating it, controlling who may use it, taking backups and tuning performance.
items.ne: DBA सँग डाटाबेसको पूर्ण नियन्त्रण हुन्छ: बनाउने, कसले प्रयोग गर्न पाउने नियन्त्रण गर्ने, backup लिने र कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The hierarchical model is a tree, so a record has exactly one parent. The network model is a graph and allows several, which is the single examinable difference between the two.
items.ne: Hierarchical model रूख हो, त्यसैले रेकर्डको एउटै parent हुन्छ। Network model ग्राफ हो र धेरै हुन दिन्छ — दुईबीचको परीक्षामा सोधिने फरक यही एउटा हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Centralisation is what makes a database powerful and also what makes it a single point of failure. The other three options are advantages. A question asking for both wants at least one of each.
items.ne: एकै ठाउँमा राख्नुले डाटाबेसलाई बलियो बनाउँछ र सँगै एउटै जोखिम बिन्दु पनि। बाँकी तीन फाइदा हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough
items.en: 1.4 — Where database systems are used. Banking (accounts and transactions), airlines and bus booking (seats), schools and universities (students, marks, fees), hospitals (patient records), telecom (call records), online shops (products, orders), and government records — citizenship, land, voter rolls.
items.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीको प्रयोग: बैंकिङ (खाता र कारोबार), हवाई तथा बस टिकट (सिट), विद्यालय र विश्वविद्यालय (विद्यार्थी, अंक, शुल्क), अस्पताल (बिरामीको रेकर्ड), टेलिकम (कल रेकर्ड), अनलाइन पसल (सामान, अर्डर), र सरकारी अभिलेख — नागरिकता, जग्गा, मतदाता नामावली।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Calling the DBMS "the database". The database is the data; the DBMS is the program. MySQL is a DBMS.
items.ne: DBMS लाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। डाटाबेस भनेको data, DBMS भनेको प्रोग्राम।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Data, information, database or DBMS?
items.ne: Data, information, database कि DBMS?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The four words of 1.1, drilled on real cases. The one students lose a mark on is calling the software "the database" — so decide carefully which of those two you are looking at.
items.ne: १.१ का चार शब्द, वास्तविक उदाहरणमा। विद्यार्थीले अंक गुमाउने ठाउँ एउटै हो — सफ्टवेयरलाई "डाटाबेस" भन्नु। त्यसैले ती दुईमध्ये कुन हो ध्यान दिएर छान्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: MySQL is software — it creates, manages and controls access to a database. The database is the data it looks after. This is the single most common slip in the unit.
items.ne: MySQL सफ्टवेयर हो — यसले डाटाबेस बनाउँछ, व्यवस्थापन गर्छ र पहुँच नियन्त्रण गर्छ। डाटाबेस भनेको यसले हेर्ने data हो। युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A raw fact with no meaning attached. 78 what? Of whom? Until those are answered it is data, not information.
items.ne: अर्थ नजोडिएको काँचो तथ्य। ७८ के को? कसको? यी उत्तर नआएसम्म यो data हो, information होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The same fact, processed and given meaning. Information is what data becomes once you can act on it.
items.ne: उही तथ्य, प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको। Data मा काम गर्न सकिने भएपछि त्यो information बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: An organised collection of related data. Note that the software managing it is a separate thing — that separation is the whole point of the question.
items.ne: सम्बन्धित data को व्यवस्थित सङ्ग्रह। यसलाई व्यवस्थापन गर्ने सफ्टवेयर छुट्टै कुरा हो — यही छुट्याइ नै प्रश्नको सार हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Another DBMS, like MySQL and MS Access. If you can install it, it is software; if it holds your rows, it is the database.
items.ne: MySQL र MS Access जस्तै अर्को DBMS। install गर्न मिल्ने भए सफ्टवेयर; तपाईंका पङ्क्ति राख्ने भए डाटाबेस।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Each word is built on the one before it. Getting the order right is most of the answer to "differentiate between…".
items.ne: हरेक शब्द अघिल्लोमाथि बनेको छ। "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको प्रायः पूरै उत्तर यही क्रममा छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough
items.en: Learn these as pairs. A question asking for the limitations of the file system is really asking what a database fixes.
items.ne: यिनलाई जोडीमा सम्झनुहोस्। फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा सोध्नु भनेको डाटाबेसले के सुधार्छ भनी सोध्नु हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Hierarchical and network are separated by one question: how many parents may a record have?
items.ne: Hierarchical र network लाई एउटै प्रश्नले छुट्याउँछ: एउटा रेकर्डका कति parent हुन सक्छन्?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Compare the four database models, and define schema and instance.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: data, information, database र DBMS को परिभाषा दिन र फरक छुट्याउन, फाइल प्रणालीका सीमा र डाटाबेसले तिनको के जवाफ दिन्छ भन्न, फाइदा–बेफाइदा सूचीबद्ध गर्न, वास्तविक प्रयोग बताउन, प्रयोगकर्ताका प्रकार नाम लिन, तीन तहको संरचना कोरेर व्याख्या गर्न, र चार डाटाबेस मोडेल तुलना गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Then separate data from information by asking whether it means anything on its own. 78 does not. "Ram scored 78" does.
items.ne: पाँचमध्ये दुई सफ्टवेयर हुन्, दुई सामग्री। उत्तर दिनुअघि एउटा प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: के यो install गर्न मिल्छ? मिल्छ भने DBMS; DBMS ले राख्ने वा दिने कुरा भए बाँकी तीनमध्ये एक। अनि आफैंमा अर्थ लाग्छ कि लाग्दैन सोधेर data र information छुट्याउनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Data independence in one sentence each. Physical data independence — you can change how the data is stored on disk without changing the tables. Logical data independence — you can change the tables without changing what a user sees. Physical is the easier of the two to achieve; logical is harder, because a user's view is built directly on the tables.
items.ne: एक–एक वाक्यमा: Physical data independence — डिस्कमा data कसरी राखिन्छ त्यो बदल्दा तालिका बदल्नु पर्दैन। Logical data independence — तालिका बदल्दा प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने कुरा बदल्नु पर्दैन। पहिलो हासिल गर्न सजिलो, दोस्रो गाह्रो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Four marks, four lines. Answer in a two-column layout like this and you cannot accidentally define only one side of the pair — which is how this question is usually half-answered.
items.ne: चार अंक, चार हरफ। यसरी दुई स्तम्भमा लेख्नुभयो भने जोडीको एउटा पक्ष मात्र लेख्ने गल्ती हुँदैन — यो प्रश्न प्रायः त्यसैगरी आधा उत्तर हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Two changes are coming: moving the database to a faster disk, and adding an email column. Decide the level for each before you open this. The name of the independence follows from the level — get the level right and the second half is free.
items.ne: दुई परिवर्तन आउँदैछन्: डाटाबेस छिटो disk मा सार्नु, र email स्तम्भ थप्नु। खोल्नुअघि दुवैको level निर्णय गर्नुहोस्। independence को नाम level बाटै आउँछ — level ठिक भए दोस्रो आधा आफैँ आउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Work from the bottom up: is this about the disk, about what data exists, or about who sees it? Those three questions map onto the three levels exactly, and the independence is always named after the level below the boundary it protects.
items.ne: तलबाट माथि सोच्नुहोस्: यो डिस्कको कुरा हो, कुन data छ भन्ने कुरा हो, कि कसले देख्छ भन्ने कुरा हो? यी तीन प्रश्न ठ्याक्कै तीन तहमा मिल्छन्, र independence को नाम सधैं आफूले जोगाउने सीमाको तल्लो तहबाट राखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Listing advantages when the question says advantages AND disadvantages. Half the question, half the marks.
items.ne: फाइदा र बेफाइदा दुवै सोधिएको ठाउँमा फाइदा मात्र लेख्नु। आधा प्रश्न, आधा अंक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Mixing up schema and instance. Adding a student changes the instance, not the schema.
items.ne: Schema र instance मिसाउनु। विद्यार्थी थप्दा instance बदलिन्छ, schema होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Drawing the three-level architecture upside down. External is at the top, nearest the user; internal is at the bottom, nearest the disk.
items.ne: तीन तहको चित्र उल्टो कोर्नु। External माथि — प्रयोगकर्तानजिक; internal तल — डिस्कनजिक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit is short — 6 hours — but it supplies the definitions the whole subject is built on. Almost every question here is either define, differentiate or list. All three are answered from memory, so the work is learning the exact wording rather than reasoning it out in the hall. The three-level architecture is the one diagram from this unit you may be asked to draw.
items.ne: यो युनिट छोटो छ — ६ घण्टा — तर पूरै विषय यसैका परिभाषामाथि बनेको छ। यहाँका प्रायः सबै प्रश्न परिभाषा दिने, फरक छुट्याउने वा सूची बनाउने हुन्। तीनै सम्झेर लेख्ने भएकाले ठ्याक्कै शब्द याद गर्नु नै काम हो। यस युनिटबाट कोर्न सकिने चित्र तीन तहको संरचना हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark for the diagram with all three levels in the right order, and one mark for explaining each level. Mentioning data independence between the levels is what turns a three-mark answer into a four-mark one.
items.ne: तीनै तह सही क्रममा भएको चित्रलाई एक अंक, हरेक तहको व्याख्यालाई एक–एक। तहबीचको data independence उल्लेख गर्दा तीन अंकको उत्तर चार अंकको बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The file system's four problems are redundancy, inconsistency, isolation and no concurrency control. A database answers each one.
items.ne: फाइल प्रणालीका चार समस्या: दोहोरोपन, असङ्गति, अलगाव, र समवर्ती नियन्त्रणको अभाव। डाटाबेसले हरेकको जवाफ दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A database system also has real costs: money, hardware, trained staff, and one point of failure.
items.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीका वास्तविक लागत पनि छन्: पैसा, हार्डवेयर, तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी, र एउटै ठाउँमा जोखिम।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Users: DBA, designer, application programmer, end user.
items.ne: प्रयोगकर्ता: DBA, डिजाइनर, एप्लिकेसन प्रोग्रामर, end user।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Three levels: external (what a user sees), conceptual (what data exists), internal (how it is stored). The gaps between them are data independence.
items.ne: तीन तह: external (प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने), conceptual (कुन data छ), internal (कसरी राखिएको)। बीचका खाली ठाउँ नै data independence हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Schema is the structure and rarely changes; instance is today's data and changes constantly.
items.ne: Schema संरचना हो, विरलै बदलिन्छ; instance आजको data हो, निरन्तर बदलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Data → information → database → DBMS. Each is built on the one before, and the DBMS is software, not data.
items.ne: Data → information → database → DBMS। हरेक अघिल्लोमाथि बनेको, र DBMS सफ्टवेयर हो, data होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Data is raw, unprocessed facts. On their own they carry no meaning: 78, Ram, 10. Information is data that has been processed and given meaning: "Ram scored 78 in class 10." The same facts, now useful. A database is a collection of related data, organised so it can be stored and retrieved efficiently. A DBMS (Database Management System) is the software that creates, manages and controls access to a database — MySQL, Oracle, MS Access.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Data भनेको काँचो, प्रशोधन नगरिएको तथ्य हो। एक्लै यसको अर्थ हुँदैन: 78, Ram, 10। Information भनेको प्रशोधन गरेर अर्थ दिइएको data हो: "रामले कक्षा १० मा ७८ अंक ल्याए।" उही तथ्य, अब काम लाग्ने। Database भनेको सम्बन्धित data को सङ्ग्रह हो, जुन राख्न र झिक्न सजिलो हुने गरी व्यवस्थित गरिएको हुन्छ। DBMS (Database Management System) भनेको डाटाबेस बनाउने, व्यवस्थापन गर्ने र पहुँच नियन्त्रण गर्ने सफ्टवेयर हो — MySQL, Oracle, MS Access।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 1.2 & 1.3 Why the file system was not enough
items.en: Advantages and disadvantages Advantages: redundancy is controlled; data stays consistent; data is shared between users; security and access control are possible; backup and recovery are built in; standards can be enforced. Disadvantages — and they are real: a DBMS is expensive to buy and to run; it needs powerful hardware; it needs trained staff; and because everything is in one place, a failure affects everything at once. An answer that lists only advantages is an incomplete answer. Examiners ask for both.
items.ne: फाइदा र बेफाइदा फाइदा: दोहोरोपन नियन्त्रण हुन्छ; data एकरूप रहन्छ; प्रयोगकर्ताबीच साझेदारी हुन्छ; सुरक्षा र पहुँच नियन्त्रण सम्भव हुन्छ; backup र recovery भित्रै हुन्छ; मानक लागू गर्न सकिन्छ। बेफाइदा — र यी साँच्चिकै हुन्: DBMS किन्न र चलाउन महँगो हुन्छ; बलियो हार्डवेयर चाहिन्छ; तालिम पाएका कर्मचारी चाहिन्छन्; र सबै एकै ठाउँमा हुने भएकाले एउटै बिग्रँदा सबै प्रभावित हुन्छ। फाइदा मात्र लेखेको उत्तर अपूरो हुन्छ। परीक्षकले दुवै सोध्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Four users, four jobs Database Administrator (DBA) — has complete control. Creates the database, grants and revokes permission, takes backups, tunes performance. One person, or a small team. Database Designer — decides what entities and relationships the database needs, before it is built. Application Programmer — writes the programs that read and write the database through SQL. End User — uses those programs. A naive end user works through a form or a menu and never sees SQL; a sophisticated end user writes their own queries.
items.ne: चार प्रयोगकर्ता, चार काम Database Administrator (DBA) — पूर्ण नियन्त्रण। डाटाबेस बनाउने, अधिकार दिने–खोस्ने, backup लिने, कार्यसम्पादन सुधार्ने। Database Designer — बन्नुअघि नै कुन इन्टिटी र सम्बन्ध चाहिन्छ भन्ने तय गर्ने। Application Programmer — SQL मार्फत डाटाबेस पढ्ने–लेख्ने प्रोग्राम लेख्ने। End User — ती प्रोग्राम चलाउने। naive प्रयोगकर्ताले फारम वा मेनुबाट काम गर्छ र SQL देख्दैन; sophisticated प्रयोगकर्ताले आफैं क्वेरी लेख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Schema and instance A schema is the structure of the database — the table names, the columns and their types, the keys and the constraints. It is designed once and changes rarely. An instance is the data actually in the database at a given moment. It changes every time a row is inserted, updated or deleted. The same schema has a different instance every day. The schema of the Student table does not change when a new student joins — only its instance does.
items.ne: Schema र instance Schema भनेको डाटाबेसको संरचना हो — तालिकाका नाम, स्तम्भ र तिनका टाइप, कुञ्जी र बन्धन। एक पटक डिजाइन हुन्छ र विरलै बदलिन्छ। Instance भनेको कुनै क्षणमा डाटाबेसमा साँच्चै भएको data हो। पङ्क्ति थपिँदा, बदलिँदा वा हट्दा हरेक पटक फेरिन्छ। उही schema को instance हरेक दिन फरक हुन्छ। नयाँ विद्यार्थी भर्ना हुँदा Student तालिकाको schema बदलिँदैन — instance मात्र बदलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The data is the database. The program is the DBMS. MySQL is a program.
items.ne: डाटा नै database हो। प्रोग्राम चाहिँ DBMS हो। MySQL एउटा प्रोग्राम हो।

items.ne: दुवैको परिभाषा र DBMS का दुई उदाहरण लेख्नुहोस्।

items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit

items.ne: परम्परागत फाइल प्रणालीका कुनै तीन सीमा लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: MySQL is the DBMS — the software. The database is the collection of data it manages. Saying "MySQL is a database" is the single most common slip in this unit, and it loses the mark in a "differentiate" question.
items.ne: MySQL DBMS हो — सफ्टवेयर। डाटाबेस भनेको त्यसले व्यवस्थापन गर्ने data को सङ्ग्रह हो। "MySQL एउटा डाटाबेस हो" भन्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A school stores its student records in MySQL. Which of these is the DATABASE?
items.ne: एउटा विद्यालयले विद्यार्थीको रेकर्ड MySQL मा राख्छ। यीमध्ये कुन डाटाबेस हो?

items.ne: कक्षाको औसत ७२ छ

items.ne: सीता परीक्षामा उत्तीर्ण भइन्

items.ne: एउटा DBMS — डाटाबेस व्यवस्थापन गर्ने सफ्टवेयर

items.ne: Data एकै ठाउँमा हुने भएकाले एउटै बिग्रँदा सबै प्रभावित हुन्छ

items.ne: Data redundancy नियन्त्रण हुन्छ

items.ne: धेरै प्रयोगकर्ताबीच data साझा गर्न सकिन्छ

items.en: Security and access control are possible
items.ne: सुरक्षा र पहुँच नियन्त्रण सम्भव हुन्छ

items.en: Which of these is DATA rather than information?
items.ne: यीमध्ये कुन INFORMATION होइन, DATA हो?

items.ne: MySQL के हो?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A student's address is stored in three different files. The office updates one of them. What problem is this?
items.ne: एउटै विद्यार्थीको ठेगाना तीन फरक फाइलमा छ। कार्यालयले एउटा मात्र अद्यावधिक गर्‍यो। यो कुन समस्या हो?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Which level of the three-level architecture describes what a particular user is allowed to see?
items.ne: तीन तहको संरचनामा कुन तहले कुनै प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्न पाउने कुरा बताउँछ?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A new student is admitted and a row is inserted. What has changed?
items.ne: नयाँ विद्यार्थी भर्ना भए र एउटा पङ्क्ति थपियो। के बदलियो?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Who grants and revokes permissions and takes backups?
items.ne: अधिकार दिने–खोस्ने र backup लिने काम कसले गर्छ?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: In which database model may a record have SEVERAL parent records?
items.ne: कुन डाटाबेस मोडेलमा एउटा रेकर्डका धेरै parent रेकर्ड हुन सक्छन्?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Which of these is a DISADVANTAGE of a database system?
items.ne: यीमध्ये कुन डाटाबेस प्रणालीको बेफाइदा हो?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Introduction to Database System
items.ne: डाटाबेस प्रणालीको परिचय

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: What you will learn: to separate the four words on real examples, so the "differentiate between…" question is answered from recognition rather than from a memorised sentence.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वास्तविक उदाहरणमा चारै शब्द छुट्याउन — ताकि "फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न घोकेको वाक्यबाट होइन, चिनेरै उत्तर दिन सकियोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A diamond holds the relationship, written as a verb — ENROLS, TEACHES. Entities are rectangles and attributes are ellipses.
items.ne: चतुर्भुजभित्र सम्बन्ध हुन्छ, क्रियापदमा लेखिएको — ENROLS, TEACHES। इन्टिटी आयत हुन् र एट्रिब्युट दीर्घवृत्त।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A derived attribute is drawn with a dashed ellipse. A double ellipse means multivalued, an underline marks the key, and a double rectangle is a weak entity.
items.ne: व्युत्पन्न (derived) एट्रिब्युट धर्के दीर्घवृत्तले कोरिन्छ। दोहोरो दीर्घवृत्त = बहुमान, मुनि रेखा = कुञ्जी, दोहोरो आयत = कमजोर इन्टिटी।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: "Weak" is about identification, not importance. A weak entity cannot be identified on its own and must borrow its owner's key. It is drawn with a double rectangle.
items.ne: "कमजोर" भनेको चिनारीको कुरा हो, महत्त्वको होइन। कमजोर इन्टिटी आफैंले चिनिँदैन र मालिकको कुञ्जी लिनुपर्छ। दोहोरो आयतले कोरिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Test both directions. Class → students is "many", but student → class is "one". Many one way and one the other way is 1:M. It would only be M:N if a student could also be in several classes.
items.ne: दुवै दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्। कक्षा → विद्यार्थी "धेरै" हो, तर विद्यार्थी → कक्षा "एक"। एकातिर धेरै र अर्कोतिर एक भए 1:M। विद्यार्थी धेरै कक्षामा हुन सक्ने भए मात्र M:N हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A many-to-many relationship cannot be recorded by a foreign key, because a column holds one value and each side has many partners. It becomes a third table holding one row per link.
items.ne: धेरै–धेरै सम्बन्धलाई foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन, किनभने स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्छ र दुवैतर्फ धेरै जोडी छन्। यो तेस्रो तालिका बन्छ, हरेक जोडका लागि एक पङ्क्ति।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Unique and NOT NULL are the two rules a primary key must obey — together they are what let a row be found reliably. Pointing at another table is a foreign key, which may be NULL and may repeat.
items.ne: अद्वितीय र NOT NULL — primary key ले पालना गर्नुपर्ने दुई नियम यिनै हुन्। अर्को तालिका देखाउने काम foreign key को हो, जुन NULL हुन र दोहोरिन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Any identifying set is a super key. Strip out everything unnecessary and it becomes a candidate key. One candidate key is then chosen as the primary key; the rest are alternate keys.
items.ne: पङ्क्ति चिनाउने जुनसुकै समूह super key हो। अनावश्यक कुरा हटाएपछि candidate key बन्छ। तीमध्ये एउटा primary key छानिन्छ; बाँकी alternate key हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The degree of a relationship counts the entities in it, not the rows. Only EMPLOYEE takes part here, related to itself, so the degree is unary. Do not confuse degree with cardinality.
items.ne: सम्बन्धको degree ले त्यसमा सहभागी इन्टिटी गन्छ, पङ्क्ति होइन। यहाँ EMPLOYEE मात्र छ, आफैंसँग सम्बन्धित, त्यसैले degree unary हो। Degree लाई cardinality सँग नमिसाउनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Calling a weak entity "unimportant". It means the entity has no key of its own and must borrow its owner's. Draw it with a double rectangle.
items.ne: कमजोर इन्टिटीलाई "महत्त्वहीन" भन्नु। यसको अर्थ आफ्नो कुञ्जी नभएको र मालिकको कुञ्जी लिनुपर्ने भन्ने हो। दोहोरो आयतले कोर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Which mapping cardinality?
items.ne: कुन mapping cardinality?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Read both directions before you answer. A sentence that only tells you one direction has not told you the cardinality.
items.ne: उत्तर दिनुअघि दुवै दिशा पढ्नुहोस्। एउटा दिशा मात्र बताउने वाक्यले cardinality बताएकै हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Many one way, one the other. The second sentence is what settles it — without it this could equally have been many-to-many.
items.ne: एकातिर धेरै, अर्कोतिर एक। दोस्रो वाक्यले नै तय गर्छ — त्यो नभए यो धेरै–धेरै पनि हुन सक्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Many in both directions, so no single foreign key can record it. This is the one that forces a third table.
items.ne: दुवै दिशामा धेरै, त्यसैले एउटै foreign key ले राख्न सक्दैन। तेस्रो तालिका बाध्य पार्ने यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: One in both directions. Two tables still, and the foreign key may sit in either one.
items.ne: दुवै दिशामा एक। तालिका दुई नै हुन्छन्, र foreign key जुनसुकैमा राख्न सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: "May be treated by several" is the second "many". Read carefully — the wording is softer than in the course example, but the cardinality is the same.
items.ne: "धेरै डाक्टरले उपचार गर्न सक्छन्" भन्नु नै दोस्रो "धेरै" हो। शब्द नरम छ, तर cardinality उही।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Both directions are "at most one". A teacher works in a department alongside others, but HEADS only one — the relationship named is what you judge, not the entities.
items.ne: दुवै दिशा "बढीमा एक"। शिक्षक विभागमा अरूसँगै काम गर्छन्, तर नेतृत्व एउटैको गर्छन् — इन्टिटी होइन, नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध हेर्ने हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: A drawing question is marked on the shapes. A rectangle where an ellipse belongs loses the mark even when the word inside it is right.
items.ne: कोर्ने प्रश्नमा आकार नै जाँचिन्छ। दीर्घवृत्त हुनुपर्ने ठाउँमा आयत कोर्दा भित्रको शब्द सही भए पनि अंक जान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Each key is a narrowing of the one above it. Every primary key is a candidate key, and every candidate key is a super key — but not the reverse.
items.ne: हरेक कुञ्जी माथिकोभन्दा साँघुरो हुँदै जान्छ। हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो, र हरेक candidate key एउटा super key — तर उल्टो होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Draw a complete ER diagram for a small scenario.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: ER मोडेल किन चाहिन्छ भन्न, इन्टिटी–कमजोर इन्टिटी चिन्न र चिन्ह कोर्न, एट्रिब्युटका प्रकार नाम लिन, सम्बन्ध र यसको degree भन्न, 1:1–1:M–M:N को अर्थ र तालिकामा पर्ने असर भन्न, कुञ्जीका प्रकार परिभाषित गर्न, र सानो परिदृश्यको पूरा ER चित्र कोर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: Pay attention to weak entity. "Weak" does not mean unimportant. It means the thing cannot be identified without its owner: a dependant is identified by which employee they belong to, plus their name.
items.ne: हरेक भाग क्रमैसँग थिच्नुहोस् र चित्रको कुन भाग बल्छ हेर्नुहोस्। आकारको नाम पढ्नुहोस् — परीक्षामा कोर्नुपर्ने त्यही हो — अनि वाक्य पढ्नुहोस्, जसले त्यो भाग वास्तविक तालिकामा के बन्छ बताउँछ। कमजोर इन्टिटी मा ध्यान दिनुहोस्। "कमजोर" को अर्थ महत्त्वहीन होइन; मालिकविना चिनिन नसक्ने भन्ने हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: Degree of a relationship is how many entities take part in it — not how many rows. Unary (one entity related to itself: an employee manages an employee), binary (two entities — almost every relationship you will meet), ternary (three). Degree and cardinality are different questions: degree counts entities, cardinality counts how many rows link to how many.
items.ne: सम्बन्धको degree भनेको त्यसमा कति इन्टिटी सहभागी छन् भन्ने हो — कति पङ्क्ति भन्ने होइन। Unary (एउटै इन्टिटी आफैंसँग), binary (दुई — प्रायः सबै), ternary (तीन)। Degree र cardinality फरक प्रश्न हुन्: degree ले इन्टिटी गन्छ, cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्ने।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Only M:N produces a junction table. Watch it appear, and notice it holds nothing but two foreign keys — one row per link, which is exactly what the relationship is.
items.ne: माथिको चिन्ह तीन बटनबीच झन्डै बदलिँदैन — एउटा अक्षर मात्र। तलका पङ्क्ति भने पूरै बदलिन्छन्, र वास्तविक फरक त्यही हो। 1:M मा सूचीमुनिको टिप्पणी पढ्नुहोस्: हरेक विषयले ठ्याक्कै एउटा विद्यार्थी देखाउँछ। अब M:N थिच्नुहोस् — Maths अब दुई विद्यार्थीबाट जोडिन्छ। दुवैतर्फ "धेरै", र पूरा परिभाषा यही हो। M:N ले मात्र junction तालिका बनाउँछ; त्यसमा दुई foreign key बाहेक केही हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The last two cases are the ones worth slowing down for. One uses softer wording — "may be treated by several" is still "many". The other describes a relationship between entities that also relate in other ways: judge the relationship that is named, not the entities.
items.ne: हरेक केसमा दुई वाक्यलाई दुई छुट्टै प्रश्न मानेर पढ्नुहोस्: बायाँको एउटालाई दायाँ कति? अनि दायाँको एउटालाई बायाँ कति? दुवैपछि मात्र cardinality थाहा हुन्छ। अन्तिम दुई केसमा बिस्तारै जानुहोस् — एउटामा शब्द नरम छ, अर्कोमा नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध हेर्नुपर्छ, इन्टिटी होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Always test both directions. A sentence that only tells you one direction has not told you the cardinality. "A class has many students" alone could be 1:M or M:N — you have to ask whether a student can be in two classes.
items.ne: सधैं दुवै दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्। एउटा दिशा मात्र बताउने वाक्यले cardinality बताएकै हुँदैन। "एउटा कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी" भन्ने मात्रले 1:M कि M:N भन्न मिल्दैन — एउटा विद्यार्थी दुई कक्षामा हुन सक्छ कि भनी सोध्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Four kinds of key are being asked for. Before you open this, commit to one number: how many candidate keys does this table have? If your answer is 1, look at the question again.
items.ne: चार किसिमका key सोधिएका छन्। खोल्नुअघि एउटा सङ्ख्या भन्नुहोस्: यो तालिकामा कति वटा candidate key छन्? जवाफ १ आयो भने प्रश्न फेरि हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The examiner is checking that you know these are nested, not five unrelated things. Every primary key is a candidate key, and every candidate key is a super key. Saying so in one line is often worth a mark by itself.
items.ne: परीक्षकले यी पाँच असम्बन्धित कुरा होइनन्, एकभित्र अर्को हुन् भन्ने जान्नुभएको छ कि छैन हेर्छन्। हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो, र हरेक candidate key एउटा super key। यही एक हरफले प्रायः एक अंक दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Answering "many students in a class" as M:N. Check the other direction: a student is in one class, so it is 1:M.
items.ne: "एउटा कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी" लाई M:N भन्नु। अर्को दिशा जाँच्नुहोस्: विद्यार्थी एउटै कक्षामा हुन्छ, त्यसैले 1:M।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Confusing degree with cardinality. Degree counts the entities in a relationship; cardinality counts how many rows link to how many.
items.ne: Degree र cardinality मिसाउनु। Degree ले सम्बन्धका इन्टिटी गन्छ; cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Underlining nothing in an ER diagram. The key attribute must be underlined — that is the notation for a primary key, and a marker looks for it.
items.ne: ER चित्रमा कुनै पनि नाममुनि रेखा नकोर्नु। कुञ्जी एट्रिब्युटमुनि रेखा हुनैपर्छ — primary key को चिन्ह त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Writing a relationship as a noun. A diamond holds a verb: ENROLS, TEACHES, CONTAINS — not "enrolment".
items.ne: सम्बन्धलाई नामपदमा लेख्नु। चतुर्भुजभित्र क्रियापद हुन्छ: ENROLS, TEACHES, CONTAINS — "enrolment" होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit is examined mostly by drawing. The commonest question gives you two or three sentences describing a small system and asks for an ER diagram — entities, attributes with the key underlined, a relationship named as a verb, and the cardinality marked on both lines. Marks are given for each of those four things separately, so a diagram missing its cardinalities still earns most of them. Draw it big, and label everything.
items.ne: यो युनिट प्रायः कोरेर जाँचिन्छ। सामान्य प्रश्नले दुई–तीन वाक्यमा सानो प्रणाली वर्णन गरेर ER चित्र माग्छ — इन्टिटी, कुञ्जीमुनि रेखासहितका एट्रिब्युट, क्रियापदमा नाम दिइएको सम्बन्ध, र दुवै रेखामा cardinality। यी चार कुरालाई छुट्टाछुट्टै अंक हुन्छ, त्यसैले cardinality छुटे पनि धेरैजसो अंक आउँछ। ठूलो कोर्नुहोस् र सबैमा नाम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: An attribute is a property or characteristic of an entity. Example: the student's name. It is drawn as an ellipse and becomes a column.
items.ne: दुवैको परिभाषा, एक–एक उदाहरण, र चाहेमा कुन आकारले कोरिन्छ भन्ने पनि।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark per cardinality with its example, and the fourth for stating that M:N requires an extra table.
items.ne: हरेक cardinality र उदाहरणलाई एक–एक अंक, र M:N लाई थप तालिका चाहिन्छ भनेकोमा चौथो अंक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark for the two entities as rectangles, one for the attributes as ellipses with the keys underlined, one for the relationship in a diamond named as a verb, and one for the M:N cardinality marked on both lines.
items.ne: आयतमा दुई इन्टिटीलाई एक अंक, कुञ्जीमुनि रेखासहित दीर्घवृत्तका एट्रिब्युटलाई एक, चतुर्भुजमा क्रियापद रूपको सम्बन्धलाई एक, र दुवै रेखामा M:N लेखेकोमा एक।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Degree counts the entities in a relationship; cardinality counts how many rows link to how many. They are different questions.
items.ne: Degree ले सम्बन्धका इन्टिटी गन्छ; cardinality ले कति पङ्क्ति कतिसँग जोडिन्छ। दुई फरक प्रश्न हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Always test cardinality in BOTH directions. Many one way and one the other is 1:M; many both ways is M:N.
items.ne: Cardinality सधैं दुवै दिशामा जाँच्नुहोस्। एकातिर धेरै र अर्कोतिर एक भए 1:M; दुवैतिर धेरै भए M:N।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: M:N always needs a third table. 1:1 and 1:M do not.
items.ne: M:N लाई सधैं तेस्रो तालिका चाहिन्छ। 1:1 र 1:M लाई चाहिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A primary key is unique and never NULL. A foreign key may be NULL and may repeat, but its value must already exist in the table it points at.
items.ne: Primary key अद्वितीय हुन्छ र कहिल्यै NULL हुँदैन। Foreign key NULL हुन र दोहोरिन सक्छ, तर यसको मान देखाइएको तालिकामा पहिले नै हुनुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Every primary key is a candidate key; every candidate key is a super key. The reverse is not true.
items.ne: हरेक primary key एउटा candidate key हो; हरेक candidate key एउटा super key। उल्टो होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Rectangle = entity, ellipse = attribute, diamond = relationship. Double rectangle = weak entity, double ellipse = multivalued, dashed ellipse = derived, underlined = key.
items.ne: आयत = इन्टिटी, दीर्घवृत्त = एट्रिब्युट, चतुर्भुज = सम्बन्ध। दोहोरो आयत = कमजोर इन्टिटी, दोहोरो दीर्घवृत्त = बहुमान, धर्के = व्युत्पन्न, मुनि रेखा = कुञ्जी।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Why model before you build A database is expensive to change once it holds real data. The ER model is a picture of the database drawn before any table exists, so that mistakes are found on paper instead of after a year of records. It is deliberately not SQL and not tables. It is a diagram of things and how they are connected, in language a school clerk could check. Only once the picture is agreed is it turned into tables — and that translation is Unit 3. An ER diagram has exactly three kinds of shape: rectangles for things, ellipses for their properties, and diamonds for the connections between them.
items.ne: बनाउनुअघि मोडेल किन वास्तविक data भरिसकेपछि डाटाबेस बदल्न महँगो पर्छ। ER मोडेल भनेको कुनै तालिका बन्नुभन्दा अघि कोरिने डाटाबेसको चित्र हो, ताकि गल्ती वर्ष दिनको रेकर्डपछि होइन, कागजमै भेटियोस्। यो जानाजान SQL पनि होइन, तालिका पनि होइन। यो वस्तु र तिनका सम्बन्ध को चित्र हो — विद्यालयको कर्मचारीले पनि जाँच्न सक्ने भाषामा। चित्र मिलेपछि मात्र तालिकामा बदलिन्छ, र त्यो अनुवाद युनिट ३ मा छ। ER चित्रमा ठ्याक्कै तीन किसिमका आकार हुन्छन्: वस्तुका लागि आयत, तिनका गुणका लागि दीर्घवृत्त, र जोडाइका लागि चतुर्भुज।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: Entity, entity set, weak entity — three words, one shape An entity is one single thing the database stores: Ram, one student. You can point at it. An entity set is every entity of the same kind, taken together: all the students. The rectangle you draw in an ER diagram names the set — it says STUDENT, not Ram. This is the distinction a one-mark question is testing when it asks you to "define entity and entity set", and the two answers are not interchangeable. The easiest way to keep them apart is to look one step ahead, at Unit 3. When the diagram becomes tables, the entity set becomes the table and each entity becomes one row. A table is a set of rows; that is the same sentence said twice. A weak entity is not a third kind of thing but an entity with a missing key: it cannot be identified without its owner. Drawn as a double rectangle.
items.ne: इन्टिटी, इन्टिटी सेट, कमजोर इन्टिटी — तीन शब्द, एउटै आकार इन्टिटी भनेको डाटाबेसले राख्ने एउटै वस्तु: राम, एक विद्यार्थी। औंला ठड्याएर देखाउन सकिन्छ। इन्टिटी सेट भनेको उही किसिमका सबै इन्टिटी सँगै: सबै विद्यार्थी। ER चित्रमा कोरिने आयतले सेट को नाम लेख्छ — STUDENT लेख्छ, Ram लेख्दैन। "इन्टिटी र इन्टिटी सेट परिभाषित गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने एक अंकको प्रश्नले जाँच्ने यही फरक हो, र दुई उत्तर साटासाट मिल्दैनन्। छुट्याउने सजिलो उपाय युनिट ३ तर्फ एक पाइला अघि हेर्नु हो। चित्र तालिकामा बदलिँदा इन्टिटी सेट तालिका बन्छ र हरेक इन्टिटी एक पङ्क्ति बन्छ। तालिका भनेको पङ्क्तिहरूको सेट हो — उही वाक्य दुई पटक भनिएको। कमजोर इन्टिटी तेस्रो किसिमको वस्तु होइन, कुञ्जी नभएको इन्टिटी हो: मालिकविना चिनिन सक्दैन। दोहोरो आयतले कोरिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The two rules a primary key must obey A primary key must be unique — no two rows may share its value — and it must be NOT NULL — it can never be left empty. Those two rules are what allow a row to be found reliably. A foreign key is different in kind. It is not about identifying a row in its own table; it is a column whose value must already exist as a primary key in another table. That rule is what links two tables together, and it is called referential integrity. A foreign key may be NULL — Gita has no class yet — and it may repeat, since many students share one class. A primary key may do neither.
items.ne: Primary key ले पालना गर्नुपर्ने दुई नियम Primary key अद्वितीय हुनुपर्छ — दुई पङ्क्तिको मान उही हुन नहुने — र NOT NULL हुनुपर्छ — कहिल्यै खाली छाड्न नहुने। यी दुई नियमले नै पङ्क्ति भरपर्दो रूपमा खोज्न दिन्छन्। Foreign key फरक किसिमको हो। यसले आफ्नै तालिकाको पङ्क्ति चिनाउँदैन; यो त्यस्तो स्तम्भ हो जसको मान अर्को तालिकाको primary key मा पहिले नै हुनैपर्छ। यही नियमले दुई तालिका जोड्छ, र यसलाई referential integrity भनिन्छ। Foreign key NULL हुन सक्छ — गीताको कक्षा अझै छैन — र दोहोरिन पनि सक्छ, किनभने धेरै विद्यार्थीको कक्षा एउटै हुन्छ। Primary key ले यी दुवै गर्न पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Weak means no key of its own, not unimportant. Double rectangle, double diamond.
items.ne: Weak भनेको आफ्नो कुञ्जी नभएको, महत्त्वहीन होइन। दोहोरो आयत, दोहोरो हीरा।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Define entity and attribute with one example of each.
items.ne: इन्टिटी र एट्रिब्युटको परिभाषा एक–एक उदाहरणसहित दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms

items.en: Three. Student, Course, and a third table holding one row for every enrolment. No single foreign key can record "many on both sides" — a column holds one value, so it can point at one row. The moment a relationship is many-to-many, a junction table is forced. Switch the tool below to M:N and the third table appears.

items.ne: Primary key बारे कुन भनाइ सही हो?

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Entity Relationship Model (ER-Model)
items.ne: ई–आर मोडेल

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 2.2 – 2.4 The components of an ER diagram
items.en: What you will learn: which shape belongs to which idea, and what each one becomes when the diagram is turned into tables.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: कुन आकार कुन विचारको हो, र चित्र तालिकामा बदलिँदा हरेक के बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: What you will learn: the difference between one-to-many and many-to-many, shown in rows rather than in notation — and why only one of them needs a third table.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: एक–धेरै र धेरै–धेरैको फरक, चिन्हमा होइन पङ्क्तिमा देखेर — र किन तीमध्ये एउटालाई मात्र तेस्रो तालिका चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: What you will learn: to test both directions every time, which is the one habit that separates a right answer from a guess.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: सधैं दुवै दिशा जाँच्ने बानी — सही उत्तर र अनुमानबीचको फरक यही एउटा बानीले पार्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Degree is the number of columns; cardinality is the number of rows. Here the degree is 5 and the cardinality is 200. Swapping these two is the commonest error in this unit.
items.ne: Degree भनेको स्तम्भ सङ्ख्या; cardinality भनेको पङ्क्ति सङ्ख्या। यहाँ degree ५ र cardinality २००। यी दुई साट्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A relation is a set of tuples, so no two rows may be identical — the primary key guarantees it. Order is not significant for rows or columns, and NULLs are permitted in non-key columns.
items.ne: रिलेसन ट्युपलहरूको सेट हो, त्यसैले दुई पङ्क्ति उस्तै हुन पाउँदैनन् — primary key ले सुनिश्चित गर्छ। पङ्क्ति र स्तम्भको क्रमको महत्त्व हुँदैन, र कुञ्जी नभएका स्तम्भमा NULL मिल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: A domain constrains what may appear in a column. The domain of "marks" might be whole numbers from 0 to 100, so the text "Ram" could never be stored there.
items.ne: Domain ले स्तम्भमा के आउन सक्छ भन्ने सीमित गर्छ। "marks" को domain ० देखि १०० सम्मका पूर्ण सङ्ख्या होला, त्यसैले त्यहाँ "Ram" राख्न मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Referential integrity says a foreign key may only hold a value that already exists as a primary key in the table it points at. It may be NULL — meaning "not assigned" — but it may not be wrong.
items.ne: Referential integrity अनुसार foreign key ले देखाइएको तालिकाको primary key मा पहिले नै भएको मान मात्र राख्न पाउँछ। NULL हुन सक्छ — "तोकिएको छैन" भन्ने अर्थमा — तर गलत हुन पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The primary key of the "one" side is copied into the "many" side. Each student stores the one class_id they belong to. Doing it the other way round cannot work — a column holds one value, and a class has many students.
items.ne: "एक" तर्फको primary key "धेरै" तर्फ सारिन्छ। हरेक विद्यार्थीले आफू भएको एउटा class_id राख्छ। उल्टो गर्दा हुँदैन — स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्छ, र कक्षामा धेरै विद्यार्थी हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: The relational model links tables by matching values — a foreign key holding a value that exists as a primary key elsewhere. It deliberately avoids pointers, which is what made it simpler than the models before it.
items.ne: रिलेसनल मोडेलले मान मिलाएर तालिका जोड्छ — foreign key सँग अन्यत्र primary key भएको मान। यसले जानाजान pointer प्रयोग गर्दैन, र यही कारण यो अघिल्ला मोडेलभन्दा सरल भयो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: 3.3 — The properties of a relation. Every cell holds a single, atomic value — never a list. No two rows are identical — the primary key guarantees it. The order of rows does not matter, and neither does the order of columns — a table is a set, not a list. Every value in a column comes from the same domain.
items.ne: रिलेसनका गुण: हरेक कक्षमा एउटै अविभाज्य मान हुन्छ — सूची कहिल्यै होइन। दुई पङ्क्ति उस्तै हुँदैनन् — primary key ले सुनिश्चित गर्छ। पङ्क्तिको क्रमले फरक पार्दैन, स्तम्भको क्रमले पनि — तालिका सेट हो, सूची होइन। एउटै स्तम्भका सबै मान उही domain बाट आउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Swapping degree and cardinality. Degree counts columns; cardinality counts rows. Check your answer against the table — the two numbers are almost never the same.
items.ne: Degree र cardinality साट्नु। Degree ले स्तम्भ, cardinality ले पङ्क्ति गन्छ। तालिकासँग मिलाएर जाँच्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Convert an ER diagram into a set of tables, including the junction table an M:N relationship forces.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: रिलेसनल मोडेल के हो र किन प्रायः सबै डाटाबेसले यही प्रयोग गर्छन् भन्न, दिइएको तालिकाका हरेक भागलाई सही नाम दिन, degree र cardinality नअलमलिई छुट्याउन, domain–instance–schema परिभाषित गर्न, रिलेसनका गुण भन्न, र ER चित्रलाई तालिकामा बदल्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Press the same button twice to clear it.
items.ne: Degree र Cardinality एकपछि अर्को थिच्नुहोस् — उज्यालो स्तम्भबाट पङ्क्तिमा सर्छ। दुवै गणना तालिकामुनि सधैं देखिन्छ। अब Relational schema र Relational instance थिच्नुहोस्। Schema ले शीर्ष भाग, instance ले मुख्य भाग बाल्छ — शीर्ष भनेको डिजाइन, मुख्य भाग भनेको आजको data। उही बटन दोहोर्‍याएर थिच्दा हट्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Two entities, related many-to-many. Commit to one number before you open this: how many tables will the finished answer have? The number itself tells you whether you have remembered the M:N rule.
items.ne: दुई entity, many-to-many सम्बन्ध। खोल्नुअघि एउटा सङ्ख्या भन्नुहोस्: पूरा उत्तरमा कति वटा तालिका हुनेछन्? त्यो सङ्ख्याले नै M:N को नियम सम्झनुभयो कि भएन भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Three tables from two entities. Marks are lost here by producing only two and trying to squeeze the relationship into a single column — which cannot work, because a column holds one value and this doctor has many patients.
items.ne: दुई इन्टिटीबाट तीन तालिका। यहाँ अंक जाने ठाउँ: दुई मात्र बनाएर सम्बन्धलाई एउटै स्तम्भमा कोच्न खोज्नु — जुन सम्भव छैन, किनभने स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्छ र यो डाक्टरका धेरै बिरामी छन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Gita's class_id is NULL, and that is allowed. A foreign key may be empty — it means "not assigned yet". It may not be wrong.
items.ne: दुई ब्याज पढ्नुहोस्। PK ले पङ्क्ति चिनाउने स्तम्भ, FK ले अर्को तालिका देखाउने स्तम्भ जनाउँछ। Student.class_id मा १०, १०, ११ छन् — सबै Class.class_id मा भएका मान। यही referential integrity हो। कक्षा १५ मा विद्यार्थी थप्न खोजे अस्वीकार हुन्छ। गीताको class_id NULL छ, र त्यो मिल्छ — foreign key खाली हुन पाउँछ, गलत हुन पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Write down all five answers now. Degree and cardinality are the pair that get swapped — one of them counts across, the other counts down, and deciding which before you look is the whole exercise.
items.ne: पाँचै उत्तर अहिल्यै लेख्नुहोस्। Degree र cardinality नै साटिने जोडी हो — एउटाले तेर्सो गन्छ, अर्कोले ठाडो, र हेर्नुअघि कुन हो भन्ने छुट्याउनु नै पूरा अभ्यास हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Write the two counts with the words "columns" and "rows" beside them, as above. A marker reading "Degree 4, Cardinality 3" cannot tell whether you knew which was which or guessed; "Degree 4 columns, Cardinality 3 rows" removes the doubt.
items.ne: दुई गणनासँगै "स्तम्भ" र "पङ्क्ति" शब्द लेख्नुहोस्। "Degree ४, Cardinality ३" मात्र लेखे परीक्षकले जानेर लेखेको कि अनुमान गरेको भन्न सक्दैनन्; शब्द थपे शङ्का हट्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Saying a relation may have duplicate rows. It may not — that is one of the defining properties.
items.ne: रिलेसनमा उही पङ्क्ति दोहोरिन सक्छ भन्नु। सक्दैन — यो परिभाषित गुण मध्येको एक हो।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Turning an M:N relationship into two tables. It needs three. The relationship itself becomes a table.
items.ne: M:N सम्बन्धलाई दुई तालिका बनाउनु। तीन चाहिन्छ — सम्बन्ध आफैं तालिका बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Confusing schema with instance. Inserting a row changes the instance. The schema is unchanged.
items.ne: Schema र instance मिसाउनु। पङ्क्ति थप्दा instance बदलिन्छ, schema होइन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Putting a list in a cell. "Maths, Science" in one cell breaks the atomic-value property — and it is exactly what 1NF exists to fix, in Unit 5.
items.ne: एउटै कक्षमा सूची राख्नु। "Maths, Science" ले अविभाज्य मानको गुण तोड्छ — र युनिट ५ को 1NF यही सुधार्न छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Two question shapes dominate here. The first gives you a small table and asks you to state its degree, its cardinality and its primary key — a few marks, quickly earned, provided you do not swap the first two. The second gives you an ER diagram and asks you to convert it to tables; the marks are for the right number of tables and for putting the foreign key on the correct side.
items.ne: यहाँ दुई किसिमका प्रश्न हावी छन्। पहिलोले सानो तालिका दिएर degree, cardinality र primary key सोध्छ — छिटो पाइने अंक, पहिला दुई नसाटे। दोस्रोले ER चित्र दिएर तालिकामा बदल्न भन्छ; अंक सही सङ्ख्या का तालिका र foreign key सही तर्फ राखेकोमा हुन्छ।

items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Any three, each named and explained in one line.
items.ne: कुनै तीन — नाम दिएर एक–एक हरफमा व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।

items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: One mark per table, one for the primary keys, one for the foreign key on the correct side. Putting student_id into Class instead would be wrong — a class has many students, so that column could not hold them all.
items.ne: सम्बन्ध 1:M भएकाले नियम २ लाग्छ: तेस्रो तालिका चाहिँदैन। "एक" तर्फ (Class) को primary key "धेरै" तर्फ (Student) मा foreign key भएर जान्छ। उल्टो गर्दा गलत हुन्छ।

items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Degree = number of columns. Cardinality = number of rows. Do not swap them.
items.ne: Degree = स्तम्भ सङ्ख्या। Cardinality = पङ्क्ति सङ्ख्या। नसाट्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A relation holds atomic values, no duplicate rows, and no significant order.
items.ne: रिलेसनमा अविभाज्य मान हुन्छन्, उही पङ्क्ति दोहोरिँदैन, र क्रमको महत्त्व हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: ER → tables: every entity a table; 1:M puts a foreign key in the many side; M:N makes a third table; a multivalued attribute makes its own table.
items.ne: ER → तालिका: हरेक इन्टिटी एउटा तालिका; 1:M मा "धेरै" तर्फ foreign key; M:N ले तेस्रो तालिका; बहुमान एट्रिब्युटले आफ्नै तालिका।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Referential integrity: a foreign key may be NULL, but it may never hold a value that does not exist in the table it points at.
items.ne: Referential integrity: foreign key NULL हुन सक्छ, तर देखाइएको तालिकामा नभएको मान कहिल्यै राख्न पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The relational model stores everything as tables and links them with keys, not pointers. Proposed by E. F. Codd, 1970.
items.ne: रिलेसनल मोडेलले सबै कुरा तालिकामा राख्छ र pointer होइन, कुञ्जीले जोड्छ। E. F. Codd, सन् १९७०।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The relational model represents all data as relations — two-dimensional tables of rows and columns — and represents the connections between them using keys rather than pointers or links. That is the whole idea, and its power is that it needs only one shape. A student, a course, and the enrolment joining them are all the same kind of object: a table. Nothing else has to be learned. It was proposed by E. F. Codd in 1970 and is the model behind MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL and MS Access.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् रिलेसनल मोडेल ले सबै data लाई रिलेसन — पङ्क्ति र स्तम्भ भएका दुई आयामिक तालिका — का रूपमा राख्छ, र तिनबीचको जोडाइ pointer वा link होइन, कुञ्जी ले देखाउँछ। पूरा विचार यत्ति हो, र यसको बल एउटै आकार चाहिनुमा छ। विद्यार्थी, विषय, र दुवैलाई जोड्ने भर्ना — तीनै उही किसिमका वस्तु हुन्: तालिका। अरू केही सिक्नु पर्दैन। यो E. F. Codd ले सन् १९७० मा प्रस्ताव गरेका हुन्, र MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL तथा MS Access यसैमा आधारित छन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Nine words, six things This topic is a list of terms, and lists of terms are what students confuse in the hall. The pair that goes wrong most is degree and cardinality: they sound interchangeable and they are not. Degree is the number of columns. Cardinality is the number of rows. A table with 4 columns and 100 rows has degree 4 and cardinality 100 — the numbers are usually nothing alike, so if you can remember which is which you can always check your own answer. Rather than memorising nine definitions, point at them. Use the tool below: choose a word and the part of the table it names lights up.
items.ne: नौ शब्द, छ वस्तु यो टपिक शब्दहरूको सूची हो, र परीक्षा हलमा विद्यार्थीले अलमल्ने ठाउँ यस्तै सूची हुन्। सबैभन्दा बढी बिग्रने जोडी degree र cardinality हो: सुन्दा उस्तै लाग्छ, तर होइन। Degree भनेको स्तम्भको सङ्ख्या। Cardinality भनेको पङ्क्तिको सङ्ख्या। ४ स्तम्भ र १०० पङ्क्ति भएको तालिकाको degree ४ र cardinality १०० हुन्छ — सङ्ख्या प्रायः निकै फरक हुने भएकाले कुन हो सम्झे आफ्नै उत्तर जाँच्न सकिन्छ। नौ परिभाषा घोक्नुभन्दा औंल्याएर हेर्नुहोस्। तलको औजारमा शब्द छान्नुहोस् — त्यसले जनाउने भाग तालिकामा बल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Four rules, applied in order 1. Every entity becomes a table. Its key attribute becomes the primary key, and every other attribute becomes a column. 2. A 1:M relationship is recorded by putting the primary key of the "one" side into the "many" side as a foreign key. No extra table. 3. A M:N relationship becomes a table of its own, holding the primary key of each side as a foreign key. Together those two columns form its composite primary key. 4. A multivalued attribute becomes a separate table too — a column can hold only one value, so two phone numbers cannot live in one cell.
items.ne: चार नियम, यही क्रममा १. हरेक इन्टिटी तालिका बन्छ। यसको कुञ्जी एट्रिब्युट primary key बन्छ, र बाँकी हरेक एट्रिब्युट एउटा स्तम्भ। २. 1:M सम्बन्ध लाई "एक" तर्फको primary key लाई "धेरै" तर्फ foreign key बनाएर राखिन्छ। थप तालिका चाहिँदैन। ३. M:N सम्बन्ध आफैं एउटा तालिका बन्छ, जसमा दुवैतर्फको primary key foreign key भएर बस्छ। ती दुई स्तम्भ मिलेर composite primary key बन्छ। ४. बहुमान एट्रिब्युट पनि छुट्टै तालिका बन्छ — स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्ने भएकाले दुई फोन नम्बर एउटै कक्षमा बस्न सक्दैनन्।

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.topic: 3.4 Mapping the ER model to the relational model
items.en: Degree counts across (columns). Cardinality counts down (rows).
items.ne: Degree ले तेर्सो गन्छ (स्तम्भ)। Cardinality ले ठाडो गन्छ (पङ्क्ति)।

items.en: Yes. A relation is a set of tuples, and a set has no order. This is why you must write ORDER BY when you want a particular order — the database is under no obligation to give you the rows in the order they were inserted, and without ORDER BY it may give a different order each time.
items.ne: हो। रिलेसन भनेको ट्युपलहरूको सेट हो, र सेटको क्रम हुँदैन। त्यसैले निश्चित क्रम चाहिँदा ORDER BY लेख्नैपर्छ — डाटाबेसले भर्ना गरेकै क्रममा दिनुपर्ने बाध्यता छैन।

M:N सम्बन्ध आफैं एउटा तालिका बन्छ, जसमा दुवैतर्फको primary key foreign key भएर बस्छ। ती दुई स्तम्भ मिलेर composite primary key बन्छ। ४. बहुमान एट्रिब्युट पनि छुट्टै तालिका बन्छ — स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्ने भएकाले दुई फोन नम्बर एउटै कक्षमा बस्न सक्दैनन्। {{dia:erToRelational}} Example 1 Converting an ER diagram to tables Question: a hospital records DOCTORs (doctor_id, name) and PATIENTs (patient_id, name). A doctor treats many patients, and a patient may be treated by many doctors. Convert this to the relational model. Two entities, related many-to-many. Commit to one number before you open this: how many tables will the finished answer have? The number itself tells you whether you have remembered the M:N rule. दुई entity, many-to-many सम्बन्ध। खोल्नुअघि एउटा सङ्ख्या भन्नुहोस्: पूरा उत्तरमा कति वटा तालिका हुनेछन्? त्यो सङ्ख्याले नै M:N को नियम सम्झनुभयो कि भएन भन्छ। Step 1 — apply rule 1 to each entity: Working Doctor ( doctor_id, name ) PK Patient ( patient_id, name ) PK Step 2 — decide the cardinality. Many doctors to many patients, in both directions, so it is M:N. Rule 3 applies: the relationship gets a table of its own. Answer Doctor ( doctor_id, name ) Patient ( patient_id, name ) Treats ( doctor_id, patient_id ) FK FK composite primary key = both columns together Three tables from two entities. Marks are lost here by producing only two and trying to squeeze the relationship into a single column — which cannot work, because a column holds one value and this doctor has many patients. दुई इन्टिटीबाट तीन तालिका। यहाँ अंक जाने ठाउँ: दुई मात्र बनाएर सम्बन्धलाई एउटै स्तम्भमा कोच्न खोज्नु — जुन सम्भव छैन, किनभने स्तम्भले एउटै मान राख्छ र यो डाक्टरका धेरै बिरामी छन्। Worked example — read it

items.subject: grade10/dbms
items.en: Relational Model
