items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् In a full subtractor, A = 0, B = 1, Bin = 1. What are D and Bo? Full subtractor मा A = ०, B = १, Bin = १ छ। D र Bo के हुन्छ? D = 1, Bo = 0 D = 1, Bo = 1 D = 0, Bo = 1 D = 0, Bo = 0 D = 0, Bo = 1. The sum to do is 0 − 1 − 1 = −2. Borrow once and the top becomes 10 in binary, which is 2; then 2 − 1 − 1 = 0, so the difference is 0 and the borrow stayed out at 1. Check it against the XOR rule too: 0 ⊕ 1 ⊕ 1 = 0. Both routes agree, and the trap in this row is assuming that a borrow always leaves a difference of 1. D = ०, Bo = १। गर्नुपर्ने जोडघटाउ ० − १ − १ = −२ हो। एक पटक borrow लिएपछि माथिको १० अर्थात् २ बन्छ; अनि २ − १ − १ = ०, त्यसैले difference ० र borrow बाहिर १ रह्यो। XOR नियमले पनि जाँच्नुहोस्: ० ⊕ १ ⊕ १ = ०। दुवै बाटो मिल्छ। यो पङ्क्तिको पासो — borrow लिएपछि difference सधैं १ हुन्छ भन्ने अनुमान। 4.6 Code converters {{dia:grayCode}} Binary to Gray: copy the leading bit, then XOR each neighbouring pair. Binary बाट Gray: पहिलो बिट सारै लैजाने, अनि छेउछाउका जोडी XOR गर्ने। The two converters you need Gray code is arranged so that only one bit changes between consecutive values. That matters in a position sensor: if several bits changed at once, a reading taken mid-change could be wildly wrong. BCD (Binary Coded Decimal) stores each decimal digit in its own group of four bits. 59 in BCD is 0101 1001 — not the same as 59 in plain binary, which is 111011. चाहिने दुई converter Gray code यसरी मिलाइएको हुन्छ कि लगातार दुई मानबीच एउटै बिट मात्र फेरियोस्। position sensor मा यो महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: धेरै बिट एकैचोटि फेरिँदा बीचमा लिइएको पठन धेरै गलत हुन सक्छ। BCD (Binary Coded Decimal) ले हरेक दशमलव अङ्कलाई आफ्नै चार बिटको समूहमा राख्छ। BCD मा 59 भनेको 0101 1001 हो — साधारण binary को 59 (111011) होइन। Example 2 Convert 1011 to Gray code, and 47 to BCD (a) Binary 1011 → Gray. Copy the leading bit, then XOR each adjacent pair: You now have the whole rule. Work out all four Gray bits of 1011 yourself before opening this — the method is short enough that reading it is no substitute for doing it once. पूरा नियम तपाईंसँग छ। खोल्नुअघि 1011 का चारै Gray बिट आफैँ निकाल्नुहोस् — तरिका छोटो छ, त्यसैले पढेर मात्र एक पटक गरेको बराबर हुँदैन। Working binary 1 0 1 1 copy 1 1 ⊕ 0 = 1 0 ⊕ 1 = 1 1 ⊕ 1 = 0 Gray 1 1 1 0 (b) Decimal 47 → BCD. Convert each digit separately into four bits: Working 4 → 0100 7 → 0111 47 in BCD = 0100 0111 The commonest error is converting 47 as a whole number to binary (101111) and calling it BCD. BCD never converts the number — it converts each digit. सबैभन्दा धेरै हुने गल्ती: 47 लाई पूरै संख्याका रूपमा binary (101111) बनाएर BCD भन्नु। BCD ले संख्या होइन, हरेक अङ्क बदल्छ। 4.7 – 4.10 Decoder, encoder, multiplexer, demultiplexer {{dia:combBlocks}} Learn them in opposite pairs: decoder ↔ encoder, and MUX ↔ DEMUX. विपरीत जोडीमा सिक्नुहोस्: decoder ↔ encoder, र MUX ↔ DEMUX। One definition each, and the line between the pairs Decoder — n inputs, 2ⁿ outputs. The input is a binary number, and the one output whose position matches that number goes to 1 while every other output stays at 0. A 2-to-4 decoder given 10 raises output 2 and nothing else. Few in, many out. Encoder — the exact reverse. 2ⁿ inputs, n outputs. One input is high and the circuit reports which one, as a binary number. A keypad uses one: press the 5 key, get 0101. Many in, few out. Multiplexer (MUX) — many data inputs, one output. n select lines choose which of the 2ⁿ inputs is passed through; the rest are ignored. A data selector. Many to one. Demultiplexer (DEMUX) — one data input, many outputs. The select lines choose which output the input is delivered to. A data distributor. One to many. The line that separates the pairs: a decoder and an encoder work on a code — the thing coming in or going out is the number. A MUX and a DEMUX move data, and the select lines are not the data; they only say which path it takes. एक–एक परिभाषा, र जोडीबीचको रेखा Decoder — n इनपुट, 2ⁿ आउटपुट। इनपुट एउटा binary सङ्ख्या हो, र त्यो सङ्ख्यासँग ठाउँ मिल्ने एउटै आउटपुट १ हुन्छ, अरू सबै ० मा रहन्छन्। 2-to-4 decoder लाई १० दिए आउटपुट २ मात्र उठ्छ। थोरै भित्र, धेरै बाहिर। Encoder — ठ्याक्कै उल्टो। 2ⁿ इनपुट, n आउटपुट। एउटा इनपुट उच्च हुन्छ र सर्किटले कुन हो भनी binary सङ्ख्यामा बताउँछ। किबोर्डको किप्याडमा यही हुन्छ: ५ थिच्दा ०१०१ आउँछ। धेरै भित्र, थोरै बाहिर। Multiplexer (MUX) — धेरै data इनपुट, एउटा आउटपुट। n select लाइनले 2ⁿ इनपुटमध्ये कुन पार गर्ने छान्छ; बाँकी बेवास्ता हुन्छन्। data छान्ने यन्त्र। धेरैदेखि एक। Demultiplexer (DEMUX) — एउटा data इनपुट, धेरै आउटपुट। select लाइनले इनपुट कुन आउटपुटमा पुर्‍याउने छान्छ। data बाँड्ने यन्त्र। एकदेखि धेरै। जोडीबीच छुट्याउने रेखा: decoder र encoder code मा काम गर्छन् — भित्र आउने वा बाहिर जाने चीज आफैं सङ्ख्या हो। MUX र DEMUX data सार्छन्, र select लाइन data होइन; त्यसले कुन बाटो भन्ने मात्र बताउँछ। Try it
items.ne: · चलाएर हेर्नुहोस्

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Binary Arithmetic and Combinational Logic
items.ne: बाइनरी गणित र कम्बिनेसनल लजिक

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: What you will learn: how each circuit turns its inputs into several outputs at once, and which truth-table row you are standing on.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक सर्किटले इनपुटलाई एकैचोटि धेरै आउटपुटमा कसरी बदल्छ, र तपाईं ट्रुथ टेबलको कुन पङ्क्तिमा हुनुहुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Choose Multiplexer in the workbench above, then change S1 and S0 and watch which data input reaches Y.
items.ne: माथिको प्रयोगशालामा Multiplexer छान्नुहोस्, अनि S1 र S0 बदलेर कुन डाटा इनपुट Y सम्म पुग्छ हेर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: A microprocessor is the whole CPU on one chip: the ALU that calculates, the control unit that directs, and the registers that hold values.
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसर भनेको एउटै चिपमा पूरै CPU हो: गणना गर्ने ALU, निर्देशन दिने control unit, र मान राख्ने register।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The address bus is 16 bits wide and unidirectional — the CPU always chooses the address, so memory never drives it. 16 lines reach 2¹⁶ = 64 KB.
items.ne: Address bus १६ बिट चौडा र एकतर्फी हुन्छ — ठेगाना सधैं CPU ले छान्छ। १६ लाइनले 2¹⁶ = ६४ KB सम्म पुग्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The Program Counter holds the ADDRESS of the next instruction. The Instruction Register holds the instruction itself once it has been fetched.
items.ne: Program Counter ले अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना राख्छ। Instruction Register ले झिकिसकेको निर्देशन आफैं राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The processor must first bring the instruction in (fetch), then work out what it means (decode), then carry it out (execute), storing any result.
items.ne: प्रोसेसरले पहिले निर्देशन भित्र्याउँछ (fetch), अनि त्यसको अर्थ निकाल्छ (decode), अनि चलाउँछ (execute), र नतिजा भए राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Flags record something about the last ALU result. Z is set to 1 when that result is exactly zero, so the program can act on it with a "jump if zero".
items.ne: Flag ले पछिल्लो ALU नतिजाबारे कुरा टिप्छ। नतिजा ठ्याक्कै शून्य हुँदा Z 1 हुन्छ, जसले "शून्य भए जम्प गर" गर्न दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The order from highest to lowest is TRAP, RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5, INTR. TRAP is also non-maskable — software cannot disable it.
items.ne: सर्वोच्चदेखि सबैभन्दा कम: TRAP, RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5, INTR। TRAP लाई सफ्टवेयरले बन्द गर्न सक्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The value 05H is written inside the instruction itself, so it is immediate addressing. Direct addressing would give a memory address instead.
items.ne: 05H मान निर्देशनभित्रै लेखिएको छ, त्यसैले यो immediate addressing हो। Direct ले मेमोरीको ठेगाना दिन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The same eight lines carry the lower address byte first and then the data, which saves eight pins. The ALE signal goes high to say the lines currently hold an address.
items.ne: उही आठ लाइनले पहिले तल्लो ठेगाना बाइट र त्यसपछि डाटा बोक्छन्, जसले आठ pin बचाउँछ। अहिले ठेगाना छ भन्न ALE सङ्केत उच्च हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: 16 address lines give 2¹⁶ = 65,536 distinct locations. At one byte each that is 64 KB.
items.ne: १६ ठेगाना लाइनले 2¹⁶ = ६५,५३६ फरक ठाउँ दिन्छ। प्रति ठाउँ एक बाइट भएकाले त्यो ६४ KB हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The ALU is the only part that calculates. The control unit directs the other blocks but performs no arithmetic itself.
items.ne: गणना गर्ने एउटै भाग ALU हो। Control unit ले अरू ब्लकलाई निर्देशन दिन्छ तर आफैं गणित गर्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: 5.3 – 5.6 The blocks of a microprocessor system
items.en: The three buses in one line each. The address bus says WHERE — 16 bits, one way, CPU to memory. The data bus carries WHAT — 8 bits, both ways. The control bus says WHEN and WHICH WAY — read, write, timing.
items.ne: तीन bus, एक–एक वाक्यमा: address bus ले कहाँ भन्छ — १६ बिट, एकतर्फी; data bus ले के बोक्छ — ८ बिट, दुवैतर्फ; control bus ले कहिले र कुन दिशामा भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Saying the PC holds the current instruction. It holds the address of the next one. The IR holds the instruction.
items.ne: PC ले चलिरहेको निर्देशन राख्छ भन्नु। यसले अर्कोको ठेगाना राख्छ; निर्देशन IR मा हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: 5.3 – 5.6 The blocks of a microprocessor system
items.en: This diagram is worth learning to draw from memory. Label the three blocks inside the CPU, the two outside it, and all three buses with their widths.
items.ne: यो चित्र सम्झेर कोर्न सिक्नु फाइदाजनक छ। CPU भित्रका तीन ब्लक, बाहिरका दुई, र तीनै bus लाई चौडाइसहित नाम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Five flags in an eight-bit register — and the three bits that are not used, which is the part the list above cannot show. Learn the positions: a question may ask which bit holds the carry flag.
items.ne: आठ बिटको रजिस्टरमा पाँच flag — र प्रयोगमा नआउने तीन बिट, जुन माथिको सूचीले देखाउन सक्दैन। स्थान सम्झनुहोस्: carry flag कुन बिटमा छ भनी सोध्न सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Forty pins, six groups. Questions ask what a group is for, not the number of an individual pin.
items.ne: चालीस pin, छ समूह। प्रश्नले समूह केका लागि हो भन्ने सोध्छ, कुनै एउटा pin को नम्बर होइन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The mode describes where the operand is found, not what the instruction does.
items.ne: Mode ले operand कहाँ भेटिन्छ भन्ने बताउँछ, निर्देशनले के गर्छ भन्ने होइन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Explain the instruction cycle in order, and identify an addressing mode.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: माइक्रोप्रोसेसरको परिभाषा र प्रयोग भन्न, वर्गीकरण गर्न, ब्लक डायग्राम कोर्न, ALU, control unit, register, flag र तीन bus वर्णन गर्न, 8085 का pin समूह र interrupt नाम लिन, र निर्देशन चक्र क्रमैसँग बताउन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: how many bits it handles at once — the 8085 is 8-bit
items.ne: एकैचोटि कति बिट सम्हाल्छ — 8085 8-बिटको हो

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: many complex instructions, or few simple fast ones
items.ne: धेरै जटिल निर्देशन, कि थोरै सरल र छिटो

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: a computer's CPU, a whole system on one chip, or signal work
items.ne: कम्प्युटरको CPU, एउटै चिपमा पूरै प्रणाली, वा सिग्नलको काम

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The flags change only when the ALU produces a result. After ADD B the answer is 08H: not zero, not negative, no carry out — so all three flags read 0.
items.ne: PC FETCH मै सर्छ, अन्त्यमा होइन। ALU ADD B को EXECUTE मा मात्र बल्छ — MVI र STA ले छुँदैनन्, किनभने डाटा सार्नु गणित होइन। ALU ले नतिजा दिँदा मात्र flag बदलिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: One simplification, so you are not caught out: the first instruction's FETCH is shown as two steps — the address going out, then the instruction coming back — because that is the part worth seeing once. For the second and third instructions both halves are shown as a single FETCH step. Nothing else is compressed.
items.ne: एउटा सरलीकरण, अन्योल नहोस् भनेर: पहिलो निर्देशनको FETCH लाई दुई चरणमा देखाइएको छ — ठेगाना बाहिर जाने, अनि निर्देशन फर्केर आउने — किनभने एक पटक हेर्न लायक कुरा त्यही हो। दोस्रो र तेस्रो निर्देशनमा दुवै भाग एउटै FETCH चरणमा देखाइएको छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: A0H + 60H. Do the addition in binary first, then commit to all four flags before opening this. The one that catches people is Z: a result of zero and a carry out of the top bit happen together here.
items.ne: A0H + 60H। पहिले binary मा जोड्नुहोस्, अनि खोल्नुअघि चारै flag भन्नुहोस्। अल्झाउने चाहिँ Z हो: यहाँ शून्य नतिजा र माथिल्लो बिटको carry सँगै आउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Two traps live in this one question. The carry is not part of the accumulator — A holds 00H and the ninth bit lives in CY alone. And parity counts the 1s in the result, so a result of zero has even parity and sets P. Students routinely answer P = 0 here.
items.ne: यही प्रश्नमा दुई पासो छन्। Carry accumulator को भाग होइन — A मा 00H छ र नवौं बिट CY मा मात्र। र parity ले नतिजाका 1 गन्छ, त्यसैले शून्य नतिजाको parity जोर हुन्छ र P = 1 हुन्छ। विद्यार्थीले प्रायः P = 0 लेख्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Why AD0–AD7 are shared. A 16-bit address and an 8-bit data value would need 24 pins. The 8085 saves eight of them by sending the lower address byte and the data over the same eight lines at different moments. The ALE pin goes high to say "these lines are carrying an address right now" — that is the whole meaning of the word multiplexed in the phrase "multiplexed address/data bus".
items.ne: AD0–AD7 किन साझा: १६-बिट ठेगाना र ८-बिट डाटालाई २४ pin चाहिन्थ्यो। 8085 ले तल्लो ठेगाना बाइट र डाटा उही आठ लाइनबाट फरक–फरक क्षणमा पठाएर आठ pin बचाउँछ। ALE pin ले "अहिले यी लाइनमा ठेगाना छ" भन्छ — "multiplexed" शब्दको अर्थ यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Name all five before opening this. Two of them look almost identical — MOV A, C and MOV A, M — and they are not the same mode. That pair is the whole question.
items.ne: खोल्नुअघि पाँचै वटा भन्नुहोस्। दुई वटा झन्डै उस्तै देखिन्छन् — MOV A, C र MOV A, M — तर तिनको mode फरक हो। त्यही जोडी नै पूरा प्रश्न हो।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The trick for telling direct from register indirect: direct writes the address in the instruction; indirect keeps it in a register pair, so you have to look there first.
items.ne: Direct र register indirect छुट्याउने तरिका: direct ले ठेगाना निर्देशनमै लेख्छ; indirect ले register pair मा राख्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यहाँ हेर्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Drawing the address bus as two-way. It is one way only — the CPU always chooses the address.
items.ne: Address bus लाई दुईतर्फी कोर्नु। यो एकतर्फी मात्र हो।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Confusing the 8-bit data bus with the 16-bit address bus. 8 bits of data make the 8085 an 8-bit processor; 16 address lines give it 64 KB of memory.
items.ne: ८-बिट data bus र १६-बिट address bus मिसाउनु। ८ बिट डाटाले 8085 लाई ८-बिट प्रोसेसर बनाउँछ; १६ ठेगाना लाइनले ६४ KB मेमोरी दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Putting TRAP anywhere but first. TRAP has the highest priority and cannot be masked.
items.ne: TRAP लाई पहिलो बाहेक अन्त राख्नु। TRAP कै प्राथमिकता सर्वोच्च हो र यसलाई बन्द गर्न मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: 15 hours and 15 marks — joint highest in the subject, with Unit 2. The block diagram is the single most valuable thing to be able to draw. After that: the definition, the three buses with their widths, the function of each register, the five flags, the five interrupts in priority order, and the instruction cycle in sequence. Almost all of it is recall, so it rewards revision directly.
items.ne: १५ घण्टा र १५ अंक — युनिट २ सँगै विषयकै सबैभन्दा बढी। कोर्न सक्नुपर्ने सबैभन्दा महत्त्वपूर्ण कुरा ब्लक डायग्राम हो। त्यसपछि: परिभाषा, तीन bus र तिनका चौडाइ, हरेक register को काम, पाँच flag, प्राथमिकताक्रममा पाँच interrupt, र निर्देशन चक्र। प्रायः सबै सम्झनामा आधारित छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Applications: computers, mobile phones, washing machines, traffic light controllers, calculators, cars.
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसर भनेको ALU, control unit र register समेटिएको एउटै IC हो — पूरै CPU एउटै चिपमा। यसले मेमोरीका निर्देशन झिक्छ, बुझ्छ र चलाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: ALU: performs all arithmetic and logical operations. Control Unit: decodes instructions and directs every other block. Registers: fast internal storage — accumulator, general purpose registers, PC, IR, SP and the flag register. Memory: stores the program and the data. Input/Output: connects the system to the outside world. Buses: address (16-bit, one way), data (8-bit, both ways), control (timing and read/write signals).
items.ne: CPU भित्र ALU, Control Unit र Registers; बाहिर Memory र Input/Output; तीन bus ले जोड्छन्। हरेकको काम माथि लेखिएझैं।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Store: if the instruction produces a result to be kept, it is written back to a register or to memory. The cycle then repeats for the next instruction.
items.ne: Fetch → Decode → Execute → Store, अनि यही क्रम अर्को निर्देशनका लागि दोहोरिन्छ। हरेक चरणमा कुन भागले काम गर्छ लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Interrupts, highest priority first: TRAP, RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5, INTR. TRAP is non-maskable — it cannot be disabled by software.
items.ne: Flag: S, Z, CY, AC, P। Interrupt प्राथमिकताक्रममा: TRAP, RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5, INTR। TRAP लाई सफ्टवेयरले बन्द गर्न सक्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Address bus 16-bit one way; data bus 8-bit both ways; control bus for timing.
items.ne: Address bus १६-बिट एकतर्फी; data bus ८-बिट दुवैतर्फ; control bus समयका लागि।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: PC holds the address of the next instruction; IR holds the current one.
items.ne: PC ले अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना; IR ले चलिरहेको निर्देशन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: FETCH → DECODE → EXECUTE → STORE, repeating for every instruction.
items.ne: FETCH → DECODE → EXECUTE → STORE, हरेक निर्देशनका लागि दोहोरिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Five flags: S, Z, CY, AC, P — all set by the ALU from its last result.
items.ne: पाँच flag: S, Z, CY, AC, P — सबै ALU ले पछिल्लो नतिजाबाट सेट गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Interrupts by priority: TRAP, RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5, INTR.
items.ne: Interrupt प्राथमिकताक्रम: TRAP, RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5, INTR।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The addressing mode says where the operand is, not what the instruction does.
items.ne: Addressing mode ले operand कहाँ छ भन्छ, निर्देशनले के गर्छ भन्ने होइन।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A microprocessor is the whole CPU — ALU, control unit and registers — on one chip.
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसर भनेको पूरै CPU — ALU, control unit र register — एउटै चिपमा।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A microprocessor is a single integrated circuit that contains the arithmetic logic unit, the control unit and the registers of a computer — that is, the whole central processing unit on one chip. It fetches instructions from memory, decodes them and executes them. On its own it does nothing useful: it needs memory and input/output devices around it to become a working system. Applications: computers and laptops, mobile phones, washing machines, traffic lights, calculators, cars, medical instruments — anything that follows a stored set of instructions.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् माइक्रोप्रोसेसर भनेको एउटै एकीकृत सर्किट (IC) हो, जसभित्र कम्प्युटरको arithmetic logic unit, control unit र register हुन्छन् — अर्थात् पूरै केन्द्रीय प्रोसेसिङ इकाई एउटै चिपमा। यसले मेमोरीबाट निर्देशन झिक्छ, बुझ्छ र चलाउँछ। एक्लै यसले केही गर्न सक्दैन: काम गर्ने प्रणाली बन्न वरिपरि मेमोरी र इनपुट/आउटपुट यन्त्र चाहिन्छ। प्रयोग: कम्प्युटर र ल्यापटप, मोबाइल फोन, वासिङ मेसिन, ट्राफिक बत्ती, क्याल्कुलेटर, कार, चिकित्सा उपकरण — भण्डारण गरिएका निर्देशन पछ्याउने जुनसुकै यन्त्र।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: 5.3 – 5.6 The blocks of a microprocessor system
items.en: What each block does ALU — performs all arithmetic (add, subtract) and all logic (AND, OR, NOT, compare). It is the only part that calculates. Control Unit — decodes the instruction and tells every other block what to do and when. It calculates nothing itself; it directs. Registers — very fast storage inside the CPU. The accumulator (A) holds one operand and receives the result; B, C, D, E, H, L are general purpose; the Program Counter (PC) holds the address of the next instruction; the Instruction Register (IR) holds the instruction being carried out; the Stack Pointer (SP) holds the top of the stack. Memory — holds the program and the data, one byte per address. Input/output — everything outside: keyboard, display, ports.
items.ne: हरेक ब्लकको काम ALU — सबै गणित (जोड, घटाउ) र सबै तर्क (AND, OR, NOT, तुलना) गर्छ। गणना गर्ने एउटै भाग यही हो। Control Unit — निर्देशन बुझेर अरू हरेक ब्लकलाई कहिले के गर्ने भन्छ। यसले आफैं गणना गर्दैन; निर्देशन दिन्छ। Registers — CPU भित्रकै अति छिटो भण्डारण। accumulator (A) ले एउटा operand राख्छ र नतिजा पाउँछ; B, C, D, E, H, L सामान्य प्रयोजनका; Program Counter (PC) ले अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना राख्छ; Instruction Register (IR) ले चलिरहेको निर्देशन; Stack Pointer (SP) ले stack को टुप्पो। Memory — प्रोग्राम र डाटा, प्रति ठेगाना एक बाइट। Input/output — बाहिरका सबै यन्त्र।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Why this comes first The blocks above only make sense once you have watched them work. Every instruction a processor ever runs goes through the same cycle: FETCH — the PC's address goes onto the address bus, and memory returns the instruction on the data bus into the IR. DECODE — the control unit works out what the instruction means. EXECUTE — the ALU or the registers do the work. STORE — if there is a result to keep, it is written back. Then the cycle repeats, for as long as the processor is powered.
items.ne: यो पहिले किन माथिका ब्लक काम गरेको हेरेपछि मात्र बुझिन्छन्। प्रोसेसरले चलाउने हरेक निर्देशन उही चक्रबाट जान्छ: FETCH — PC को ठेगाना address bus मा जान्छ, मेमोरीले निर्देशन data bus बाट IR मा फर्काउँछ। DECODE — control unit ले निर्देशनको अर्थ निकाल्छ। EXECUTE — ALU वा register ले काम गर्छ। STORE — राख्नुपर्ने नतिजा भए फेरि लेखिन्छ। अनि प्रोसेसरमा बिजुली भएसम्म यही चक्र दोहोरिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The flag register A flag is a single bit that records something about the last ALU result. The 8085 has five: S — Sign: 1 if the result is negative. Z — Zero: 1 if the result is exactly zero. CY — Carry: 1 if the result produced a carry out. AC — Auxiliary Carry: a carry from bit 3 to bit 4, used in BCD arithmetic. P — Parity: 1 if the result has an even number of 1s. Flags exist so the program can make decisions: "jump if zero" reads Z.
items.ne: Flag रजिस्टर Flag भनेको एउटा बिट हो, जसले पछिल्लो ALU नतिजाबारे केही कुरा टिपेर राख्छ। 8085 मा पाँच छन्: S — Sign: नतिजा ऋणात्मक भए 1। Z — Zero: नतिजा ठ्याक्कै शून्य भए 1। CY — Carry: क्यारी बाहिर निस्किए 1। AC — Auxiliary Carry: बिट ३ बाट ४ मा गएको क्यारी, BCD गणितमा प्रयोग हुन्छ। P — Parity: नतिजामा 1 को सङ्ख्या जोर भए 1। Flag हुनुको कारण: प्रोग्रामले निर्णय गर्न सकोस् — "शून्य भए जम्प गर" ले Z पढ्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Interrupts An interrupt is a signal that asks the processor to stop what it is doing, attend to something urgent, and then return to exactly where it left off. The 8085 has five: TRAP (highest priority, cannot be disabled), RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5 and INTR (lowest priority). Learn the priority order — it is the part that gets asked.
items.ne: Interrupt Interrupt भनेको त्यस्तो सङ्केत हो, जसले प्रोसेसरलाई गरिरहेको काम रोकेर जरुरी कामतिर ध्यान दिन र त्यसपछि ठ्याक्कै जहाँ छाडेको थियो त्यहीँ फर्कन भन्छ। 8085 मा पाँच छन्: TRAP (सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता, बन्द गर्न मिल्दैन), RST 7.5, RST 6.5, RST 5.5 र INTR (सबैभन्दा कम)। प्राथमिकताको क्रम सम्झनुहोस् — सोधिने भाग त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: PC points at the next instruction. IR holds the one running now.
items.ne: PC ले अर्को instruction को ठेगाना देखाउँछ। IR ले अहिले चलिरहेको बोक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Define a microprocessor and list any four applications.
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसरको परिभाषा दिनुहोस् र कुनै चार प्रयोग लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Draw the block diagram of a microprocessor system and explain the function of each block.
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसर प्रणालीको ब्लक डायग्राम कोर्नुहोस् र हरेक ब्लकको काम व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Explain the instruction cycle of a microprocessor.
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसरको निर्देशन चक्र व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Name the flags of the 8085 and state when each is set. List its interrupts in order of priority.
items.ne: 8085 का flag र ती कहिले सेट हुन्छन् लेख्नुहोस्। Interrupt लाई प्राथमिकताक्रममा राख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: The PC holds the address of the next instruction; the IR holds the instruction itself once it has arrived. Watch the simulation below — the PC moves on during FETCH, before the instruction has even been decoded.
items.ne: PC ले अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना राख्छ; IR ले आइसकेको निर्देशन आफैं। तलको सिमुलेसनमा हेर्नुहोस् — निर्देशन decode हुनुअघि नै FETCH मा PC अगाडि सर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Which register holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched?
items.ne: झिक्नुपर्ने अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना कुन रजिस्टरमा हुन्छ?

items.ne: किबोर्ड, मनिटर र प्रिन्टर

items.ne: RAM, ROM र हार्ड डिस्क
