items.en: · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् Which register holds the address of the next instruction to be fetched? झिक्नुपर्ने अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना कुन रजिस्टरमा हुन्छ? Program Counter (PC) Instruction Register (IR) Accumulator (A) The PC holds the address of the next instruction; the IR holds the instruction itself once it has arrived. Watch the simulation below — the PC moves on during FETCH, before the instruction has even been decoded. PC ले अर्को निर्देशनको ठेगाना राख्छ; IR ले आइसकेको निर्देशन आफैं। तलको सिमुलेसनमा हेर्नुहोस् — निर्देशन decode हुनुअघि नै FETCH मा PC अगाडि सर्छ। Step-by-step simulation
items.ne: · पाइला–पाइला सिमुलेसन

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: Introduction to Microprocessor
items.ne: माइक्रोप्रोसेसर र यसका भाग

items.subject: grade10/digital-design
items.en: What you will learn: which block is working at each stage, what the buses are carrying, and when the flags change.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: हरेक चरणमा कुन ब्लकले काम गर्छ, bus ले के बोकिरहेको छ, र flag कहिले बदलिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The proton is positive and sits in the nucleus. The neutron is also in the nucleus but has no charge; the electron is negative and orbits in shells. A molecule is not a subatomic particle at all — it is made of atoms.
items.ne: Proton धनात्मक हुन्छ र nucleus मा बस्छ। Neutron पनि nucleus मै हुन्छ तर चार्ज हुँदैन; electron ऋणात्मक हुन्छ र शेलमा घुम्छ। Molecule उप-आणविक कण नै होइन — यो atom हरूबाट बनेको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: KCL: total in equals total out. In = 6 + 2 = 8 A. Known out = 3 A, so the remaining branch carries 8 − 3 = 5 A. Choosing 11 A means the 3 A was added instead of subtracted — a sign error, not a knowledge gap.
items.ne: KCL: भित्र आउने कुल र बाहिर जाने कुल बराबर। भित्र = ६ + २ = ८ A। थाहा भएको बाहिर = ३ A, त्यसैले बाँकी शाखाले ८ − ३ = ५ A बोक्छ। ११ A छान्नु भनेको ३ A घटाउनुको साटो जोडिनु — ज्ञानको कमी होइन, चिन्हको गल्ती।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Trivalent means three valence electrons, so one of silicon's four bonds is left unfilled — that gap is a hole, and holes dominating makes it P-type. Option 3 is the trap: P-type is NOT charged. Doping adds a carrier, not a charge, because the impurity atom brings its own protons.
items.ne: Trivalent भनेको तीन valence electron, त्यसैले silicon का चारमध्ये एउटा बन्धन खाली रहन्छ — त्यो खाली ठाउँ hole हो, र hole हावी हुँदा P-type बन्छ। तेस्रो विकल्प पासो हो: P-type मा चार्ज हुँदैन। Doping ले वाहक थप्छ, चार्ज होइन — किनकि अशुद्धिको atom आफ्नै proton सहित आउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Reverse bias pulls carriers away from the junction, so the region empty of carriers grows wider and the barrier increases. Note the wording: a small leakage current, carried by the minority carriers, does still flow — writing "no current at all" loses the mark that "negligible leakage current" earns.
items.ne: Reverse bias ले वाहकलाई जोडबाट टाढा तान्छ, त्यसैले वाहकविहीन क्षेत्र चौडा हुन्छ र barrier बढ्छ। शब्द ध्यान दिनुहोस्: अल्पसंख्यक वाहकले बोक्ने सानो leakage current भने बग्छ — "बिल्कुलै current छैन" लेख्दा अंक गुम्छ, "नगण्य leakage current" ले पाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Saying N-type is negatively charged and P-type positively charged. Both are electrically neutral. The impurity atom brings its own protons with it — doping adds a carrier, not a charge.
items.ne: N-type ऋणात्मक र P-type धनात्मक चार्ज भएको भन्नु। दुवै विद्युतीय रूपमा उदासीन छन्। अशुद्धिको atom ले आफ्नै proton ल्याउँछ — doping ले वाहक थप्छ, चार्ज होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: P-type or N-type?
items.ne: P-type कि N-type?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Each case describes a doped semiconductor from a different angle — the impurity, the carrier, or what the exam calls it. Decide which material it is. The trap is the last one: neither type is charged.
items.ne: हरेक केसले doped semiconductor लाई फरक कोणबाट वर्णन गर्छ — अशुद्धि, वाहक, वा परीक्षाको शब्द। कुन पदार्थ हो छान्नुहोस्। अन्तिममा पासो छ: कुनै पनि प्रकार चार्ज भएको हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: True of both
items.ne: दुवैमा सही

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Phosphorus is pentavalent. Four of its electrons bond with the silicon; the fifth is spare and free to move. A spare electron means N-type — N for negative carrier.
items.ne: Phosphorus pentavalent हो। यसका चारवटा electron silicon सँग बन्धन बनाउँछन्; पाँचौं फाल्तु रहन्छ र चल्न स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ। फाल्तु electron भनेको N-type — N भनेको ऋणात्मक वाहक।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A hole is the gap left where a bond could not be completed, and it behaves like a positive carrier. Holes dominating means P-type — P for positive carrier.
items.ne: Hole भनेको बन्धन पूरा हुन नसकेको खाली ठाउँ हो, र यो धनात्मक वाहकजस्तै व्यवहार गर्छ। Hole हावी हुनु भनेको P-type — P भनेको धनात्मक वाहक।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Boron is trivalent — it can fill only three of the four bonds silicon offers. The fourth is left empty, and that empty bond is a hole. Trivalent gives P-type.
items.ne: Boron trivalent हो — silicon ले दिने चारमध्ये तीन बन्धन मात्र भर्न सक्छ। चौथो खाली रहन्छ, र त्यही खाली बन्धन hole हो। Trivalent ले P-type दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Read which carrier is in the MINORITY, not which is named. If holes are the minority then electrons are the majority, so this is N-type. Half the marks lost on this topic go to reading "minority" as "majority".
items.ne: कुन वाहक अल्पसंख्यक हो पढ्नुहोस्, नाम लिइएको होइन। Hole अल्पसंख्यक भए electron बहुसंख्यक हुन्छ, त्यसैले यो N-type हो। यस विषयमा गुम्ने आधा अंक "अल्पसंख्यक" लाई "बहुसंख्यक" पढ्दा जान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: This is the trap, and it is worth a mark on its own. Doping adds a CARRIER, not a CHARGE — the impurity atom arrives with its own protons, so the total charge is unchanged. Neither P-type nor N-type is charged.
items.ne: यही पासो हो, र यसैको छुट्टै अंक हुन्छ। Doping ले वाहक थप्छ, चार्ज होइन — अशुद्धिको atom आफ्नै proton सहित आउँछ, त्यसैले कुल चार्ज उस्तै रहन्छ। P-type र N-type कुनै पनि चार्ज भएको हुँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Each one is contained in the one before it. "Define matter, molecule and atom" is answered by getting this order right and naming the three particles.
items.ne: हरेक कुरा अघिल्लोभित्र पर्छ। "Matter, molecule र atom को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको उत्तर यही क्रम मिलाएर र तीन कणको नाम लिएर दिइन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Both laws are "state it, then apply it" questions. The applying is simple arithmetic once you have decided which currents are in and which are out.
items.ne: दुवै नियम "भन्नुहोस्, अनि लगाउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न हुन्। कुन current भित्र र कुन बाहिर हो छुट्याइसकेपछि लगाउनु साधारण गणित मात्र हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The yellow band at the bottom is the line that most often decides a mark: doping adds a carrier, not a charge. Both doped types are still electrically neutral.
items.ne: तलको पहेँलो पट्टी नै प्रायः अंक निर्धारण गर्ने वाक्य हो: doping ले वाहक थप्छ, चार्ज होइन। दुवै doped प्रकार अझै विद्युतीय रूपमा उदासीन छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Step through it. Forward and reverse bias are not two facts to memorise — they are the same depletion region moving in opposite directions.
items.ne: एक–एक चरण हेर्नुहोस्। Forward र reverse bias घोक्नुपर्ने दुई तथ्य होइनन् — उही depletion region उल्टो दिशामा चलेको हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Explain forward bias and reverse bias, and why a diode conducts in only one direction.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: matter, molecule र atom को परिभाषा दिन र तीन उप-आणविक कणलाई चार्जसहित नाम लिन, KCL र KVL भन्न र लगाएर छुटेको मान निकाल्न, doping के हो र P-type–N-type कसरी बन्छ भन्न, दुवैको बहुसंख्यक–अल्पसंख्यक वाहक नाम लिन र दुवै किन उदासीन रहन्छन् भन्न, PN junction र depletion region कसरी बन्छ बताउन, र forward–reverse bias मा diode किन एकतर्फी मात्र चल्छ व्याख्या गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Work it out before you read on — the whole law is one sentence, and you already have it.
items.ne: पढ्नुअघि आफैँ निकाल्नुहोस् — पूरै नियम एउटै वाक्य हो, र त्यो तपाईंसँग छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Say the direction, not just the number. A junction question with an unsigned answer is only half answered, because "2 A" is true of a current going either way.
items.ne: सङ्ख्या मात्र होइन, दिशा पनि लेख्नुहोस्। दिशा नलेखिएको उत्तर आधा मात्र हो — किनकि "२ A" दुवै दिशाको current लाई मिल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: This is the check a technician makes on a suspect power rail: if the drops do not add up to the supply, either a reading is wrong or there is a fault in the loop.
items.ne: बिग्रिएको पावर रेल जाँच्दा टेक्निसियनले यही हेर्छ: ड्रपको योग सप्लाईसँग मिलेन भने या त कुनै रिडिङ गलत छ, या loop मै खराबी छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Writing that no current at all flows in reverse bias. A very small leakage current flows, carried by the minority carriers. "No current" loses the mark that "negligible leakage current" earns.
items.ne: Reverse bias मा बिल्कुलै current बग्दैन भन्नु। अल्पसंख्यक वाहकले बोकेको सानो leakage current बग्छ। "Current छैन" भन्दा "नगण्य leakage current" ले अंक पाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Confusing a hole with an electron that has moved. A hole is the absence of an electron in a bond, and it behaves like a positive carrier.
items.ne: Hole लाई सरेको electron सम्झनु। Hole भनेको बन्धनमा electron को अनुपस्थिति हो, र यो धनात्मक वाहकजस्तै व्यवहार गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Mixing up KCL and KVL. Current at a junction, voltage round a loop. If the question shows a node, it is KCL; if it shows a closed path, it is KVL.
items.ne: KCL र KVL मिसाउनु। जोडमा current, loop मा voltage। प्रश्नले node देखाए KCL, बन्द बाटो देखाए KVL।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This is the only theory-heavy unit in a practical subject, and it carries 8 marks. Questions come in three shapes: define (matter, molecule, atom, doping, semiconductor), state and apply (KCL and KVL with numbers — always show the equation before the answer), and differentiate (P-type vs N-type, forward vs reverse bias, majority vs minority carrier). The PN junction with its depletion region labelled is the one diagram from this unit you may be asked to draw.
items.ne: व्यावहारिक विषयको एक मात्र सैद्धान्तिक भारी युनिट यही हो, र यसले ८ अंक बोक्छ। प्रश्न तीन किसिमका आउँछन्: परिभाषा (matter, molecule, atom, doping, semiconductor), भनेर लगाउने (सङ्ख्यासहित KCL र KVL — उत्तरअघि समीकरण अवश्य लेख्नुहोस्), र फरक छुट्याउने (P-type र N-type, forward र reverse bias, बहुसंख्यक र अल्पसंख्यक वाहक)। यस युनिटबाट कोर्न सकिने चित्र depletion region नामांकित PN junction हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: When P-type and N-type are joined, free electrons from the N side diffuse across and recombine with holes on the P side. The strip either side of the join is left with no free carriers and with exposed ions, forming the depletion region and a barrier potential of about 0.7 V in silicon. Under reverse bias the supply pulls carriers away from the junction, so the depletion region widens, the barrier increases, and conduction stops apart from a small leakage current due to minority carriers.
items.ne: P-type र N-type जोडिँदा N तर्फका स्वतन्त्र electron पारि सरेर P तर्फका hole सँग पुनर्संयोजन हुन्छन्। जोडको दुवैतिरको पट्टीमा स्वतन्त्र वाहक रहँदैन र खुला ion बाँकी रहन्छन् — यसैले depletion region र silicon मा करिब ०.७ V को barrier potential बन्छ। Reverse bias मा सप्लाईले वाहकलाई जोडबाट टाढा तान्छ, त्यसैले depletion region चौडा हुन्छ, barrier बढ्छ, र अल्पसंख्यक वाहकको सानो leakage current बाहेक चालन रोकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: KCL: current in = current out at a junction. KVL: supply = sum of drops around a loop.
items.ne: KCL: जोडमा भित्रको current = बाहिरको current। KVL: loop मा सप्लाई = ड्रपहरूको योग।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Silicon and germanium have four valence electrons. Doping adds a pentavalent impurity for N-type or a trivalent one for P-type.
items.ne: Silicon र germanium मा चार valence electron हुन्छन्। N-type लाई pentavalent, P-type लाई trivalent अशुद्धि मिसाइन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: N-type: electrons majority, holes minority. P-type: holes majority, electrons minority. Both are electrically neutral.
items.ne: N-type: electron बहुसंख्यक, hole अल्पसंख्यक। P-type: hole बहुसंख्यक, electron अल्पसंख्यक। दुवै उदासीन छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The depletion region has no free carriers and sets up a 0.7 V barrier in silicon. Forward bias narrows it and current flows; reverse bias widens it and current stops apart from leakage.
items.ne: Depletion region मा स्वतन्त्र वाहक हुँदैन र silicon मा ०.७ V को barrier बन्छ। Forward bias ले साँघुरो बनाउँछ र current बग्छ; reverse bias ले चौडा बनाउँछ र leakage बाहेक current रोकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: every diode, transistor and chip on a motherboard is built from these two materials joined together. If you cannot tell them apart, the PN junction in 1.4 has nothing to stand on.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: मदरबोर्डको हरेक diode, transistor र चिप यिनै दुई पदार्थ जोडेर बनेको हुन्छ। यी छुट्याउन नसके १.४ को PN junction अडिने ठाउँ नै रहँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Matter → molecule → atom → proton, neutron, electron. Proton positive, neutron neutral, electron negative.
items.ne: Matter → molecule → atom → proton, neutron, electron। Proton धनात्मक, neutron उदासीन, electron ऋणात्मक।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Matter is anything that has mass and occupies space. A wire, a chip, the air around the board — all matter. A molecule is the smallest particle of a substance that still has the properties of that substance. Split a water molecule and you no longer have water. An atom is the smallest particle of an element. It is built from three subatomic particles: the proton (positive) and neutron (no charge) in the nucleus, and the electron (negative) orbiting in shells. Electronics is the study of what those outermost electrons do. Everything in this subject — conduction, doping, a diode — comes back to whether an electron is free to move.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Matter भनेको जुनसुकै कुरा जसको द्रव्यमान हुन्छ र ठाउँ ओगट्छ। तार, चिप, बोर्ड वरिपरिको हावा — सबै matter हुन्। Molecule भनेको कुनै पदार्थको त्यस्तो सबैभन्दा सानो कण, जसमा त्यही पदार्थका गुण कायम रहन्छन्। पानीको molecule फुटाए त्यो पानी रहँदैन। Atom भनेको तत्व को सबैभन्दा सानो कण हो। यसमा तीन उप-आणविक कण हुन्छन्: nucleus भित्र proton (धनात्मक) र neutron (चार्ज नभएको), अनि शेलमा घुम्ने electron (ऋणात्मक)। इलेक्ट्रोनिक्स भनेको ती सबैभन्दा बाहिरी electron ले के गर्छन् भन्ने अध्ययन हो। यस विषयका सबै कुरा — चालकता, doping, diode — electron चल्न स्वतन्त्र छ कि छैन भन्नेमै फर्किन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL): at any junction, the total current flowing in equals the total current flowing out. Nothing is created or lost at a joint. Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL): around any closed loop, the supply voltage equals the sum of the voltage drops. Energy given by the source is entirely used up by the loop. These two laws are why a technician can reason about a board without measuring every point: if three currents at a junction are known, the fourth is fixed.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Kirchhoff's Current Law (KCL): कुनै पनि जोडमा भित्र आउने कुल current र बाहिर जाने कुल current बराबर हुन्छ। जोडमा केही बन्दैन, केही हराउँदैन। Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (KVL): कुनै पनि बन्द loop मा सप्लाईको भोल्टेज र सबै भोल्टेज ड्रपको योग बराबर हुन्छ। स्रोतले दिएको ऊर्जा loop ले पूरै खपत गर्छ। यी दुई नियमकै कारण टेक्निसियनले हरेक बिन्दु नापेर हेर्नु पर्दैन: जोडमा तीन current थाहा भए चौथो आफैँ निश्चित हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A semiconductor conducts better than an insulator but worse than a conductor. Silicon and germanium are the two used. Each has four valence electrons, so a pure crystal has none spare and barely conducts. Doping is deliberately adding a small amount of impurity to a pure semiconductor to increase its conductivity. N-type — add a pentavalent impurity (5 valence electrons: phosphorus, arsenic). Four electrons bond; the fifth is spare and free to move. P-type — add a trivalent impurity (3 valence electrons: boron, gallium). One bond is left unfilled, and that gap is a hole.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Semiconductor ले insulator भन्दा राम्रो तर conductor भन्दा कम बिजुली चलाउँछ। Silicon र germanium दुई प्रयोग हुन्छन्। दुवैमा चार valence electron हुन्छन्, त्यसैले शुद्ध क्रिस्टलमा फाल्तु electron हुँदैन र मुस्किलले चल्छ। Doping भनेको चालकता बढाउन शुद्ध semiconductor मा जानाजान थोरै अशुद्धि मिसाउनु हो। N-type — pentavalent अशुद्धि (५ valence electron: phosphorus, arsenic) मिसाउनुहोस्। चार वटाले बन्धन बनाउँछन्; पाँचौं फाल्तु रहन्छ र चल्न स्वतन्त्र हुन्छ। P-type — trivalent अशुद्धि (३ valence electron: boron, gallium) मिसाउनुहोस्। एउटा बन्धन खाली रहन्छ, र त्यही खाली ठाउँ hole हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Majority and minority carriers Both kinds of carrier exist in both materials. What changes is which one dominates. In N-type: electrons are the majority carrier, holes the minority. In P-type: holes are the majority carrier, electrons the minority. The minority carriers come from heat breaking bonds in the silicon itself, which is why a hot device leaks more current than a cold one.
items.ne: बहुसंख्यक र अल्पसंख्यक वाहक दुवै किसिमका वाहक दुवै पदार्थमा हुन्छन्। फरक यत्ति हो कि कुन हावी हुन्छ। N-type मा: electron बहुसंख्यक, hole अल्पसंख्यक वाहक हो। P-type मा: hole बहुसंख्यक, electron अल्पसंख्यक वाहक हो। अल्पसंख्यक वाहक silicon भित्रै तापले बन्धन टुट्दा बन्छन् — त्यसैले तातो उपकरणले चिसो भन्दा बढी current चुहाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A PN junction is formed when a P-type and an N-type material are joined in a single crystal. It is the basis of the diode. At the join, free electrons from the N side cross and fill holes on the P side. That leaves a thin strip with no free carriers — the depletion region — and exposed ions that create a barrier potential of about 0.7 V in silicon (0.3 V in germanium). Forward bias: P to the positive terminal, N to the negative. The depletion region narrows, and once the supply exceeds the barrier, current flows. Reverse bias: the connections are swapped. Carriers are pulled away from the join, the depletion region widens, and current stops — apart from a tiny leakage current carried by the minority carriers.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् PN junction भनेको एउटै क्रिस्टलमा P-type र N-type पदार्थ जोडिँदा बन्ने जोड हो। Diode यसैमा आधारित छ। जोडमा N तर्फका स्वतन्त्र electron पारि गएर P तर्फका hole भर्छन्। त्यसले स्वतन्त्र वाहक नभएको पातलो पट्टी छोड्छ — depletion region — र खुला ion हरूले silicon मा करिब ०.७ V (germanium मा ०.३ V) को barrier potential बनाउँछन्। Forward bias: P धनात्मक टर्मिनलमा, N ऋणात्मकमा। Depletion region साँघुरो हुन्छ, र सप्लाईले barrier नाघेपछि current बग्छ। Reverse bias: जडान उल्टिन्छ। वाहकहरू जोडबाट टाढा तानिन्छन्, depletion region चौडा हुन्छ, र current रोकिन्छ — अल्पसंख्यक वाहकले बोक्ने अति सानो leakage current बाहेक।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Doping adds a carrier, not a charge. Forward narrows, reverse widens.
items.ne: Doping ले वाहक थप्छ, चार्ज होइन। Forward ले साँघुरो, reverse ले चौडा बनाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Doping is the deliberate addition of a small amount of impurity to a pure semiconductor in order to increase its conductivity. Pentavalent: phosphorus (or arsenic, antimony). Trivalent: boron (or gallium, indium).
items.ne: Doping भनेको चालकता बढाउने उद्देश्यले शुद्ध semiconductor मा जानाजान थोरै अशुद्धि मिसाउनु हो। Pentavalent: phosphorus (वा arsenic, antimony)। Trivalent: boron (वा gallium, indium)।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: KCL: at any junction the total current flowing in equals the total current flowing out. In = 4 + 7 = 11 A. Known out = 5 A. So the remaining branch carries 11 − 5 = 6 A out of the junction.
items.ne: KCL: कुनै पनि जोडमा भित्र आउने कुल current र बाहिर जाने कुल current बराबर हुन्छ। भित्र = ४ + ७ = ११ A। थाहा भएको बाहिर = ५ A। त्यसैले बाँकी शाखाले ११ − ५ = ६ A जोडबाट बाहिर बोक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Define doping. Name one pentavalent and one trivalent impurity.
items.ne: Doping को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। एउटा pentavalent र एउटा trivalent अशुद्धिको नाम लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: State Kirchhoff's Current Law. At a junction 4 A and 7 A flow in, and 5 A flows out on one branch. Find the current in the remaining branch.
items.ne: Kirchhoff's Current Law भन्नुहोस्। एउटा जोडमा ४ A र ७ A भित्र आउँछन्, र एउटा शाखाबाट ५ A बाहिर जान्छ। बाँकी शाखाको current निकाल्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Explain how a depletion region forms at a PN junction, and what happens to it under reverse bias.
items.ne: PN junction मा depletion region कसरी बन्छ, र reverse bias मा त्यसमा के हुन्छ — व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: Reverse bias pulls both kinds of carrier away from the junction, so the region empty of carriers gets wider and the barrier grows. The diode blocks. It never disappears — the depletion region exists even with no supply connected at all.
items.ne: Reverse bias ले दुवै किसिमका वाहकलाई जोडबाट टाढा तान्छ, त्यसैले वाहकविहीन क्षेत्र चौडा हुन्छ र barrier बढ्छ। Diode ले रोक्छ। यो कहिल्यै हराउँदैन — कुनै सप्लाई नजोडे पनि depletion region हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias
items.en: A silicon diode is connected in reverse bias. What happens to the depletion region?
items.ne: एउटा silicon diode reverse bias मा जोडियो। Depletion region मा के हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: 5 A
items.ne: ५ A

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: 3 A
items.ne: ३ A

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: 1 A
items.ne: १ A

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: N-type, with electrons as the majority carrier
items.ne: N-type, electron बहुसंख्यक वाहक भएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: P-type, with holes as the majority carrier
items.ne: P-type, hole बहुसंख्यक वाहक भएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: P-type, which carries a negative charge
items.ne: P-type, जसमा ऋणात्मक चार्ज हुन्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Pure silicon with better conductivity
items.ne: शुद्ध silicon, राम्रो चालकता भएको

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The depletion region narrows and current flows freely
items.ne: Depletion region साँघुरो हुन्छ र current स्वतन्त्र बग्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The depletion region widens and only a small leakage current flows
items.ne: Depletion region चौडा हुन्छ र सानो leakage current मात्र बग्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The depletion region disappears completely
items.ne: Depletion region पूरै हराउँछ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The diode is destroyed immediately
items.ne: Diode तुरुन्तै नष्ट हुन्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which subatomic particle carries a positive charge?
items.ne: कुन उप-आणविक कणले धनात्मक चार्ज बोक्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: At a junction, currents of 6 A and 2 A flow in, and 3 A flows out on one branch. What flows out on the remaining branch?
items.ne: एउटा जोडमा ६ A र २ A भित्र आउँछन्, र एउटा शाखाबाट ३ A बाहिर जान्छ। बाँकी शाखाबाट कति बाहिर जान्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Silicon is doped with a trivalent impurity such as boron. What is produced?
items.ne: Silicon मा boron जस्तो trivalent अशुद्धि मिसाइयो। के बन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A silicon diode is connected in reverse bias. What happens?
items.ne: एउटा silicon diode reverse bias मा जोडियो। के हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Introduction to Electronic Devices
items.ne: इलेक्ट्रोनिक उपकरणको परिचय

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What you will learn: to read a description and decide which material it is, so the "differentiate P-type and N-type" question is answered from recognition rather than from a memorised pair of sentences.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: विवरण पढेर कुन पदार्थ हो छुट्याउन — ताकि "P-type र N-type फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न घोकेको वाक्यबाट होइन, चिनेरै उत्तर दिन सकियोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A comparison is a LOGICAL operation, and every logical and arithmetic operation happens in the ALU. The control unit fetched and decoded the instruction and will act on the result, but it does not do the comparing itself. This is the most confused pair in the unit.
items.ne: तुलना तार्किक काम हो, र हरेक तार्किक तथा अंकगणितीय काम ALU मा हुन्छ। Control unit ले निर्देशन ल्यायो, बुझ्यो र नतिजामा काम गर्नेछ, तर तुलना आफैँ गर्दैन। यस युनिटमा सबैभन्दा बढी मिसिने जोडी यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A scanner measures reflected light and produces a picture. The letters in it are dark pixels, not characters. OCR software must analyse that image before anything becomes editable text — which is why "scan then edit" always has a step in between.
items.ne: Scanner ले परावर्तित बत्ती नाप्छ र तस्बिर बनाउँछ। त्यसका अक्षर कालो पिक्सेल हुन्, अक्षर होइनन्। सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षर बन्नुअघि OCR सफ्टवेयरले त्यो चित्र विश्लेषण गर्नैपर्छ — त्यसैले "स्क्यान गरेर सम्पादन" बीचमा सधैं एउटा चरण हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Flicker is the screen being redrawn too few times per second for the eye to blend the frames, which is exactly what refresh rate measures. Raise it to the highest the monitor supports. Resolution changes sharpness, not flicker; colour depth changes the number of shades.
items.ne: झिमझिम भनेको स्क्रिन सेकेन्डमा यति थोरै पटक कोरिनु कि आँखाले फ्रेम जोड्न नसक्नु — refresh rate ले नाप्ने ठ्याक्कै त्यही हो। Monitor ले सक्ने सबैभन्दा माथि बढाउनुहोस्। Resolution ले तीक्ष्णता बदल्छ, झिमझिम होइन; colour depth ले रङको सङ्ख्या।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: An LED monitor IS an LCD — the same liquid crystals block or pass light. What changed is the light source behind them: LEDs instead of a CCFL lamp, which makes it thinner, gives better contrast and uses less power. Option 3 describes a CRT.
items.ne: LED monitor भनेकै LCD हो — उही liquid crystal ले बत्ती छेक्छ वा पास गर्छ। फरक तिनको पछाडिको बत्तीको स्रोतमा हो: CCFL लैम्पको साटो LED, जसले पातलो बनाउँछ, राम्रो contrast दिन्छ र कम बिजुली खान्छ। तेस्रो विकल्पले CRT वर्णन गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying the control unit performs calculations. It fetches, decodes and directs. Every calculation and comparison is the ALU's.
items.ne: Control unit ले गणना गर्छ भन्नु। यसले ल्याउँछ, बुझ्छ र निर्देशन दिन्छ। हरेक गणना र तुलना ALU को हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which display property is being described?
items.ne: कुन display गुणको कुरा हो?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: These three are never asked as bare definitions in a practical paper — they arrive as a user complaint or a setting. Decide which property each one is about.
items.ne: व्यावहारिक प्रश्नपत्रमा यी तीन कुरा खाली परिभाषाका रूपमा सोधिँदैनन् — प्रयोगकर्ताको गुनासो वा सेटिङ बनेर आउँछन्। हरेक कुन गुणसँग सम्बन्धित हो छान्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Two numbers multiplied like this are always pixels across by pixels down. That is resolution, and nothing else on a display is written in that form.
items.ne: यसरी लेखिएका दुई सङ्ख्या सधैं चौडाइका पिक्सेल × उचाइका पिक्सेल हुन्। त्यो resolution हो, र display को अरू कुनै गुण यसरी लेखिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Flicker is the screen being redrawn too few times a second for the eye to blend the frames. Raise the refresh rate to the highest the monitor supports and the flicker goes.
items.ne: झिमझिम भनेको स्क्रिन सेकेन्डमा यति थोरै पटक कोरिनु कि आँखाले फ्रेम जोड्नै नसक्नु। Monitor ले सक्ने सबैभन्दा माथिको refresh rate राखेपछि झिमझिम हट्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Bits per pixel is colour depth. More bits means more distinguishable shades, which is why a low setting shows visible bands in a smooth gradient instead of a gradual change.
items.ne: प्रति पिक्सेल bit भनेको colour depth हो। बढी bit भनेको बढी छुट्याउन सकिने रङ — त्यसैले कम सेटिङमा बिस्तारै बदलिनुको साटो पट्टी–पट्टी देखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A flat panel has one native resolution and looks sharp only at that. Set to anything else, the picture is scaled to fit and goes soft — stretched sideways means the aspect ratio is wrong too.
items.ne: Flat panel को एउटै native resolution हुन्छ र त्यहीँ मात्र तीक्ष्ण देखिन्छ। अरू राखे तस्बिर अटाउन तानिन्छ र धमिलो हुन्छ — छेउतिर तानिनुले aspect ratio पनि बिग्रेको जनाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: LED is not a different kind of screen from LCD — it is an LCD with a different backlight. Saying so earns the mark that "LED is newer" does not.
items.ne: LED, LCD भन्दा फरक किसिमको स्क्रिन होइन — फरक backlight भएको LCD हो। यही भन्दा अंक मिल्छ; "LED नयाँ हो" भन्दा मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Compare CRT, LCD and LED monitors on how they make light, size and power use.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: कम्प्युटर प्रणालीका आधारभूत एकाइ नाम लिन र हरेकको काम भन्न, सामान्य input उपकरण सूचीबद्ध गर्न र हरेकले कसरी data भित्र ल्याउँछ बताउन, ALU र control unit नसाटी ठ्याक्कै के गर्छन् भन्न, resolution–colour depth–refresh rate को परिभाषा दिन र स्क्रिनमा के फरक पार्छन् भन्न, र CRT–LCD–LED लाई बत्ती बनाउने तरिका, आकार र बिजुली खपतमा तुलना गर्न सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 2.3 The processing unit — ALU and control unit
items.en: Before you read on, decide one thing: which unit performs the comparison?
items.ne: पढ्नुअघि एउटा कुरा निर्णय गर्नुहोस्: तुलना कुन एकाइले गर्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 2.3 The processing unit — ALU and control unit
items.en: Notice the control unit appears twice and never calculates. That is the distinction the exam is testing.
items.ne: ध्यान दिनुहोस्, control unit दुई पटक आउँछ र कहिल्यै गणना गर्दैन। परीक्षाले जाँच्ने भिन्नता यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: You have every number you need. Work out the two steps before reading on.
items.ne: चाहिने सबै सङ्ख्या तपाईंसँग छन्। पढ्नुअघि दुई चरण आफैँ निकाल्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Now see why refresh rate matters to the hardware: at 60 Hz the graphics card must deliver that 3 MB sixty times every second. Resolution, colour depth and refresh rate are not three unrelated settings — they multiply together into the work the card has to do.
items.ne: अब refresh rate हार्डवेयरका लागि किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ हेर्नुहोस्: ६० Hz मा ग्राफिक्स कार्डले त्यही ३ MB सेकेन्डमा साठी पटक पुर्‍याउनुपर्छ। Resolution, colour depth र refresh rate तीन असम्बन्धित सेटिङ होइनन् — यी गुणन भएर कार्डले गर्नुपर्ने काम बन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Calling a scanner an output device because it produces a file. Direction is judged by where the data is going: into the computer is input.
items.ne: फाइल बन्छ भन्दैमा scanner लाई output भन्नु। दिशा data कता जान्छ भन्नेले तय हुन्छ: कम्प्युटरभित्र जान्छ भने input हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Confusing resolution with screen size. A large monitor can have a low resolution and look worse than a small one with a high resolution.
items.ne: Resolution र स्क्रिनको आकार मिसाउनु। ठूलो monitor को resolution कम भए त्यो उच्च resolution भएको सानो भन्दा नराम्रो देखिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Writing that LED is a completely different technology from LCD. It is an LCD with an LED backlight — the crystals are the same.
items.ne: LED लाई LCD भन्दा पूरै फरक प्रविधि लेख्नु। यो LED backlight भएको LCD हो — crystal उही हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This unit is the vocabulary the rest of the subject is written in, and it carries 8 marks. Expect list questions (name four input devices), differentiate questions (ALU vs control unit, CRT vs LCD vs LED, input vs output device) and define questions (resolution, colour depth, refresh rate). The block diagram of a computer system with its units labelled is the one diagram from this unit you may be asked to draw — and the arrows between the blocks are worth marks, not just the boxes.
items.ne: यो युनिट बाँकी विषय लेखिने शब्दावली हो, र यसले ८ अंक बोक्छ। सूची प्रश्न (चार input उपकरणको नाम), फरक छुट्याउने प्रश्न (ALU र control unit, CRT–LCD–LED, input र output) र परिभाषा प्रश्न (resolution, colour depth, refresh rate) आउँछन्। यस युनिटबाट कोर्न सकिने चित्र एकाइ नामांकित कम्प्युटर प्रणालीको ब्लक डायग्राम हो — र बाकसबीचका तीर पनि अंक बोक्छन्, बाकस मात्र होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: The ALU performs all arithmetic operations (+ − × ÷) and all logical operations (comparisons, AND, OR, NOT) — for example, evaluating whether marks > 40. The control unit does not calculate at all; it fetches each instruction from memory, decodes it, and generates the signals that tell the other units what to do and when — for example, directing the machine to the next instruction once the ALU reports its result.
items.ne: ALU ले सबै अंकगणितीय (+ − × ÷) र सबै तार्किक (तुलना, AND, OR, NOT) काम गर्छ — जस्तै, marks > 40 हो कि होइन जाँच्ने। Control unit ले गणना गर्दैनँ; यसले मेमोरीबाट हरेक निर्देशन ल्याउँछ, बुझ्छ, र अरू एकाइलाई कहिले के गर्ने भन्ने सङ्केत बनाउँछ — जस्तै, ALU ले नतिजा दिएपछि मेसिनलाई अर्को निर्देशनतिर लैजाने।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Resolution is the number of pixels displayed across the screen by the number down, for example 1366 × 768; a higher resolution gives a sharper, more detailed picture. Refresh rate is the number of times per second the screen image is redrawn, measured in hertz. When it is too low the user sees visible flicker, which causes eye strain and headaches.
items.ne: Resolution भनेको स्क्रिनको चौडाइमा देखिने पिक्सेल × उचाइमा देखिने पिक्सेल, जस्तै १३६६ × ७६८; बढी resolution ले तीक्ष्ण र बढी विवरणसहितको तस्बिर दिन्छ। Refresh rate भनेको स्क्रिनको तस्बिर सेकेन्डमा कति पटक फेरि कोरिन्छ, hertz मा नापिने। धेरै कम हुँदा प्रयोगकर्ताले झिमझिम देख्छ, जसले आँखा थकाइ र टाउको दुखाइ ल्याउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: ALU does arithmetic and logic. The control unit fetches, decodes and directs — and calculates nothing.
items.ne: ALU ले अंकगणित र तर्क गर्छ। Control unit ले ल्याउँछ, बुझ्छ र निर्देशन दिन्छ — गणना गर्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Input devices: keyboard, mouse, scanner, digital camera. A scanner gives an image; OCR turns it into text.
items.ne: Input उपकरण: keyboard, mouse, scanner, digital camera। Scanner ले चित्र दिन्छ; OCR ले अक्षरमा बदल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Resolution = pixels across × down. Colour depth = bits per pixel. Refresh rate = redraws per second in Hz.
items.ne: Resolution = चौडाइ × उचाइका पिक्सेल। Colour depth = प्रति पिक्सेल bit। Refresh rate = सेकेन्डमा फेरि कोरिने पटक, Hz मा।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: CRT is bulky and uses most power; LCD is flat and cooler; LED is an LCD with an LED backlight — thinnest and least power.
items.ne: CRT ठूलो र सबैभन्दा बढी बिजुली खान्छ; LCD पातलो र चिसो; LED भनेको LED backlight भएको LCD — सबैभन्दा पातलो र कम बिजुली।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 2.1 The basic units of a computer system
items.en: Why this matters: "differentiate between the ALU and the control unit" is asked almost every year, and the marks are lost by students who know both words but attach the wrong job to each. Seeing them side by side in the flow fixes which is which.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: "ALU र control unit फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्" झन्डै हरेक वर्ष सोधिन्छ, र अंक ती विद्यार्थीले गुमाउँछन् जसलाई दुवै शब्द थाहा हुन्छ तर काम उल्टो जोडिन्छ। प्रवाहमा सँगै देखेपछि कुन कुन हो पक्का हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Why this matters: a user complaint is never "my refresh rate is low" — it is "the screen flickers and my eyes hurt". Translating the complaint into the property is the actual skill.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: प्रयोगकर्ताले "मेरो refresh rate कम छ" कहिल्यै भन्दैन — "स्क्रिन झिमझिम गर्छ र आँखा दुख्छ" भन्छ। गुनासोलाई गुणमा बदल्नु नै वास्तविक सीप हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Five units: input, control, ALU, memory, output. The middle three are the CPU.
items.ne: पाँच एकाइ: input, control, ALU, memory, output। बीचका तीन मिलेर CPU।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 2.1 The basic units of a computer system
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Every computer, from a phone to a server, is built from the same five functional units: input, control, arithmetic and logic, memory and output. The middle three together are the CPU (Central Processing Unit). That grouping is what a question means when it says "the components of the CPU". The order matters and it is always the same: data comes in, is held in memory, is worked on by the ALU under the direction of the control unit, and the result goes out.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् फोनदेखि सर्भरसम्म हरेक कम्प्युटर उही पाँच कार्यात्मक एकाइबाट बनेको हुन्छ: input, control, arithmetic and logic, memory र output। बीचका तीन मिलेर CPU (Central Processing Unit) बन्छ। "CPU का भागहरू" भनेर सोधिँदा यही समूह खोजिएको हुन्छ। क्रम महत्त्वपूर्ण छ र सधैं उही हुन्छ: data भित्र आउँछ, मेमोरीमा राखिन्छ, control unit को निर्देशनमा ALU ले काम गर्छ, र नतिजा बाहिर जान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The input unit accepts data and instructions from the outside world and converts them into the binary form the computer can process. Keyboard — each key press closes a switch; the keyboard controller turns that into a scan code, which becomes a character. Mouse — a pointing device. An optical mouse photographs the surface many times a second and works out which way it moved. Scanner — shines light across a document and measures the reflection, producing an image of the page. OCR software is what turns that image into editable text. Digital camera — a lens focuses light onto an image sensor, which converts the brightness at each point into a number and stores it in memory.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Input unit ले बाहिरी संसारबाट data र निर्देशन लिन्छ र कम्प्युटरले प्रशोधन गर्न सक्ने binary रूपमा बदल्छ। Keyboard — हरेक किथिचाइले एउटा स्विच बन्द गर्छ; keyboard controller ले त्यसलाई scan code बनाउँछ, जुन अक्षर बन्छ। Mouse — देखाउने उपकरण। Optical mouse ले सेकेन्डमा धेरै पटक सतहको फोटो खिच्छ र कता सर्‍यो पत्ता लगाउँछ। Scanner — कागजमा बत्ती पार गरेर परावर्तन नाप्छ, र पानाको चित्र बनाउँछ। त्यो चित्रलाई सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षरमा बदल्ने काम OCR सफ्टवेयरको हो। Digital camera — लेन्सले बत्ती image sensor मा केन्द्रित गर्छ, जसले हरेक बिन्दुको उज्यालोलाई सङ्ख्यामा बदलेर मेमोरीमा राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 2.3 The processing unit — ALU and control unit
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The ALU (Arithmetic and Logic Unit) performs all arithmetic operations (+ − × ÷) and all logical operations (greater than, less than, equal to, AND, OR, NOT). Every calculation and every comparison in the machine happens here and nowhere else. The control unit (CU) directs the whole system. It fetches each instruction from memory, decodes it to work out what is required, and sends the signals that tell each unit what to do and when. It does not calculate anything itself. A useful picture: the ALU is the worker, the control unit is the supervisor. The supervisor decides what gets done next; the worker does it.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ALU (Arithmetic and Logic Unit) ले सबै अंकगणितीय काम (+ − × ÷) र सबै तार्किक काम (ठूलो, सानो, बराबर, AND, OR, NOT) गर्छ। मेसिनको हरेक गणना र हरेक तुलना यहीँ हुन्छ, अन्त कतै हुँदैन। Control unit (CU) ले पूरै प्रणाली निर्देशित गर्छ। मेमोरीबाट हरेक निर्देशन ल्याउँछ, के चाहिएको हो बुझ्छ, र कुन एकाइले कहिले के गर्ने भन्ने सङ्केत पठाउँछ। यसले आफैँ केही गणना गर्दैन। सम्झने तरिका: ALU कामदार हो, control unit सुपरभाइजर। सुपरभाइजरले अब के गर्ने भन्छ; कामदारले गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Resolution is the number of pixels across by the number down — 1366 × 768. More pixels means a sharper picture and more detail in the same area. Colour depth is the number of bits used to describe one pixel's colour. 24-bit gives about 16.7 million colours; fewer bits produce visible banding in a gradient. Refresh rate is how many times per second the screen is redrawn, measured in hertz. 60 Hz means sixty times a second. Too low a rate is visible as flicker and causes eye strain. CRT fires an electron beam at a phosphor coating — bulky, heavy, hot, most power. LCD uses liquid crystals to block or pass light from a lamp behind them — flat and far cooler. LED is an LCD whose backlight is made of LEDs instead — thinner still, better contrast, least power.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Resolution भनेको चौडाइका पिक्सेल × उचाइका पिक्सेल — १३६६ × ७६८। बढी पिक्सेल भनेको उही ठाउँमा तीक्ष्ण तस्बिर र बढी विवरण। Colour depth भनेको एउटा पिक्सेलको रङ बताउन प्रयोग हुने bit सङ्ख्या। २४-bit ले करिब १ करोड ६७ लाख रङ दिन्छ; कम bit भए रङ बदलिँदा पट्टीहरू देखिन्छन्। Refresh rate भनेको स्क्रिन सेकेन्डमा कति पटक फेरि कोरिन्छ — hertz मा नापिन्छ। ६० Hz भनेको सेकेन्डमा साठी पटक। धेरै कम भए झिमझिम देखिन्छ र आँखा दुख्छ। CRT ले phosphor मा electron किरण हान्छ — ठूलो, गह्रौं, तातो, सबैभन्दा बढी बिजुली। LCD ले पछाडिको बत्तीलाई liquid crystal ले छेक्ने वा पास गर्ने गर्छ — पातलो र धेरै चिसो। LED भनेको त्यही LCD हो, तर पछाडिको बत्ती LED को — झन् पातलो, राम्रो contrast, सबैभन्दा कम बिजुली।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: CU directs, ALU calculates. LED is an LCD with a new lamp.
items.ne: CU ले निर्देशन दिन्छ, ALU ले गणना गर्छ। LED भनेको नयाँ बत्ती भएको LCD हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Keyboard — characters and commands typed by the user. Mouse — position and selection. Scanner — an image of a printed document. Digital camera — photographs as image data. (Also acceptable: microphone for sound, joystick for movement, barcode reader for product codes.)
items.ne: Keyboard — प्रयोगकर्ताले टाइप गरेका अक्षर र आदेश। Mouse — स्थान र छनोट। Scanner — छापिएको कागजको चित्र। Digital camera — तस्बिर, image data का रूपमा। (माइक्रोफोन–आवाज, joystick–चाल, barcode reader–उत्पादन कोड पनि मान्य।)

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Differentiate between the ALU and the control unit, with one example of the work each does.
items.ne: ALU र control unit बीचको फरक छुट्याउनुहोस्, र हरेकले गर्ने कामको एउटा उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Define resolution and refresh rate. State one problem a user notices when the refresh rate is too low.
items.ne: Resolution र refresh rate को परिभाषा दिनुहोस्। Refresh rate धेरै कम हुँदा प्रयोगकर्ताले देख्ने एउटा समस्या लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Name any four input devices and state what kind of data each one brings in.
items.ne: कुनै चार input उपकरणको नाम लेख्नुहोस् र हरेकले कस्तो data भित्र ल्याउँछ भन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A scanner is a light sensor, not a reader. What it produces is a picture of the page — the letters in it are just dark pixels. OCR (Optical Character Recognition) software has to examine that picture and work out which shapes are which characters before anything becomes editable text.
items.ne: Scanner बत्ती नाप्ने सेन्सर हो, पढ्ने यन्त्र होइन। यसले पानाको तस्बिर दिन्छ — त्यसका अक्षर केवल कालो पिक्सेल हुन्। OCR (Optical Character Recognition) सफ्टवेयरले त्यो तस्बिर हेरेर कुन आकार कुन अक्षर हो पत्ता लगाएपछि मात्र सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षर बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: You scan a printed page. Straight afterwards, can you edit the words in a word processor?
items.ne: तपाईंले छापिएको पाना स्क्यान गर्नुभयो। लगत्तै word processor मा शब्दहरू सम्पादन गर्न सकिन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Editable text
items.ne: सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षर

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: An image of the page
items.ne: पानाको चित्र

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A printed copy
items.ne: छापिएको प्रतिलिपि

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A compressed archive
items.ne: Compress गरिएको archive

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Brightness only
items.ne: Brightness मात्र

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: LED uses no liquid crystals at all
items.ne: LED मा liquid crystal हुँदै हुँदैन

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: They differ only in the backlight used
items.ne: फरक केवल प्रयोग गरिने backlight मा हो

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: LED fires electrons at a phosphor screen
items.ne: LED ले phosphor स्क्रिनमा electron हान्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: LCD is thinner and uses less power
items.ne: LCD पातलो हुन्छ र कम बिजुली खान्छ

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Which unit performs the comparison in the instruction "IF marks > 40"?
items.ne: "IF marks > 40" निर्देशनमा तुलना कुन एकाइले गर्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: You scan a printed page. What do you have immediately afterwards?
items.ne: तपाईंले छापिएको पाना स्क्यान गर्नुभयो। लगत्तै तपाईंसँग के हुन्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A user says the screen flickers and their eyes hurt after an hour. Which setting should you change?
items.ne: प्रयोगकर्ताले स्क्रिन झिमझिम गर्छ र एक घण्टापछि आँखा दुख्छ भन्छ। कुन सेटिङ बदल्नुपर्छ?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What is the essential difference between an LCD and an LED monitor?
items.ne: LCD र LED monitor बीचको मुख्य फरक के हो?

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Introduction to Computer System
items.ne: कम्प्युटर प्रणालीको परिचय

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 2.1 The basic units of a computer system
items.en: What you will learn: where each unit sits in the flow and exactly what it is responsible for — so that when a question asks which unit does the comparing, you can see the answer rather than recall a sentence.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: प्रवाहमा हरेक एकाइ कहाँ पर्छ र ठ्याक्कै कसको के जिम्मेवारी हो — ताकि तुलना कसले गर्छ भन्ने प्रश्न आउँदा वाक्य सम्झनुभन्दा उत्तर देख्न सकियोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: What you will learn: to match a symptom or a description to resolution, colour depth or refresh rate — which is how these three are actually asked about, rather than as bare definitions.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: कुनै लक्षण वा विवरणलाई resolution, colour depth वा refresh rate सँग मिलाउन — किनकि यी तीन कुरा खाली परिभाषाका रूपमा होइन, यसरी नै सोधिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The BIOS is firmware on a motherboard chip. It has to run before any disk is read — it is what finds and loads the operating system — so it cannot be stored on the disk. RAM is wrong because RAM is empty at power-on.
items.ne: BIOS मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो। कुनै disk पढिनुअघि नै यो चल्नुपर्छ — अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर लोड गर्ने यही हो — त्यसैले disk मा हुनै सक्दैन। RAM गलत हो किनकि बिजुली लाग्दा RAM खाली हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: CMOS memory holds the BIOS settings and runs the clock, and it needs power even when the machine is unplugged. That power comes from a coin battery on the board. When it dies, everything CMOS remembers is lost each time mains power goes — which is exactly this symptom.
items.ne: CMOS मेमोरीले BIOS सेटिङ राख्छ र घडी चलाउँछ, र मेसिन अनप्लग हुँदा पनि यसलाई बिजुली चाहिन्छ। त्यो बोर्डको सिक्का ब्याट्रीबाट आउँछ। त्यो सकिएपछि मुख्य बिजुली जाँदा CMOS ले सम्झेको सबै हराउँछ — लक्षण ठ्याक्कै यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A sector is one slice of a track and is the smallest addressable unit. A track is a whole concentric ring, a cylinder is the same track across all platters, and a platter is the entire disk — all three are larger than a sector.
items.ne: Sector भनेको track को एउटा टुक्रा हो र ठेगाना दिन मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ हो। Track पूरै केन्द्रित रिङ हो, cylinder सबै platter का उही track, र platter पूरै डिस्क — तीनै sector भन्दा ठूला छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Seek time is the arm moving to the correct track, rotational delay is waiting for the sector to come round under the head, and transfer time is reading or writing the data. The first two are mechanical, which is why they dominate and why a solid-state drive is so much faster.
items.ne: Seek time भनेको arm ठीक track मा जाने, rotational delay भनेको sector head मुनि आइपुग्न पर्खने, र transfer time भनेको data पढ्ने वा लेख्ने। पहिलो दुई यान्त्रिक हुन् — त्यसैले तिनकै बढी समय लाग्छ, र solid-state drive यति छिटो हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: A quick format rewrites the file system index only, so the drive reports itself as empty while the sectors still hold the data. Recovery software scans sectors directly instead of trusting the index. To remove data properly you need a full format or a wipe utility that overwrites every sector.
items.ne: Quick format ले file system को सूची मात्र फेरि लेख्छ, त्यसैले ड्राइभ खाली देखिन्छ तर sector मा data रहन्छ। Recovery सफ्टवेयरले सूचीमा भर नपरी sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। Data ठीकसँग हटाउन full format वा हरेक sector ओभरराइट गर्ने wipe utility चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: An extended partition exists to get round the limit on primary partitions: it holds logical drives, and those get the letters. The extended partition itself has none, and you boot from a primary partition, not from it.
items.ne: Primary partition को सीमा नाघ्न extended partition बनाइन्छ: यसले logical drive राख्छ, र अक्षर तिनैले पाउँछन्। Extended partition आफैँले पाउँदैन, र boot primary partition बाट हुन्छ, यसबाट होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying the BIOS is stored on the hard disk. It is firmware on a chip on the motherboard — it has to run before any disk is read.
items.ne: BIOS hard disk मा हुन्छ भन्नु। यो मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो — कुनै disk पढिनुअघि नै यो चल्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Step through one read. "Explain the operation of a hard disk" is answered by this sequence, and the three parts of access time are usually worth a mark each.
items.ne: एउटा पढाइ चरणबद्ध हेर्नुहोस्। "Hard disk को सञ्चालन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्नको उत्तर यही क्रम हो, र access time का तीन भागको प्रायः एक–एक अंक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: One disk, several drives. The extended partition is the box, not one of the drives inside it — a distinction that is regularly worth a mark.
items.ne: एउटै डिस्क, धेरै ड्राइभ। Extended partition भाँडो हो, त्यसभित्रको कुनै ड्राइभ होइन — यही भिन्नताको प्रायः अंक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Explain partitioning and drive lettering, and distinguish quick from full formatting.
items.ne: यो युनिट सकिँदा: BIOS के हो र POST सहित यसका मुख्य काम भन्न, मदरबोर्डका प्रमुख भाग चिन्न र हरेकले के जोड्छ भन्न, form factor के हो र बोर्ड साट्दा किन महत्त्वपूर्ण हुन्छ बताउन, PCI local bus र expansion slot को काम वर्णन गर्न, आन्तरिक पावर सप्लाईका भाग र यसले दिने भोल्टेज नाम लिन, hard disk को बनावट वर्णन गर्न र एउटा ब्लक कसरी पढिन्छ व्याख्या गर्न, र partitioning–drive lettering बुझाउन तथा quick र full formatting छुट्याउन सक्नुहुनेछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: The CMOS memory that holds the settings and runs the clock needs power even when the machine is unplugged, and that comes from a small coin battery on the board. When it dies, everything CMOS remembers is lost each time mains power goes. It is a cheap part and a two-minute fix — but only if you read the symptom correctly instead of suspecting the disk.
items.ne: सेटिङ राख्ने र घडी चलाउने CMOS मेमोरीलाई मेसिन अनप्लग हुँदा पनि बिजुली चाहिन्छ, र त्यो बोर्डको सानो सिक्का ब्याट्रीबाट आउँछ। त्यो सकिएपछि मुख्य बिजुली जाँदा CMOS ले सम्झेको सबै हराउँछ। सस्तो पार्ट र दुई मिनेटको काम हो — तर लक्षण ठीक पढेमा मात्र, disk मा शंका गरेर होइन।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: This is the practical reason the two format types are in the syllabus at all — the difference has consequences for privacy, not just for time taken.
items.ne: पाठ्यक्रममा दुई किसिमको format राखिनुको व्यावहारिक कारण यही हो — फरकले समय मात्र होइन, गोपनीयतामा पनि असर पार्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Step 2 is where marks are lost. A cylinder is not one track — it is the same track number on every surface, so you must multiply by the number of surfaces. Miss that and your answer is four times too small.
items.ne: अंक चरण २ मै गुम्छ। Cylinder एउटा track होइन — हरेक सतहको उही नम्बरको track हो, त्यसैले सतह सङ्ख्याले गुणन गर्नैपर्छ। यो छुटे उत्तर चार गुणा सानो आउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Saying a quick format erases the data. It clears the index. The data stays on the platters until something overwrites it.
items.ne: Quick format ले data मेटाउँछ भन्नु। यसले सूची मात्र सफा गर्छ। कुनै कुराले नओभरराइट गरेसम्म data platter मै रहन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Treating a partition as a physical disk. C: and D: are very often two areas of one drive — if that drive fails, both go together.
items.ne: Partition लाई भौतिक डिस्क ठान्नु। C: र D: प्रायः एउटै ड्राइभका दुई क्षेत्र हुन् — ड्राइभ बिग्रिए दुवै सँगै जान्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Giving the extended partition a drive letter. It is a container. The logical drives inside it get the letters.
items.ne: Extended partition लाई ड्राइभ अक्षर दिनु। त्यो भाँडो हो। अक्षर त्यसभित्रका logical drive ले पाउँछन्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: This is the heaviest unit for definitions — 12 hours and 9 marks — and it is where the practical exam gets its component questions. Expect list the functions of the BIOS (POST is always one of them), explain the construction and operation of a hard disk (track, sector, cylinder, head, and the three parts of access time), and differentiate questions on primary vs extended partition and quick vs full format. Be ready to label a motherboard diagram and to name the parts of an SMPS with its output voltages.
items.ne: परिभाषाका हिसाबले सबैभन्दा भारी युनिट यही हो — १२ घण्टा, ९ अंक — र व्यावहारिक परीक्षाका पार्ट्ससम्बन्धी प्रश्न यहीँबाट आउँछन्। BIOS का काम सूचीबद्ध गर्नुहोस् (POST सधैं एक हो), hard disk को बनावट र सञ्चालन व्याख्या गर्नुहोस् (track, sector, cylinder, head, र access time का तीन भाग), र primary–extended partition तथा quick–full format को फरक सोधिन्छ। मदरबोर्ड चित्रमा नाम लेख्न र SMPS का भाग तथा आउटपुट भोल्टेज भन्न तयार रहनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: BIOS (Basic Input Output System) is firmware held on a chip on the motherboard, and it is the first program to run when the computer is switched on. Its main functions are: POST (Power-On Self Test), which checks the essential hardware and reports failures by beep codes; the bootstrap loader, which locates the operating system and loads it into memory; BIOS drivers, which give low-level control of basic hardware before the operating system's own drivers are available; and CMOS setup, which lets the user view and change hardware settings such as boot order and system time.
items.ne: BIOS (Basic Input Output System) मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो, र कम्प्युटर खोल्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्ने प्रोग्राम यही हो। यसका मुख्य काम: POST (Power-On Self Test), जसले आवश्यक हार्डवेयर जाँच्छ र बिग्रिएमा बीप कोडले सुनाउँछ; bootstrap loader, जसले अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर मेमोरीमा लोड गर्छ; BIOS drivers, जसले OS का आफ्नै driver उपलब्ध हुनुअघि आधारभूत हार्डवेयरको तल्लो तहको नियन्त्रण दिन्छ; र CMOS setup, जसबाट boot order र समयजस्ता सेटिङ हेर्न र बदल्न मिल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A track is one concentric ring on the surface of a platter. A sector is one slice of a track and is the smallest unit that can be read or written. A cylinder is the set of tracks of the same number on all the platters taken together. Access time = seek time (moving the head to the correct track) + rotational delay (waiting for the sector to come round) + transfer time (reading or writing the data).
items.ne: Track भनेको platter को सतहमा भएको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ हो। Sector भनेको track को एउटा टुक्रा र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ हो। Cylinder भनेको सबै platter का उही नम्बरका track सँगै लिँदा बन्ने समूह हो। Access time = seek time (head लाई ठीक track मा लाने) + rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न पर्खने) + transfer time (data पढ्ने वा लेख्ने)।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A quick format only rewrites the file system index, so the partition reports itself as empty while the data physically remains on the disk until overwritten; it takes a few seconds. A full format also scans every sector for defects and marks any bad ones so they are not used, which takes much longer but gives a genuine check of the disk's condition.
items.ne: Quick format ले file system को सूची मात्र फेरि लेख्छ, त्यसैले partition खाली देखिन्छ तर data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा डिस्कमै रहन्छ; केही सेकेन्ड लाग्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ र बिग्रिएका sector चिन्ह लगाएर प्रयोग नगर्ने बनाउँछ — समय धेरै लाग्छ तर डिस्कको अवस्थाको साँचो जाँच हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: A form factor fixes a board's size, mounting holes and port positions — ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX.
items.ne: Form factor ले बोर्डको आकार, स्क्रु प्वाल र पोर्टको स्थान तय गर्छ — ATX, Micro-ATX, Mini-ITX।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: PCI is a local bus with expansion slots for add-on cards, and it is plug and play.
items.ne: PCI एउटा local bus हो, जसका expansion slot मा थप कार्ड राखिन्छ, र यो plug and play हो।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: An SMPS has a transformer, rectifier, filter, regulator and fan, and outputs +12 V, +5 V and +3.3 V.
items.ne: SMPS मा transformer, rectifier, filter, regulator र पंखा हुन्छन्, र +१२ V, +५ V तथा +३.३ V दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Access time = seek time + rotational delay + transfer time.
items.ne: Access time = seek time + rotational delay + transfer time।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: Primary partitions boot; an extended partition holds logical drives and gets no letter itself. Quick format clears the index; full format also checks every sector.
items.ne: Primary partition बाट boot हुन्छ; extended partition ले logical drive राख्छ र आफैँ अक्षर पाउँदैन। Quick format ले सूची सफा गर्छ; full format ले हरेक sector पनि जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 3.2 The motherboard and its form factors
items.en: Why this matters: the practical exam can put a board in front of you and ask you to point at a component. Reading its name in a list is not the same skill as recognising it on a board — and the fault note attached to each part is what Unit 4 will ask you to reason with.
items.ne: किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: व्यावहारिक परीक्षामा तपाईंअघि बोर्ड राखेर कुनै भाग देखाउन भन्न सकिन्छ। सूचीमा नाम पढ्नु र बोर्डमा चिन्नु एउटै सीप होइन — र हरेक भागसँग जोडिएको खराबीकै आधारमा युनिट ४ ले तर्क गर्न लगाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: Exam focus — what is asked from this unit
items.en: BIOS is firmware on a motherboard chip. Its functions: POST, bootstrap loader, BIOS drivers, CMOS setup.
items.ne: BIOS मदरबोर्डको चिपमा रहेको firmware हो। काम: POST, bootstrap loader, BIOS drivers, CMOS setup।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording BIOS (Basic Input Output System) is firmware stored on a chip on the motherboard. It is the first program that runs when the machine is switched on — before any operating system exists in memory. Its four functions: 1. POST (Power-On Self Test) — checks that the essential hardware is present and working. If something fails, it reports with beep codes, because the screen may not be available yet. 2. Bootstrap loader — finds the operating system on a drive and loads it into memory. 3. BIOS drivers — low-level control of the basic hardware so the machine can work before the OS drivers load. 4. CMOS setup — the screen where boot order, time and hardware settings are changed. Those settings are kept in CMOS memory, powered by a small battery.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् BIOS (Basic Input Output System) मदरबोर्डको चिपमा राखिएको firmware हो। मेसिन खोल्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्ने प्रोग्राम यही हो — मेमोरीमा कुनै अपरेटिङ सिस्टम आउनुअघि नै। यसका चार काम: १. POST (Power-On Self Test) — आवश्यक हार्डवेयर छ र चलिरहेको छ कि जाँच्छ। केही बिग्रिए बीप कोड ले सुनाउँछ, किनकि स्क्रिन अझै उपलब्ध नहुन सक्छ। २. Bootstrap loader — ड्राइभमा अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर मेमोरीमा लोड गर्छ। ३. BIOS drivers — आधारभूत हार्डवेयरको तल्लो तहको नियन्त्रण, ताकि OS का driver लोड हुनुअघि पनि मेसिन चल्न सकोस्। ४. CMOS setup — boot order, समय र हार्डवेयर सेटिङ बदल्ने स्क्रिन। ती सेटिङ CMOS मेमोरीमा रहन्छन्, जसलाई सानो ब्याट्रीले चलाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.topic: 3.2 The motherboard and its form factors
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The motherboard is the main printed circuit board. Every other component either plugs into it or connects to it, and it carries the buses that let them communicate. A form factor is the standard that fixes a board's size, its mounting-hole positions, and where its ports and power connector sit. ATX is the common desktop standard; Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX are smaller versions with fewer slots. The form factor is why a replacement board is not simply "any board" — it must match the case it has to screw into and the power supply that has to feed it.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Motherboard मुख्य printed circuit board हो। अरू हरेक भाग या त यसमा जोडिन्छ या यससँग जडान हुन्छ, र तिनलाई कुरा गर्न दिने bus यसैले बोक्छ। Form factor भनेको बोर्डको आकार, स्क्रु प्वालको स्थान, र पोर्ट तथा power connector कहाँ पर्ने भन्ने तय गर्ने मानक हो। ATX सामान्य डेस्कटप मानक हो; Micro-ATX र Mini-ITX कम slot भएका साना संस्करण हुन्। Form factor कै कारण साट्ने बोर्ड "जुनसुकै बोर्ड" हुँदैन — यो अटाउने केस र बिजुली दिने पावर सप्लाई दुवैसँग मिल्नुपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A bus is a set of parallel wires that carries data, addresses and control signals between components. PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) is a local bus — "local" meaning it runs close to the processor and at high speed, rather than out on a slow peripheral path. Its expansion slots take add-on cards: graphics, sound, network, additional ports. This is what makes a desktop upgradable — a capability the board does not have can be added as a card instead of replacing the whole machine. PCI cards are also plug and play: the system detects the card and allocates the resources it needs, instead of the user setting jumpers by hand.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Bus भनेको भागहरूबीच data, ठेगाना र नियन्त्रण सङ्केत बोक्ने समानान्तर तारहरूको समूह हो। PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) एउटा local bus हो — "local" भनेको यो ढिलो peripheral बाटोमा नभई प्रोसेसरको नजिक, उच्च गतिमा चल्छ। यसका expansion slot ले थप कार्ड लिन्छन्: graphics, sound, network, थप पोर्ट। डेस्कटप अपग्रेड गर्न मिल्ने यसैले हुन्छ — बोर्डमा नभएको क्षमता पूरै मेसिन साट्नुको साटो कार्ड थपेर ल्याउन सकिन्छ। PCI कार्ड plug and play पनि हुन्छन्: प्रयोगकर्ताले हातले jumper मिलाउनुपर्दैन, प्रणालीले कार्ड पत्ता लगाएर चाहिने साधन बाँडिदिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording The SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) converts the AC mains supply into the low DC voltages the components need, and it must do so cleanly and steadily. Its main parts: a transformer to change the voltage, a rectifier to convert AC into DC, a filter to smooth what is left of the ripple, a voltage regulator to hold each output steady as the load changes, and a cooling fan. The outputs: +12 V for motors and the processor circuits, +5 V and +3.3 V for the board's logic and the drives. A supply that is failing does not always die outright. It often produces voltages that are out of range under load, which shows up as random restarts and faults that move around — the hardest kind to diagnose.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) ले मुख्य AC बिजुलीलाई भागहरूलाई चाहिने कम DC भोल्टेजमा बदल्छ, र त्यो सफा तथा स्थिर हुनुपर्छ। यसका मुख्य भाग: भोल्टेज बदल्न transformer, AC लाई DC बनाउन rectifier, बाँकी ripple मिलाउन filter, भार बदलिँदा पनि हरेक आउटपुट स्थिर राख्न voltage regulator, र कुलिङ पंखा। आउटपुट: मोटर र प्रोसेसर परिपथका लागि +१२ V, बोर्डको लजिक र ड्राइभका लागि +५ V र +३.३ V। बिग्रँदै गएको सप्लाई सधैं एकैचोटि मर्दैन। भार पर्दा दायराबाहिरको भोल्टेज दिन्छ, जुन अनियमित रिस्टार्ट र ठाउँ बदलिरहने खराबीका रूपमा देखिन्छ — निदान गर्न सबैभन्दा गाह्रो किसिम।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording A hard disk drive stores data magnetically on rigid rotating platters. Track — one concentric ring on a platter surface. Sector — one slice of a track, and the smallest unit that can be read or written. Cylinder — the same track number on every platter, taken together. Read-write head — mounted on an actuator arm, floating microns above the surface on a cushion of air. Access time is made of three parts added together: seek time (the arm moves to the right track), rotational delay (the disk turns until the sector arrives), and transfer time (the data is read). The head never touches the platter. When it does — from a knock while running — that is a head crash, and the damage is physical.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Hard disk drive ले घुम्ने कडा platter मा चुम्बकीय रूपमा data राख्छ। Track — platter सतहको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ। Sector — track को एउटा टुक्रा, र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ। Cylinder — हरेक platter को उही नम्बरको track सँगै लिँदा। Read-write head — actuator arm मा जडित, हावाको तकियामा सतहभन्दा माइक्रोन मात्र माथि तैरिने। Access time तीन भागको योग हो: seek time (arm ठीक track मा जाने), rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न डिस्क घुम्ने), र transfer time (data पढिने)। Head ले platter छुँदैन। चलिरहेको बेला धक्का लागेर छोयो भने त्यो head crash हो, र क्षति भौतिक हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Partitioning divides one physical disk into separate areas that the operating system treats as independent drives. A primary partition can be booted from. An extended partition is a container that holds logical drives; the extended partition itself gets no drive letter. Drive lettering assigns C:, D:, E: and so on. Reasons to partition: separating the operating system from data so the OS can be reinstalled without losing files, running more than one OS, and keeping backups organised. Formatting writes a file system onto a partition so files can be stored. Quick format clears the index only — the data is still physically there until it is overwritten. Full format also scans every sector for defects, which is why it takes far longer.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Partitioning ले एउटै भौतिक डिस्कलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै क्षेत्रमा बाँड्छ, जसलाई अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले स्वतन्त्र ड्राइभ मान्छ। Primary partition बाट boot गर्न सकिन्छ। Extended partition भनेको logical drive राख्ने भाँडो हो; extended partition आफैँले ड्राइभ अक्षर पाउँदैन। Drive lettering ले C:, D:, E: आदि दिन्छ। Partition गर्ने कारण: अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई data बाट छुट्याउनु ताकि फाइल नगुमाई OS फेरि इन्स्टल गर्न सकियोस्, एकभन्दा बढी OS चलाउनु, र ब्याकअप व्यवस्थित राख्नु। Formatting ले partition मा file system लेख्छ ताकि फाइल राख्न सकियोस्। Quick format ले सूची मात्र मेटाउँछ — data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा त्यहीँ हुन्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले धेरै समय लाग्छ।

items.subject: grade10/hardware
items.en: Quick format hides the data; full format checks the disk. BIOS is on the board, not the disk.
items.ne: Quick format ले data लुकाउँछ; full format ले disk जाँच्छ। BIOS बोर्डमा हुन्छ, disk मा होइन।
