items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — एरे Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0]. एरे एरे भनेको एउटै प्रकारका तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी मा राखिन्छ र सधैं ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। मेमोरी लगातार भएकाले र हरेक तत्त्वको साइज उही भएकाले कम्प्युटरले जुनसुकै तत्त्वको ठेगाना तुरुन्तै गणना गर्न सक्छ: ठेगाना = base + index × size। त्यसैले एरेको पहुँचलाई direct/random access भनिन्छ — a[900] मा पुग्न पनि a[0] जत्तिकै समय लाग्छ। {{dia:arrayMemory}} Five integers in one continuous block. Index 0 to 4 — never 1 to 5. पाँच पूर्णांक एउटै लगातार ब्लकमा। index ० देखि ४ सम्म — १ देखि ५ होइन। Example 1 Declaring an array and printing it #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int marks[5] = {75, 82, 60, 91, 48}; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { cout << "marks[" << i << "] = " << marks[i] << endl; } return 0; } Output marks[0] = 75 marks[1] = 82 marks[2] = 60 marks[3] = 91 marks[4] = 48 The loop runs while i < 5, so i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — exactly the five valid indexes. लुप i < 5 सम्म चल्छ, त्यसैले i ले ०,१,२,३,४ मान लिन्छ — यीनै पाँच वटा मान्य index हुन्। Common mistake Writing marks[5] to reach the last element. In an array of size 5 the last index is 4. marks[5] is outside the array and gives a garbage value or crashes the program. C++ does not warn you. अन्तिम तत्त्वका लागि marks[5] लेख्नु गलत हो। साइज ५ को एरेमा अन्तिम index ४ हो। marks[5] एरे बाहिर पर्छ र फोहोर मान दिन्छ वा प्रोग्राम क्र्यास हुन्छ। C++ ले चेतावनी दिँदैन। Size 5 means last index 4. The last valid index is always size − 1. साइज ५ भए अन्तिम index ४। अन्तिम मान्य index सधैं साइज − १ हुन्छ। 1.5.1 (b) Linked List
items.ne: — लिंक्ड लिस्ट

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — लिंक्ड लिस्ट Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first). लिंक्ड लिस्ट लिंक्ड लिस्ट भनेको नोड भनिने तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो। हरेक नोडका दुई भाग हुन्छन्: डाटा, र अर्को नोडको ठेगाना राख्ने pointer। नोडहरू लगातार मेमोरीमा हुँदैनन् — जहाँसुकै हुन सक्छन्। लिस्टलाई पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडेर राख्छ। head नामक पोइन्टरले पहिलो नोड देखाउँछ, र अन्तिम नोडको पोइन्टरमा NULL हुन्छ जसले अन्त्य जनाउँछ। एक–एक नोड गरी मेमोरी लिने भएकाले लिस्ट प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा घटबढ हुन सक्छ। यसैलाई dynamic डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनिन्छ। प्रकार: singly (एउटा पोइन्टर), doubly (अघि र पछि दुवैको पोइन्टर), circular (अन्तिम नोडले पहिलो नोड देखाउने)। {{dia:linkedList}} Three nodes at scattered addresses, held together only by pointers. छरिएका ठेगानामा रहेका तीन नोड, पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडिएका। Example 2 What one node looks like in C++ struct Node { int data; // part 1 — the value Node *next; // part 2 — address of the next node }; int main() { Node *head = new Node; // create the first node head->data = 75; head->next = NULL; // NULL means "the list ends here" return 0; } Notice Node *next; — a Node that stores the address of another Node. That single line is what makes the chain possible. Node *next; हेर्नुहोस् — एउटा Node ले अर्को Node को ठेगाना राख्छ। यही एउटा लाइनले शृंखला सम्भव बनाउँछ। Why this difference matters — array vs linked list in action {{dia:arrayVsList}} Inserting into the middle: the array must shift elements, the linked list only re-points two links. This single picture answers most array-vs-list questions. बीचमा थप्दा: एरेले तत्त्वहरू सार्नुपर्छ, लिंक्ड लिस्टले दुई लिंक मात्र फेर्छ। यही एउटा चित्रले array-vs-list का धेरै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिन्छ। 1.5.1 (c) Stack
items.ne: — स्ट्याक

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — स्ट्याक Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix. स्ट्याक स्ट्याक त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ राख्ने र झिक्ने काम एउटै छेउ (top) बाट मात्र हुन्छ। यसले LIFO — Last In, First Out नियम मान्छ। अन्तिममा हालेको तत्त्व सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: push() हाल्ने, pop() झिक्ने, peek() नझिकी हेर्ने, isEmpty() र isFull() अवस्था जाँच्ने। Overflow = भरिएको स्ट्याकमा push। Underflow = खाली स्ट्याकबाट pop। खाली स्ट्याकमा top = -1 हुन्छ। प्रयोग: ब्राउजरको Back बटन, एडिटरको Undo, फङ्सन कलको call stack, स्ट्रिङ उल्टाउने, ब्राकेट मिलेको छ कि छैन जाँच्ने, infix लाई postfix मा बदल्ने। {{dia:stackOps}} Both push and pop use the same end. Only top moves. push र pop दुवै उही छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्। top मात्र सर्छ। Analogy — a pile of plates You wash plates and stack them one on top of another. The plate you put down last sits on top, so it is the plate you pick up first. The very first plate is at the bottom and leaves last. You cannot pull a plate from the middle without lifting the ones above it. उदाहरण — थाकिएका प्लेट। धोएर एक–अर्कामाथि थुपारेका प्लेटमध्ये अन्तिममा राखेको सबैभन्दा माथि हुन्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यही उठाइन्छ। पहिलो प्लेट सबैभन्दा तल हुन्छ र अन्तिममा निस्कन्छ। 1.5.1 (d) Queue
items.ne: — क्यु

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — क्यु Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers. क्यु क्यु त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ एउटा छेउ (rear) बाट राखिन्छ र अर्को छेउ (front) बाट झिकिन्छ। यसले FIFO — First In, First Out नियम मान्छ। पहिले हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: enqueue() पछाडि हाल्ने, dequeue() अगाडिबाट झिक्ने, front() पहिलो तत्त्व नझिकी हेर्ने। front > rear हुँदा क्यु खाली हुन्छ। प्रकार: simple queue, circular queue (rear घुमेर सुरुमै फर्कने), priority queue (महत्त्वपूर्ण तत्त्व पहिले निस्कने), deque (दुवै छेउबाट राख्न–झिक्न मिल्ने)। प्रयोग: प्रिन्टरको job queue, CPU scheduling, कल–सेन्टरको लाइन, डाटा बफर। {{dia:queueOps}} Two different ends: join at the rear, leave from the front. दुई फरक छेउ: पछाडिबाट लाइनमा बस्ने, अगाडिबाट निस्कने। 1.5.2 (a) Tree
items.ne: — ट्री

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: — ट्री Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children. ट्री ट्री त्यस्तो अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जसले डाटालाई नोडहरूको तह (hierarchy) मा मिलाउँछ। माथि एउटा मात्र root हुन्छ, र अरू हरेक नोडको एउटा मात्र parent हुन्छ। ट्रीमा चक्र (cycle) हुँदैन। जान्नैपर्ने शब्दहरू: Root — सबैभन्दा माथिको नोड; parent नभएको एक मात्र नोड। Parent — तल नोड भएको नोड। Child — कुनै नोडको ठीक तलको नोड। Siblings — एउटै parent भएका नोडहरू। Leaf — सन्तान नभएको नोड। Level — root level ०, त्यसका सन्तान level १, यसरी नै। Height — root देखि सबैभन्दा तलको leaf सम्मको तह संख्या। Binary tree भनेको हरेक नोडका बढीमा दुई सन्तान हुने ट्री हो। {{dia:tree}} A is the root. D, E and F are leaves. D and E are siblings. A root हो। D, E, F leaf हुन्। D र E siblings हुन्। 1.5.2 (b) Graph
items.ne: — ग्राफ

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Basic Introduction to Data Structure
items.ne: डाटा स्ट्रक्चरको आधारभूत परिचय

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: What you will learn: to choose a structure from a description instead of reciting the classification. "Which data structure would you use and why" is how this unit's heaviest marks are actually asked.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्गीकरण घोकेर भन्नुको साटो विवरण पढेर संरचना छान्न। "कुन डाटा स्ट्रक्चर प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ र किन" भनी यस युनिटका सबैभन्दा भारी अंक यसै रूपमा सोधिन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: What you will learn: which end each structure uses, and why that one difference decides the order values come out. The running code line lights up and the console explains every step in both languages.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: दुवैले कुन छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्, र त्यही एउटा फरकले मान निस्कने क्रम कसरी निर्धारण गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Compilation is how any source program becomes machine code — it happens to C programs too and has nothing to do with objects. The features of OOP are class, object, encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, data hiding and message passing.
items.ne: Compilation भनेको जुनसुकै source प्रोग्राम मेसिन कोड बन्ने तरिका हो — C प्रोग्राममा पनि हुन्छ र object सँग यसको सम्बन्ध छैन। OOP का विशेषता: class, object, encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, data hiding र message passing।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Structured programming divides a problem into functions, and data is passed around between them. OOP divides it into objects, each holding its own data together with the functions allowed to touch that data. That binding is what makes data hiding possible. Both use loops, variables and a compiler.
items.ne: Structured programming ले समस्यालाई function मा बाँड्छ, र data तिनीहरूबीच पठाइन्छ। OOP ले object मा बाँड्छ, र हरेक object ले आफ्नो data सँगै त्यो data छुन पाउने function पनि राख्छ। यही बन्धनले data hiding सम्भव बनाउँछ। दुवैमा loop, variable र compiler चाहिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Keywords are words reserved by the language with a fixed meaning, so they cannot be used as names. An identifier is a name YOU choose, such as a variable or function name. Both are kinds of token, along with constants, strings, operators and punctuators.
items.ne: Keyword भनेका भाषाले आफ्नै लागि सुरक्षित राखेका, निश्चित अर्थ भएका शब्द हुन्, त्यसैले तिनलाई नामका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन। Identifier भनेको तपाईंले छानेको नाम — जस्तै variable वा function को नाम। दुवै token का किसिम हुन्, constant, string, operator र punctuator सँगै।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: An identifier may contain letters, digits and the underscore, and must not START with a digit. _totalMarks is fine. 2ndMarks begins with a digit; total marks contains a space; float is a reserved keyword, so it cannot be used as a name.
items.ne: Identifier मा अक्षर, अंक र underscore हुन सक्छन्, तर अंकबाट सुरु हुनु हुँदैन। _totalMarks ठीक छ। 2ndMarks अंकबाट सुरु भयो; total marks मा खाली ठाउँ छ; float सुरक्षित keyword भएकाले नाम बनाउन मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Read the arrows as the direction the data travels. cin >> n moves data FROM the input stream INTO n. cout << n moves it OUT of n to the screen. Writing cin << n is the most common beginner error in this unit — the arrows point the wrong way.
items.ne: तीरलाई data कता जान्छ भन्ने दिशा ठान्नुहोस्। cin >> n ले input बाट n भित्र data लैजान्छ। cout << n ले n बाट बाहिर स्क्रिनमा। cin << n लेख्नु यस युनिटको सबैभन्दा सामान्य गल्ती हो — तीर उल्टो छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: It is a preprocessor directive that pastes in the iostream header, which declares cin, cout and the stream operators. Without it the compiler does not know what cout is. Execution always begins at main, whatever headers are included.
items.ne: यो preprocessor directive हो, जसले iostream header भित्र्याउँछ — र त्यसैले cin, cout तथा stream operator घोषणा गर्छ। यो नभए compiler लाई cout के हो थाहा हुँदैन। जुनसुकै header राखे पनि प्रोग्राम सधैं main बाट सुरु हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A do…while tests its condition AFTER the body, so the body always runs at least once. 5 is printed, i becomes 6, and only then is 6 < 3 tested — false, so the loop ends. Output is just 5. If this had been a plain while loop, the condition would have been tested first and nothing would have printed.
items.ne: do…while ले शर्त पछि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले body कम्तीमा एक पटक चल्छ। 5 छापिन्छ, i 6 हुन्छ, अनि मात्र 6 < 3 जाँचिन्छ — गलत, त्यसैले loop सकिन्छ। आउटपुट 5 मात्र। यदि साधारण while भएको भए शर्त पहिले जाँचिन्थ्यो र केही छापिँदैनथ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: This is called fall-through: once a case matches, statements keep executing until a break or the end of the switch. It compiles happily, which is what makes it dangerous — the program runs and quietly produces the wrong answer. Fall-through is occasionally useful on purpose, but a missing break is usually a bug.
items.ne: यसलाई fall-through भनिन्छ: एउटा case मिलेपछि break नआएसम्म वा switch नसकिएसम्म कथन चल्दै जान्छन्। यो सजिलै compile हुन्छ — त्यही नै खतरा हो, किनकि प्रोग्राम चल्छ र चुपचाप गलत उत्तर दिन्छ। कहिलेकाहीं जानाजान fall-through राखिन्छ, तर छुटेको break प्रायः बग हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: float stores numbers with a fractional part. Storing 72.45 in an int does not round it — it truncates to 72 and the .45 is gone silently, which is why marks calculations written with int come out slightly wrong. char holds a single character and bool holds only true or false.
items.ne: float ले दशमलव भएको सङ्ख्या राख्छ। 72.45 लाई int मा राख्दा यो गोलो हुँदैन — काटिएर 72 हुन्छ र .45 चुपचाप हराउँछ; त्यसैले int ले लेखिएको अंक गणना अलिअलि गलत आउँछ। char ले एउटै अक्षर र bool ले true वा false मात्र राख्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: GUI design is a classic OOP application: every window, button and text box is an object with its own data and behaviour. Other areas the syllabus lists include simulation and modelling, real-time systems, office automation and CAD. The other three options are hardware tasks, not programming ones.
items.ne: GUI डिजाइन OOP को उत्कृष्ट प्रयोग हो: हरेक window, button र text box आफ्नै data र व्यवहार भएको object हो। पाठ्यक्रमले simulation र modelling, real-time प्रणाली, कार्यालय स्वचालन र CAD पनि लेख्छ। बाँकी तीन हार्डवेयरका काम हुन्, प्रोग्रामिङका होइनन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: C++ reads a function top to bottom, and a name must be declared before it is used. On the cout line the compiler has not met marks yet, so it reports an undeclared identifier. Moving the declaration above the cout fixes it. Note the error is at COMPILE time — the program never runs at all.
items.ne: C++ ले function लाई माथिबाट तल पढ्छ, र नाम प्रयोग गर्नुअघि घोषणा भइसक्नुपर्छ। cout भएको लाइनमा compiler ले marks भेटेकै छैन, त्यसैले undeclared identifier भन्छ। घोषणालाई cout भन्दा माथि सारे मिल्छ। ध्यान दिनुहोस्, त्रुटि compile कै बेला हुन्छ — प्रोग्राम चल्नै पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The loop runs with i = 1, 2, 3 and prints i × i each time: 1, 4, 9. It stops when i becomes 4 because 4 <= 3 is false, so 16 is never printed. Choosing 1 4 9 16 is the off-by-one slip — count how many times the condition is TRUE, not how many values i takes.
items.ne: Loop i = 1, 2, 3 मा चल्छ र हरेक पटक i × i छाप्छ: 1, 4, 9। i 4 हुँदा 4 <= 3 गलत हुने भएकाले रोकिन्छ, त्यसैले 16 कहिल्यै छापिँदैन। 1 4 9 16 छान्नु एक-ले-चुक्ने गल्ती हो — i कति मान लिन्छ होइन, शर्त कति पटक सही हुन्छ गन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Data hiding means the data is declared private, so only the class's own member functions can reach it. Encapsulation is the binding of data and functions together; data hiding is what that binding lets you enforce. Inheritance passes members to a derived class and polymorphism gives one name several forms.
items.ne: Data hiding भनेको data लाई private घोषणा गर्नु, ताकि class कै member function ले मात्र छुन सकून्। Encapsulation भनेको data र function सँगै बाँध्नु; त्यही बन्धनले data hiding लागू गर्न दिन्छ। Inheritance ले derived class लाई member दिन्छ र polymorphism ले एउटै नामलाई धेरै रूप।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The arrows point the way the data travels. cout << pushes a value OUT to the screen; cin >> pulls a value IN from the keyboard. Written as cin << n the compiler looks for a way to insert into an input stream, finds none, and stops — so this is a compile error, not a wrong answer at run time. An uninitialised int n; is perfectly legal, which is why option 2 is the tempting wrong one.
items.ne: तीरले data कुन दिशामा जान्छ देखाउँछ। cout << ले मान पर्दामा बाहिर पठाउँछ; cin >> ले किबोर्डबाट भित्र तान्छ। cin << n लेख्दा compiler ले input stream भित्र हाल्ने उपाय खोज्छ, पाउँदैन, र रोकिन्छ — त्यसैले यो चल्दाको गलत उत्तर होइन, compile त्रुटि हो। int n; लाई मान नदिई छोड्नु पूर्ण रूपमा वैध छ, त्यसैले दोस्रो विकल्प आकर्षक गलत उत्तर हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A switch JUMPS to the matching label and then keeps running straight down — the later case labels are only labels, not barriers. There is no break anywhere, so after printing B it carries on into case 3 and then default, giving BCD. default is not skipped just because a case already matched. Add break; to each case and the answer becomes B.
items.ne: switch ले मिल्ने label मा हाम फाल्छ र त्यसपछि सिधै तल चलिरहन्छ — पछिका case label मात्र हुन्, बार होइनन्। कतै break छैन, त्यसैले B छापेपछि case 3 र त्यसपछि default मा पनि पस्छ, र BCD आउँछ। कुनै case मिलेकै कारण default छुट्दैन। हरेक case मा break; थपे उत्तर B बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Which feature of OOP is this?
items.ne: यो OOP को कुन विशेषता हो?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Each case describes something a program does. Name the OOP feature responsible. Two of them are the pair students swap most often — read what is being HIDDEN and what is being IGNORED.
items.ne: हरेक केसले प्रोग्रामले गर्ने कुरा वर्णन गर्छ। जिम्मेवार OOP विशेषताको नाम दिनुहोस्। दुईवटा त्यस्ता छन् जुन विद्यार्थीले सबैभन्दा बढी साट्छन् — के लुकाइँदै छ र के बेवास्ता गरिँदै छ, त्यो पढ्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Data and the functions that work on it are wrapped together in one class, and the data is protected from direct access. That wrapping is encapsulation. The private keyword is its usual sign.
items.ne: डाटा र त्यसमा काम गर्ने फङ्सन एउटै क्लासमा बाँधिएका छन्, र डाटा सिधै पहुँचबाट जोगिएको छ। यही बाँधाइ नै encapsulation हो। private शब्द यसको सामान्य सङ्केत हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Only the necessary detail is shown and the internal working is hidden. That is abstraction — it hides COMPLEXITY. Encapsulation hides DATA. This pair is the one students swap.
items.ne: आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ र भित्रको काम लुकाइएको छ। यही abstraction हो — यसले जटिलता लुकाउँछ। Encapsulation ले डाटा लुकाउँछ। विद्यार्थीले साट्ने जोडी यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One class acquires the members of another, so common code is written once and reused. The IS-A test confirms it: a Dog IS-A Animal.
items.ne: एउटा क्लासले अर्कोका मेम्बर प्राप्त गर्छ, त्यसैले साझा कोड एक पटक लेखेर पुनः प्रयोग हुन्छ। IS-A जाँचले पुष्टि गर्छ: Dog एक प्रकारको Animal हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One name behaving in more than one form. This is compile-time polymorphism (function overloading) — the compiler decides which to call from the argument list.
items.ne: एउटै नाम एकभन्दा बढी रूपमा चल्नु। यो compile-time polymorphism (function overloading) हो — कुन चलाउने भन्ने compiler ले आर्गुमेन्ट हेरेर तय गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Also polymorphism, but run-time — function overriding with a virtual function. Same name, form chosen while the program runs rather than while it compiles.
items.ne: यो पनि polymorphism, तर run-time — virtual फङ्सनसहितको function overriding। उही नाम, तर रूप compile गर्दा होइन, चल्दै गर्दा छानिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Two classes acquiring members from one base is hierarchical inheritance. If the question had asked which draw() runs through a Shape pointer, the answer would have been polymorphism instead.
items.ne: दुई क्लासले एउटै base बाट मेम्बर लिनु hierarchical inheritance हो। Shape pointer बाट कुन draw() चल्छ भनी सोधेको भए उत्तर polymorphism हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Why OOP was invented — the problem it solves
items.en: In C, global data can be changed by any function. In C++, each object locks its own data away and offers only public functions.
items.ne: C मा global डाटालाई जुनसुकै फङ्सनले बदल्न सक्छ। C++ मा हरेक अब्जेक्टले आफ्नो डाटा बन्द राख्छ र public फङ्सन मात्र दिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Every C++ program has these same parts. Learn to label them.
items.ne: हरेक C++ प्रोग्राममा यीनै भाग हुन्छन्। नाम दिन सिक्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Why OOP was invented — the problem it solves
items.en: That is exactly what an object does — and it is why an object is safer than a global variable that any function can change.
items.ne: उदाहरण — TV को रिमोट। बटन थिच्दा च्यानल फेरिन्छ। भित्रको सर्किट थाहा हुँदैन र छुन पनि पाइँदैन। रिमोटले भित्री भाग (डाटा) लुकाएर बटन (फङ्सन) मात्र दिन्छ। अब्जेक्ट ले पनि ठ्याक्कै यही गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A real-world entity that has data (its state) and functions (its behaviour). An object is an instance of a class and it takes memory.
items.ne: डाटा र व्यवहार भएको वास्तविक वस्तु। क्लासको एउटा instance, जसले मेमोरी लिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A blueprint or template that describes what data and functions its objects will have. A class takes no memory by itself.
items.ne: अब्जेक्ट बनाउने नक्सा वा टेम्प्लेट। यसले आफैंले मेमोरी लिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: private.
items.ne: डाटा र फङ्सनलाई एउटै एकाइमा बाँध्ने र डाटालाई बाहिरबाट लुकाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Showing only the necessary features to the user and hiding the internal details of how the work is actually done.
items.ne: आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाउने र भित्री जटिलता लुकाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One class acquires the properties and functions of another class, so that code can be reused instead of rewritten.
items.ne: एउटा क्लासले अर्को क्लासका गुण र फङ्सन प्राप्त गर्ने — कोड पुनः प्रयोग हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One name, many forms. The same function name or operator behaves differently in different situations.
items.ne: एउटै नाम, धेरै रूप। उही फङ्सनको नामले फरक अवस्थामा फरक काम गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Objects communicate with each other by calling one another's member functions — this is called sending a message.
items.ne: अब्जेक्टहरूले एकअर्काको फङ्सन बोलाएर सञ्चार गर्ने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The code that will run for a function call is decided at run time, not while compiling. This is what makes virtual functions work.
items.ne: कुन कोड चल्ने हो भन्ने कुरा कम्पाइल गर्दा होइन, चल्दै गर्दा निर्णय हुने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Abstraction. Complexity is hidden and only what you need is shown. The test that separates the two: abstraction hides COMPLEXITY, encapsulation hides DATA. A private variable with a getter is encapsulation; a dashboard that shows speed without the mechanism is abstraction. Unit 4 spends a whole section on this pair — it is asked most years.
items.ne: Abstraction। जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र चाहिने कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ। छुट्याउने जाँच: abstraction ले जटिलता लुकाउँछ, encapsulation ले डाटा। Getter सहितको private चल encapsulation हो; संयन्त्र नदेखाई गति देखाउने ड्यासबोर्ड abstraction हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Two cases are both polymorphism — one decided by the compiler, one decided while the program runs. Read the reasons: the exam asks you to name which kind.
items.ne: उत्तर दिनुअघि एउटै प्रश्न सोध्नुहोस्: के लुकाइँदै छ? फङ्सनपछाडि लुकेको डाटा = encapsulation। सरल अन्तरमुखपछाडि लुकेको जटिलता = abstraction। अर्कोका मेम्बर लिने क्लास = inheritance। एउटै नाम धेरै रूपमा = polymorphism। दुई केस polymorphism कै हुन् — एउटा compiler ले, अर्को चल्दै गर्दा तय हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Reserved words with a fixed meaning. You cannot use them as your own names.
items.ne: पहिल्यै अर्थ तोकिएका शब्द — आफ्नो नामका रूपमा प्रयोग गर्न मिल्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Names the programmer creates for variables, functions and classes.
items.ne: प्रोग्रामरले भेरिएबल, फङ्सन र क्लासलाई राखेको नाम।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Fixed values that never change while the program runs.
items.ne: प्रोग्राम चल्दा नबदलिने मान।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Symbols that perform an operation on values.
items.ne: मानमाथि काम गर्ने चिन्ह।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Symbols that separate or group parts of the program.
items.ne: प्रोग्रामका भाग छुट्याउने वा समूह बनाउने चिन्ह।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A sequence of characters written inside double quotes.
items.ne: डबल कोट भित्रका अक्षरहरूको शृंखला।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Count the tokens in that line and write your number down before opening this. Almost everyone who gets it wrong forgets the same one — and it is the character at the very end.
items.ne: त्यो लाइनका token गन्नुहोस् र खोल्नुअघि आफ्नो सङ्ख्या लेख्नुहोस्। बिराउनेहरू प्रायः उही एउटा बिर्सन्छन् — र त्यो सबैभन्दा अन्तिमको अक्षर हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: ; (punctuator). Questions like "identify the tokens in the given statement" are common — count carefully.
items.ne: यो एउटै लाइनमा सात टोकन छन्। "दिइएको कथनमा token पहिचान गर्नुहोस्" भन्ने प्रश्न बारम्बार आउँछ — ध्यान दिएर गन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Whole numbers, no decimal point
items.ne: दशमलव नभएको पूर्ण संख्या

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Decimal numbers, about 6 digits of precision
items.ne: दशमलव भएको संख्या

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Decimal numbers with higher precision
items.ne: अझ शुद्ध दशमलव संख्या

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A single character in single quotes
items.ne: सिंगल कोटमा एउटा अक्षर

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: false (0)
items.ne: true वा false मात्र

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: "No value" — used when a function returns nothing
items.ne: कुनै मान नहुने

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: <string>
items.ne: अक्षरहरूको शृंखला

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: main().
items.ne: यी चार गल्ती सबैभन्दा बढी हुन्छन्: namespace बिर्सने, cin मा तीर उल्टो लेख्ने, सेमीकोलन छुटाउने, र main

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Runs a block only when the condition is true.
items.ne: सर्त सही भएमा मात्र चल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One block if true, another block if false.
items.ne: सही भए एउटा, गलत भए अर्को ब्लक।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Checks many conditions one by one from the top down.
items.ne: माथिबाट धेरै सर्त क्रमशः जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: An if inside another if.
items.ne: एउटा if भित्र अर्को if।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: break.
items.ne: मान मिलाएर धेरैमध्ये एउटा case छान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Repeats a block a known number of times.
items.ne: कति पटक दोहोरिने थाहा हुँदा।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Repeats while a condition is true. The condition is checked first — entry controlled. May run zero times.
items.ne: सर्त पहिले जाँच्छ, त्यसैले ० पटक पनि चल्न सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Runs the block at least once, then checks the condition — exit controlled.
items.ne: कम्तीमा एक पटक चल्छ, अनि मात्र सर्त जाँच्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Exits the loop or switch immediately.
items.ne: तुरुन्तै लुप वा switch बाट बाहिर निस्कन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Skips the rest of this round and jumps to the next round.
items.ne: यो चक्र छोडेर अर्को चक्रमा जान्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: marks is 78. Name the grade that prints, and say how many of the four tests are actually evaluated before the program stops testing. A ladder is not four separate ifs, and that is the marks difference.
items.ne: marks = ७८ छ। कुन grade छापिन्छ भन्नुहोस्, र प्रोग्रामले परीक्षण रोक्नुअघि चारमध्ये कति परीक्षण साँच्चै गर्छ पनि भन्नुहोस्। ladder भनेको छुट्टाछुट्टै चार वटा if होइन, र अङ्कको फरक त्यहीँ छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The ladder is checked from the top. 78 fails the first test (78 >= 90 is false) but passes the second (78 >= 75 is true), so it prints Grade A and stops — the remaining conditions are never checked.
items.ne: माथिबाट क्रमशः जाँचिन्छ। ७८ पहिलो सर्तमा असफल भयो तर दोस्रोमा सफल भयो, त्यसैले "Grade A" छापेर रोकियो — बाँकी सर्त जाँचिँदैनन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: do…while printed once. That is the whole difference: while checks first, do…while acts first.
items.ne: उही सर्त, उही सुरुको मान — तर while

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: Structured vs object-oriented programming, and the features of OOP, are the two most repeated questions from this unit.
items.ne: Structured र OOP को तुलना, अनि OOP का विशेषता — यी दुई सबैभन्दा बढी दोहोरिने प्रश्न हुन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: Any four of: Object — a real-world entity with data and behaviour; Class — a blueprint from which objects are created; Encapsulation — binding data and functions in one unit and hiding the data; Abstraction — showing only essential features and hiding internal details; Inheritance — one class acquiring the properties of another; Polymorphism — one name behaving in many forms.
items.ne: परिभाषा + कुनै चार विशेषताको एक–एक लाइन व्याख्या लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: "Ram").
items.ne: परिभाषा + छवटै प्रकार + एक–एक उदाहरण दिनुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: do…while ends with a semicolon after the condition.
items.ne: entry vs exit controlled, ० पटक vs कम्तीमा एक पटक, र अन्त्यको सेमीकोलन — यी तीन बुँदा लेखे पुग्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Object Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming method that solves a big problem by breaking it into small parts called objects. Each object keeps its own data and the functions that work on that data bound together, so that no other part of the program can access that data directly. The key phrase examiners look for is "binds together data and the functions that operate on that data".
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् OOP भनेको ठूलो समस्यालाई अब्जेक्ट भनिने साना–साना भागमा बाँडेर समाधान गर्ने प्रोग्रामिङ तरिका हो। हरेक अब्जेक्टले आफ्नो डाटा र त्यही डाटामाथि काम गर्ने फङ्सन लाई सँगै बाँधेर राख्छ, ताकि प्रोग्रामको अरू भागले त्यो डाटा सिधै छुन नसकोस्। परीक्षकले खोज्ने मुख्य वाक्यांश: "डाटा र त्यसमाथि काम गर्ने फङ्सनलाई सँगै बाँध्छ"।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Where OOP is used Real-time systems, simulation and modelling Object-oriented databases Graphical User Interface (GUI) design Computer games and animation Artificial Intelligence and expert systems CAD/CAM and office automation systems Mobile and web application development Neural networks and parallel programming
items.ne: OOP कहाँ प्रयोग हुन्छ रियल–टाइम सिस्टम, सिमुलेसन र मोडलिङ अब्जेक्ट ओरिएन्टेड डाटाबेस ग्राफिकल युजर इन्टरफेस (GUI) डिजाइन कम्प्युटर गेम र एनिमेसन आर्टिफिसियल इन्टेलिजेन्स र एक्सपर्ट सिस्टम CAD/CAM र अफिस अटोमेसन मोबाइल र वेब एप्लिकेसन विकास न्युरल नेटवर्क र प्यारलल प्रोग्रामिङ

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Token A token is the smallest individual unit of a C++ program that has meaning to the compiler. When the compiler reads your program it first breaks it into tokens. The character set is every character C++ understands: letters A–Z and a–z, digits 0–9, special symbols such as + - * / = < > ( ) { } ; ,, and white space (space, tab, newline).
items.ne: टोकन टोकन भनेको C++ प्रोग्रामको सबैभन्दा सानो अर्थपूर्ण एकाइ हो, जुन कम्पाइलरले बुझ्छ। कम्पाइलरले प्रोग्राम पढ्दा पहिले यसलाई टोकनमा टुक्र्याउँछ। Character set भनेको C++ ले बुझ्ने सबै अक्षर हो: A–Z, a–z, ०–९, विशेष चिन्ह + - * / = ( ) { } ;, र खाली ठाउँ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: cout and cin cout << sends data out to the screen. << is called the insertion operator. cin >> takes data in from the keyboard. >> is called the extraction operator. Both are objects defined in the header file <iostream> and both live inside the namespace std. endl moves the cursor to a new line. Memory trick: the arrows point in the direction the data travels. cout << x — data flows out of x into cout. cin >> x — data flows from cin into x.
items.ne: cout र cin cout << ले डाटा स्क्रिनमा बाहिर पठाउँछ। << लाई insertion operator भनिन्छ। cin >> ले किबोर्डबाट डाटा भित्र लिन्छ। >> लाई extraction operator भनिन्छ। दुवै <iostream> हेडर फाइलमा भएका अब्जेक्ट हुन् र std नेमस्पेस भित्र बस्छन्। endl ले नयाँ लाइनमा लैजान्छ। सम्झने तरिका: तीर जता फर्किएको छ, डाटा त्यतै जान्छ।

items.ne: छोटो सार POP मा फङ्सन मुख्य हुन्छ, डाटा प्रायः global हुने भएकाले कम सुरक्षित हुन्छ, र यसले माथिबाट तल (top-down) सोच्छ। OOP मा अब्जेक्ट मुख्य हुन्छ, डाटा private राखेर लुकाइन्छ, र तलबाट माथि (bottom-up) सोच्छ। ठूलो प्रोग्रामका लागि OOP राम्रो। Predict first · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A driver uses a steering wheel without knowing how the engine works. Which feature of OOP does that describe? चालकले इन्जिन कसरी चल्छ नजानीकनै स्टेयरिङ चलाउँछन्। यसले OOP को कुन विशेषता जनाउँछ? Encapsulation Abstraction Inheritance Abstraction. Complexity is hidden and only what you need is shown. The test that separates the two: abstraction hides COMPLEXITY, encapsulation hides DATA. A private variable with a getter is encapsulation; a dashboard that shows speed without the mechanism is abstraction. Unit 4 spends a whole section on this pair — it is asked most years. Abstraction। जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र चाहिने कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ। छुट्याउने जाँच: abstraction ले जटिलता लुकाउँछ, encapsulation ले डाटा। Getter सहितको private चल encapsulation हो; संयन्त्र नदेखाई गति देखाउने ड्यासबोर्ड abstraction हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Protected is reachable from a derived class. This is the ONLY difference between protected and private, and it is what protected exists for.
items.ne: Protected मा derived क्लासबाट पुग्न सकिन्छ। Protected र private बीचको एउटै फरक यही हो, र protected हुनुको कारण पनि यही हो।

items.ne: Derived क्लासले private मेम्बरमा पहुँच पाउँदैन। त्यो अब्जेक्टभित्र छ, तर B ले सिधै छुन सक्दैन — ५.१ को उदाहरणमा यसलाई बाबुको व्यक्तिगत डायरी भनिएको छ। private लाई protected बनाए compile हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Protected helps a DERIVED class, not the outside world. From main() it behaves exactly like private. Students who learn "protected is less strict" often miss this.
items.ne: Protected ले derived क्लासलाई सहयोग गर्छ, बाहिरी संसारलाई होइन। main() बाट यो ठ्याक्कै private जस्तै हुन्छ। "Protected कम कडा हो" भनेर सिकेकाहरू यहीँ चुक्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One-line memory hook A class is the house design on paper. An object is the real house built from it. One design can produce many houses — and you cannot live inside the design. That is exactly why a class takes no memory but an object does.
items.ne: क्लास = कागजमा कोरेको घरको नक्सा। अब्जेक्ट = त्यसबाट बनेको साँच्चिकै घर। एउटा नक्साबाट धेरै घर बन्छ — र नक्सामा बस्न मिल्दैन। त्यसैले क्लासले मेमोरी लिँदैन, अब्जेक्टले लिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Accessible only inside the same class. Not from outside the class, and not even from a derived class. This is the default for a class.
items.ne: उही क्लास भित्रबाट मात्र। बाहिरबाट वा derived क्लासबाट पनि हुँदैन। क्लासमा यही default हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Accessible from anywhere — inside the class, through an object, and from derived classes. This is the default for a struct.
items.ne: जताबाट पनि — क्लास भित्र, अब्जेक्टबाट, र derived क्लासबाट।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp

items.en: Note the trap: in a struct the default is public instead. Same language, opposite default — and that difference is worth a mark when the question gives you a struct.
items.ne: Private। class मा default private हुन्छ, त्यसैले x बाहिरबाट पुग्न सकिँदैन — public: लेख्न बिर्सँदा सुरुका प्रोग्राममा "member is inaccessible" आउनुको कारण यही हो। ध्यान दिनुहोस्: struct मा default public हुन्छ। उही भाषा, उल्टो default।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Case 4 is the one that catches people who learned "protected is less strict". From outside the class, protected behaves exactly like private.
items.ne: केस २ र ३ मा एउटै कोड छ, एउटै शब्द फरक — protected बाट private — र उत्तर उल्टिन्छ। दुई specifier बीचको पूरा फरक त्यही शब्द हो, र त्यो derived क्लासभित्र मात्र देखिन्छ। केस ४ ले "protected कम कडा हो" भन्ने भ्रम भत्काउँछ: क्लासबाहिरबाट protected ठ्याक्कै private जस्तै हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Six lines are printed. Write all six down, in order, before opening this. The order is the answer: each constructor announces itself when it runs, so the first three lines tell you which one was chosen and when.
items.ne: छ वटा लाइन छापिन्छन्। खोल्नुअघि क्रम मिलाएर छैटै लेख्नुहोस्। क्रम नै उत्तर हो: हरेक constructor चल्दा आफ्नो नाम भन्छ, त्यसैले पहिलो तीन लाइनले कुन कहिले रोजियो भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: All three constructors have the same name — the compiler picks the right one by counting and checking the arguments. That is constructor overloading, and it is an example of compile-time polymorphism.
items.ne: तीनै कन्स्ट्रक्टरको नाम उही छ — कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट हेरेर सही एउटा छान्छ। यसैलाई constructor overloading भनिन्छ, र यो compile-time polymorphism कै उदाहरण हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Class A class is a user-defined data type that acts as a blueprint or template. It groups data members (the variables) and member functions (the methods) together into one unit. A class does not take any memory — it is only a design. Memory is allocated only when an object is created from it.
items.ne: क्लास क्लास भनेको प्रयोगकर्ताले बनाएको डाटा टाइप हो, जुन नक्सा (blueprint) जस्तै काम गर्छ। यसले डाटा मेम्बर (भेरिएबल) र मेम्बर फङ्सन (मेथड) लाई एउटै एकाइमा राख्छ। क्लासले मेमोरी लिँदैन — यो डिजाइन मात्र हो। अब्जेक्ट बनेपछि मात्र मेमोरी छुट्याइन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Object An object is a variable of a class — one real copy built from the blueprint. An object does take memory, and each object has its own separate copy of the data members. The act of creating an object from a class is called instantiation.
items.ne: अब्जेक्ट अब्जेक्ट भनेको क्लासको भेरिएबल हो — नक्सा हेरेर बनाइएको वास्तविक प्रति। अब्जेक्टले मेमोरी लिन्छ, र हरेक अब्जेक्टसँग आफ्नै छुट्टै डाटा हुन्छ। क्लासबाट अब्जेक्ट बनाउने कामलाई instantiation भनिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Constructor A constructor is a special member function that is called automatically when an object is created. Its job is to initialise the object's data. Its name is exactly the same as the class name. It has no return type — not even void. It can take parameters and can be overloaded. Three types: Default constructor — takes no arguments. Parameterized constructor — takes arguments to set the starting values. Copy constructor — creates a new object as a copy of an existing one, written Student(Student &s).
items.ne: कन्स्ट्रक्टर कन्स्ट्रक्टर एउटा विशेष मेम्बर फङ्सन हो, जुन अब्जेक्ट बन्ने बित्तिकै आफैं बोलिन्छ। यसको काम डाटालाई सुरुवाती मान दिनु हो। नाम क्लासकै नामसँग ठ्याक्कै मिल्नुपर्छ। return type हुँदैन — void पनि होइन। प्यारामिटर लिन सक्छ र overload पनि हुन सक्छ। तीन प्रकार: Default — कुनै आर्गुमेन्ट नलिने। Parameterized — सुरुको मान तोक्न आर्गुमेन्ट लिने। Copy — भइरहेको अब्जेक्टको प्रतिलिपि बनाउने।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Destructor A destructor is a special member function that is called automatically when an object is destroyed — that is, when it goes out of scope. Its job is to free the memory the object was using. Its name is the class name with a tilde ~ in front. It has no return type and takes no parameters. It cannot be overloaded — a class has exactly one destructor. Objects are destroyed in the reverse order of their creation.
items.ne: डिस्ट्रक्टर डिस्ट्रक्टर एउटा विशेष मेम्बर फङ्सन हो, जुन अब्जेक्ट नष्ट हुँदा आफैं बोलिन्छ। यसको काम अब्जेक्टले लिएको मेमोरी खाली गर्नु हो। नाम अगाडि टिल्ड ~ राखेर क्लासकै नाम। return type हुँदैन र प्यारामिटर पनि लिँदैन। overload गर्न मिल्दैन — क्लासमा एउटा मात्र डिस्ट्रक्टर हुन्छ। अब्जेक्टहरू बनेको उल्टो क्रममा नष्ट हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: From outside, protected behaves like private. Its only gift is to a derived class.
items.ne: बाहिरबाट protected, private जस्तै हो। यसले दिने एक मात्र सुविधा derived कक्षालाई हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: What you will learn: to apply the access table instead of reciting it — especially inside a derived class, where private and protected stop behaving the same.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पहुँच तालिका घोक्नुभन्दा लागू गर्न — विशेष गरी derived क्लासभित्र, जहाँ private र protected फरक हुन्छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: That is encapsulation (data hiding). Abstraction instead hides the complexity of HOW the work is done.
items.ne: यो encapsulation (data hiding) हो। Abstraction ले चाहिँ काम "कसरी" हुन्छ भन्ने जटिलता लुकाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Abstraction is about DESIGN — deciding what to show. Encapsulation is about IMPLEMENTATION — wrapping the data with the functions that may touch it. A car pedal is abstraction: you press it without knowing the engine. The sealed engine casing is encapsulation. They work together but are not the same, and the exam asks you to tell them apart.
items.ne: Abstraction डिजाइन को कुरा हो — के देखाउने भन्ने निर्णय। Encapsulation कार्यान्वयन को — data लाई छुन पाउने function सँगै बेर्ने काम। गाडीको पेडल abstraction हो: इन्जिन नजानी थिच्नुहुन्छ। बन्द इन्जिन बाकस encapsulation हो। सँगै काम गर्छन् तर एउटै होइनन्, र परीक्षाले छुट्याउन भन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Private data with public functions is the standard shape: outside code must go through a function, which can check the value before storing it. Making data public defeats the purpose entirely — anything could set a student's marks to −5. Global variables are the opposite of encapsulation.
items.ne: Private data र public function मानक ढाँचा हो: बाहिरको कोड function हुँदै आउनुपर्छ, र त्यो function ले राख्नुअघि मान जाँच्न सक्छ। Data public बनाउँदा उद्देश्य नै सकिन्छ — जसले पनि विद्यार्थीको अंक −5 बनाइदिन सक्छ। Global variable त encapsulation को ठीक उल्टो हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: You are given a simple interface — cout << x — and everything underneath it is hidden. That is abstraction: showing only what is needed to use the thing. The C++ library is itself built on this idea, which is why you can write a program on day one.
items.ne: तपाईंलाई सरल इन्टरफेस दिइएको छ — cout << x — र मुनिको सबै लुकाइएको छ। यही abstraction हो: प्रयोग गर्न चाहिने मात्र देखाउनु। C++ library आफैँ यही विचारमा बनेको छ, त्यसैले पहिलो दिनै प्रोग्राम लेख्न सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The setter is a gate. It can reject a negative age, clamp an impossible one, or record that a change happened — none of which is possible when outside code writes the variable directly. Speed and memory are unchanged, and inheritance does not depend on access specifiers at all.
items.ne: Setter एउटा ढोका हो। यसले ऋणात्मक उमेर अस्वीकार गर्न, असम्भव मान सीमित गर्न, वा परिवर्तन भएको अभिलेख राख्न सक्छ — बाहिरको कोडले सीधै variable लेख्दा यीमध्ये केही पनि सम्भव हुँदैन। गति र मेमोरी उस्तै रहन्छ, र inheritance access specifier मा भर पर्दैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Abstraction or encapsulation?
items.ne: Abstraction कि encapsulation?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The pair the paper asks you to differentiate almost every year. One test settles every case: is complexity being hidden, or is data being protected?
items.ne: परीक्षामा झन्डै हरेक वर्ष फरक छुट्याउन भनिने जोडी। एउटै जाँचले सबै केस मिलाउँछ: जटिलता लुकाइँदै छ, कि डाटा जोगाइँदै छ?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Complexity is hidden and only the necessary interface is shown. Abstraction answers "what does it do?" and hides "how".
items.ne: जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र आवश्यक अन्तरमुख मात्र देखाइएको छ। Abstraction ले "के गर्छ?" भन्छ र "कसरी" लुकाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Data is bound with its functions and protected from direct access. Encapsulation answers "who may touch this?" The private keyword is its usual sign.
items.ne: डाटा आफ्ना फङ्सनसँग बाँधिएको र सिधै पहुँचबाट जोगिएको छ। Encapsulation ले "यसलाई कसले छुन पाउँछ?" भन्छ। private शब्द यसको सङ्केत हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The class states WHAT must exist without saying HOW. A pure virtual function is abstraction in its strongest form.
items.ne: क्लासले के हुनुपर्छ भन्छ, कसरी भन्दैन। Pure virtual फङ्सन abstraction को सबैभन्दा बलियो रूप हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Binding data and functions into a single unit IS the definition of encapsulation — the wrapping itself, before any hiding.
items.ne: डाटा र फङ्सनलाई एउटै इकाइमा बाँध्नु नै encapsulation को परिभाषा हो — लुकाउनुभन्दा अघि, बाँध्ने काम आफैंमा।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Necessary information shown, mechanism hidden. If instead the question said the speed value could not be changed from outside, that would be encapsulation.
items.ne: आवश्यक जानकारी देखाइएको, संयन्त्र लुकाइएको। बरु "गति बाहिरबाट बदल्न मिल्दैन" भनेको भए त्यो encapsulation हुन्थ्यो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: You get simple, safe buttons. The complicated part stays behind a wall you cannot see past — and because the buttons never change, the hidden part can be rewritten freely.
items.ne: तपाईंलाई सजिलो र सुरक्षित बटन मात्र दिइन्छ। जटिल भाग नदेखिने पर्खाल पछाडि रहन्छ — बटन नफेरिने भएकाले भित्रको कोड जहिले पनि बदल्न सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The private data sits in a capsule. The only way in is through a public function that can refuse a bad value.
items.ne: private डाटा क्याप्सुल भित्र हुन्छ। भित्र पस्ने एक मात्र बाटो public फङ्सन हो, जसले गलत मान अस्वीकार गर्न सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The car abstracts all of that away. If the manufacturer redesigns the entire engine next year, you still drive it the same way — because the interface (the controls) did not change. That is the real benefit of abstraction in programming too.
items.ne: उदाहरण — गाडी चलाउनु। तपाईंलाई स्टेरिङ, एक्सिलेटर र ब्रेक मात्र चाहिन्छ; इन्जिन भित्र के हुन्छ थाहा पाउनु पर्दैन। भोलि कम्पनीले पूरै इन्जिन फेरे पनि तपाईंले उसैगरी चलाउनुहुन्छ — किनकि नियन्त्रण (interface) फेरिएन। प्रोग्रामिङमा पनि abstraction को साँचो फाइदा यही हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: square() helper — is completely hidden. That is abstraction.
items.ne: प्रयोगकर्ताले एउटा सजिलो फङ्सन बोलाएर जवाफ पाउँछ। कसरी गणना भयो — private square()

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A negative amount is passed to the setter. Decide what the balance is afterwards — and whether the program stopped, complained, or simply carried on. Which of those three it does is the point of the example.
items.ne: setter मा ऋणात्मक रकम पठाइएको छ। त्यसपछि balance कति हुन्छ निर्णय गर्नुहोस् — र प्रोग्राम रोकियो, गुनासो गर्‍यो, कि सामान्य रूपमा अघि बढ्यो? तीनमध्ये कुन गर्छ भन्ने नै यो उदाहरणको मुख्य कुरा हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: a.balance = -500; would have silently corrupted the account. The setter is a guard at the only door.
items.ne: encapsulation को मुख्य उद्देश्य यही हो। balance

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: Abstraction hides the complexity or implementation — the "how" — and is a design-level concept achieved through abstract classes and access specifiers; it focuses on what an object does. Encapsulation hides the data — the "what" — and is an implementation-level concept achieved by making data private and providing public getters and setters; it focuses on protecting the data.
items.ne: तालिकाको रूपमा चार हरफ लेख्नुहोस्: के लुकाउँछ, कुन तह, कसरी हासिल हुन्छ, केमा ध्यान।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Abstraction means showing only the essential features of an object to the user and hiding the internal implementation details — that is, hiding how the work is actually done. In C++ abstraction is achieved in two ways: using classes with access specifiers (data and helper functions kept private, only the useful functions made public), and at a higher level using abstract classes.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् एब्स्ट्र्याक्सन भनेको प्रयोगकर्तालाई आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाउने र भित्री काम कसरी हुन्छ भन्ने लुकाउने हो। C++ मा यो दुई तरिकाले हासिल गरिन्छ: access specifier सहितको क्लास (डाटा र सहायक फङ्सन private, काम लाग्ने फङ्सन मात्र public), र माथिल्लो तहमा abstract class मार्फत।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Advantages of abstraction Reduces complexity — the user sees a small, simple interface instead of thousands of lines. Increases security — internal data and helper functions cannot be misused. Easy to change later — the hidden code can be rewritten without breaking any program that uses it. Improves reusability — the same class can be used in many programs. Avoids code duplication and makes maintenance easier.
items.ne: एब्स्ट्र्याक्सनका फाइदा जटिलता घटाउँछ — हजारौं लाइनको सट्टा सानो, सजिलो interface मात्र देखिन्छ। सुरक्षा बढाउँछ — भित्री डाटा र सहायक फङ्सनको दुरुपयोग हुँदैन। पछि बदल्न सजिलो — लुकेको कोड बदल्दा प्रयोग गर्ने प्रोग्राम बिग्रँदैन। पुनः प्रयोग — उही क्लास धेरै प्रोग्राममा चल्छ। दोहोरो कोड हट्छ र मर्मत सजिलो हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Abstract class and pure virtual function
items.en: The higher level of abstraction A pure virtual function is a virtual function with no body, written by putting = 0 after it. It is a promise that says "every child class must provide this function". A class that contains at least one pure virtual function is called an abstract class. You cannot create an object of an abstract class — it exists only to be inherited.
items.ne: माथिल्लो तहको abstraction Pure virtual function भनेको शरीर नभएको virtual फङ्सन हो, जसमा पछाडि = 0 लेखिन्छ। यसले "हरेक सन्तान क्लासले यो फङ्सन दिनैपर्छ" भन्ने वाचा गर्छ। कम्तीमा एउटा pure virtual function भएको क्लासलाई abstract class भनिन्छ। यसको अब्जेक्ट बनाउन मिल्दैन — यो इनहेरिट गर्नकै लागि मात्र हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Encapsulation means binding data members and member functions together into a single unit (the class), and hiding the data from direct outside access by declaring it private. Outside code must then go through public functions — usually called setter and getter functions — to change or read that data. For this reason encapsulation is also called data hiding.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् इनक्याप्सुलेसन भनेको डाटा मेम्बर र मेम्बर फङ्सनलाई एउटै एकाइ (क्लास) मा बाँध्ने र डाटालाई private बनाएर बाहिरबाट सिधै छुन नदिने हो। त्यसपछि बाहिरको कोडले डाटा बदल्न वा पढ्न public फङ्सन (setter/getter) प्रयोग गर्नै पर्छ। त्यसैले यसलाई data hiding पनि भनिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Advantages of encapsulation Data security — data cannot be changed accidentally or wrongly from outside. Full control — the setter can validate the value before storing it. Read-only or write-only access — provide only a getter, or only a setter, as needed. Easier maintenance and testing — the class can be changed inside without affecting other code. Achieves data hiding, which is one of the main goals of OOP.
items.ne: इनक्याप्सुलेसनका फाइदा डाटा सुरक्षा — बाहिरबाट गल्तीले डाटा बदलिन सक्दैन। पूर्ण नियन्त्रण — setter ले मान राख्नु अघि जाँच्न सक्छ। पढ्ने मात्र वा लेख्ने मात्र पहुँच दिन सकिन्छ। मर्मत र परीक्षण सजिलो — भित्र बदल्दा अरू कोडमा असर पर्दैन। Data hiding हासिल हुन्छ, जुन OOP कै मुख्य लक्ष्य हो।

items.en: What you will learn: to settle the pair with one question instead of two remembered definitions — which is what you will have time for in the hall.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Base class constructors always run before derived ones, starting from the top-most base. So the order is Animal, then Dog, then Puppy.
items.ne: Base क्लासको कन्स्ट्रक्टर सधैं derived भन्दा पहिले चल्छ, सबैभन्दा माथिबाट सुरु हुँदै। क्रम: Animal → Dog → Puppy।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Hierarchical inheritance is one parent with many children — the picture branches downward. Multiple inheritance is the reverse: one child with many parents. Multilevel is a chain, A to B to C. Reading the SHAPE of the diagram is the fastest way to answer this kind of question.
items.ne: Hierarchical inheritance भनेको एउटा बाबु, धेरै छोरा — चित्र तलतिर फैलिन्छ। Multiple यसको उल्टो हो: एउटा छोरा, धेरै बाबु। Multilevel शृंखला हो, A देखि B देखि C। चित्रको आकार पढ्नु यस्ता प्रश्नको सबैभन्दा छिटो उत्तर हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A derived class inherits the private members — they exist in the object and take up space — but it cannot name them. It must go through a public or protected function of the base. This is exactly why protected exists: it means "private to the outside world, visible to my children".
items.ne: Derived class ले private member पाउँछ — ती object मा हुन्छन् र ठाउँ ओगट्छन् — तर नाम लिएर छुन सक्दैन। Base कै public वा protected function हुँदै जानुपर्छ। protected हुनुको कारण ठ्याक्कै यही हो: "बाहिरका लागि private, मेरा छोराछोरीका लागि देखिने"।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: C++ uses a colon, then the access specifier, then the base class name. extends is Java and inherits is not a C++ keyword at all. Option 4 has the syntax right but the direction backwards — it would make Person inherit from Student, which is the wrong way round.
items.ne: C++ मा कोलन, अनि access specifier, अनि base class को नाम लेखिन्छ। extends Java को हो र inherits C++ को keyword नै होइन। चौथो विकल्पको वाक्य-संरचना ठीक छ तर दिशा उल्टो — यसले Person लाई Student बाट inherit गराउँछ, जुन उल्टो हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Reusability is the point: common behaviour lives in one tested place and every child gets it. That also makes a program easier to extend — a new derived class needs only what is different. Inheritance does not change access rules, and a derived object is normally LARGER, not smaller, since it carries the base part too.
items.ne: पुनः प्रयोग नै मुख्य कुरा हो: साझा व्यवहार एउटै परीक्षित ठाउँमा रहन्छ र हरेक छोराले पाउँछ। यसले विस्तार पनि सजिलो बनाउँछ — नयाँ derived class लाई फरक भएको कुरा मात्र चाहिन्छ। Inheritance ले पहुँचका नियम बदल्दैन, र derived object सामान्यतया ठूलो हुन्छ, सानो होइन — किनकि base को भाग पनि बोक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: This diamond shape mixes hierarchical and multiple inheritance, so it is hybrid. D inherits A through B and again through C, so A's members arrive twice and a reference to one becomes ambiguous. C++ solves it with a virtual base class, which makes the compiler keep only one copy of A.
items.ne: यो हीरा आकारले hierarchical र multiple inheritance मिसाउँछ, त्यसैले hybrid हो। D ले A लाई B हुँदै र फेरि C हुँदै पाउँछ, त्यसैले A का member दुई पटक आउँछन् र कुनै एउटालाई बोलाउँदा अन्योल हुन्छ। C++ ले virtual base class ले समाधान गर्छ, जसले compiler लाई A को एउटै प्रति राख्न लगाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: private means "this class only", and inheriting does not loosen it — x is inherited by B but B is not allowed to touch it. protected is the specifier that exists for exactly this situation: visible to derived classes, still hidden from the outside world. Note that the inheritance mode (public here) changes what happens to the base's public and protected members; it never grants access to its private ones.
items.ne: private को अर्थ "यही class मात्र" हो, र inheritance ले यो खुकुलो बनाउँदैन — x B मा सर्छ तर B ले छुन पाउँदैन। यस्तै अवस्थाका लागि बनेको specifier protected हो: derived class ले देख्छ, बाहिरी संसारले देख्दैन। Inheritance mode (यहाँ public) ले base का public र protected मेम्बरको हैसियत बदल्छ; private मेम्बरमा पहुँच कहिल्यै दिँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Constructor and destructor order — asked very often
items.en: The rule in one line When a derived object is created, the base class constructor runs FIRST, then the derived constructor. Destructors run in the exact reverse: derived destructor first, then base destructor.
items.ne: derived अब्जेक्ट बन्दा पहिले base को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्छ, अनि derived को। डिस्ट्रक्टर ठ्याक्कै उल्टो — पहिले derived, अनि base।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Which type of inheritance?
items.ne: यो कुन प्रकारको inheritance हो?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Count the classes and count the arrows. One base with many children is not the same as one child with many parents, and multilevel is not multiple.
items.ne: क्लास गन्नुहोस् र तीर गन्नुहोस्। एउटा base का धेरै छोरा र एउटा छोराका धेरै बाबु फरक कुरा हुन्, र multilevel भनेको multiple होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A chain: C derives from B, and B derives from A. Each class has ONE parent, but the chain has more than one level. Students call this "multiple" — it is not, because no class here has two parents.
items.ne: एउटा शृंखला: C, B बाट र B, A बाट आउँछ। हरेक क्लासको एउटै बाबु छ, तर शृंखलामा एकभन्दा बढी तह छन्। विद्यार्थीले यसलाई "multiple" भन्छन् — होइन, किनभने कुनै क्लासका दुई बाबु छैनन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: ONE base with MANY derived classes — the branches go downwards from a single parent. Compare with multiple, where the arrows converge upwards into one child.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One base, one derived, one arrow. Every other type is built from this one, which is why it is worth being able to name it quickly.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Read the widest shape first. A has two children (B and C), which makes the diagram hierarchical; D hanging under B adds a level but does not change what the whole picture is called. A paper asking for ONE name wants the dominant shape — and a hybrid is what you call it if the question allows.
items.ne: पहिले सबैभन्दा फराकिलो आकार हेर्नुहोस्। A का दुई छोरा (B र C) छन्, त्यसैले चित्र hierarchical हो; B मुनिको D ले तह थप्छ तर पूरै चित्रको नाम बदल्दैन। एउटै नाम मागिएमा प्रमुख आकार भन्नुहोस् — प्रश्नले दिए hybrid पनि भन्न सकिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The two arrows that get through and the one that does not. A derived class reuses public and protected members; a private member still exists inside every object but the child cannot reach it.
items.ne: दुई तीर पुग्छन्, एउटा पुग्दैन। Derived क्लासले public र protected मेम्बर पुनः प्रयोग गर्छ; private मेम्बर हरेक अब्जेक्टभित्र हुन्छ तर छोराले छुन पाउँदैन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: What the derived class actually receives
items.en: The one rule that never changes: private members are never inherited, in any mode.
items.ne: कहिल्यै नफेरिने नियम: private मेम्बर कुनै पनि मोडमा इनहेरिट हुँदैन।

items.en: All five types, plus the diamond problem that hybrid inheritance can create.

items.topic: Constructor and destructor order — asked very often

items.en: A chain — a derived class itself becomes the base of another class. Grandparent → parent → child.
items.ne: शृंखला — derived क्लास आफैं अर्कोको base बन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp

items.ne: दुई वा बढी base बाट एउटा derived क्लास।

items.ne: एउटा base बाट धेरै derived क्लास।

items.ne: माथिका दुई वा बढी प्रकारको मिश्रण।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One child, two parents. Decide which line comes from which class before opening this — and whether the printing order is the order the bases were inherited in, or the order the calls were written in.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: The diamond problem and virtual base class
items.en: Case 5 mixes two shapes on purpose, because a real question sometimes does. Read the reason for how to answer when a diagram is not purely one type.
items.ne: दुई गणनाले प्रायः सबै केस मिलाउँछन्। कुनै एउटा क्लासका कति बाबु छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → multiple। एउटा base का कति छोरा छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → hierarchical। हरेकको एउटै बाबु तर धेरै तह भएको शृंखला → multilevel। केस ५ मा जानाजान दुई आकार मिसिएका छन्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Constructor and destructor order — asked very often
items.en: This is the promise in the title — so keep it. One object, four lines of output. Write all four down in order before opening this. The destructor order is not the constructor order, and that is the exam question.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Constructor and destructor order — asked very often
items.en: Four lines from one object. The base is built first (you cannot build the first floor before the ground floor) and destroyed last.
items.ne: एउटै अब्जेक्टबाट चार लाइन। base पहिले बन्छ (भुइँतला नबनाई पहिलो तला बन्दैन) र अन्तिममा भत्किन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: Types of inheritance and constructor call order carry the marks here — the order question appears very often.

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: class Dog : public Animal { };
items.ne: परिभाषा + base/derived + syntax — तीनै लेख्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: Exam focus — questions asked from this unit
items.en: Single — one base, one derived (A → B). Multilevel — a chain where a derived class becomes a base (A → B → C). Multiple — two or more bases, one derived (A and B → C). Hierarchical — one base, many derived (A → B and A → C). Hybrid — a combination of two or more of the above; may cause the diamond problem, solved with a virtual base class.
items.ne: पाँचै चित्र कोर्नुहोस् र एक–एक लाइन व्याख्या दिनुहोस्। चित्र बिना पूरा अंक आउँदैन।

items.ne: समस्या + virtual

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Definition — learn this wording Inheritance is the process by which one class acquires (gets) the properties and member functions of another class. The class that gives its features is the base class (also called parent or super class). The class that receives them is the derived class (also called child or sub class). The main purpose is reusability of code — common code is written once in the base class and reused by every derived class. Inheritance represents an "IS-A" relationship: a Dog IS-A Animal, a Circle IS-A Shape. If you cannot say "IS-A", inheritance is probably the wrong tool.
items.ne: परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् इनहेरिटेन्स भनेको एउटा क्लासले अर्को क्लासका गुण र मेम्बर फङ्सन प्राप्त गर्ने प्रक्रिया हो। गुण दिने क्लास base class (बाबु/parent) हो। गुण पाउने क्लास derived class (छोरा/child) हो। मुख्य उद्देश्य कोडको पुनः प्रयोग हो — साझा कोड एक पटक base मा लेख्ने र सबै derived क्लासमा चलाउने। इनहेरिटेन्सले "IS-A" सम्बन्ध जनाउँछ: Dog एक प्रकारको Animal हो, Circle एक प्रकारको Shape हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Advantages of inheritance Reusability — common code is written once and reused by every child class. Saves time and reduces code size — no duplication. Easy to extend — new features go in a derived class without touching the tested base class. Supports polymorphism — function overriding is impossible without inheritance. Better structure — the parent–child relationship models the real world clearly. Easier maintenance — fixing a bug in the base class fixes it for every derived class at once.
items.ne: इनहेरिटेन्सका फाइदा पुनः प्रयोग — साझा कोड एक पटक लेखेर सबै सन्तान क्लासमा चलाइन्छ। समय र कोड बचत — दोहोरो लेख्नु पर्दैन। सजिलो विस्तार — परीक्षण भइसकेको base नछोई derived मा नयाँ सुविधा थपिन्छ। Polymorphism सम्भव बनाउँछ — inheritance बिना overriding हुँदैन। राम्रो संरचना — बाबु–छोराको सम्बन्धले वास्तविक संसार प्रस्ट देखाउँछ। सजिलो मर्मत — base मा गल्ती सुधार्दा सबै derived क्लासमा एकैचोटि सुधार हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: The diamond problem and virtual base class
items.en: The problem In hybrid inheritance, suppose B and C both inherit from A, and D inherits from both B and C. D then receives two copies of everything in A — one through B and one through C. When you write d.show() the compiler cannot decide which copy to use, and reports an ambiguity error. Because the diagram is diamond-shaped, this is called the diamond problem.
items.ne: समस्या Hybrid inheritance मा मानौं B र C दुवैले A बाट इनहेरिट गर्छन्, र D ले B र C दुवैबाट। तब D ले A का सबै कुराको दुई प्रति पाउँछ — एउटा B बाट, अर्को C बाट। d.show() लेख्दा कम्पाइलरले कुन प्रति चलाउने भन्ने निर्णय गर्न सक्दैन र ambiguity error देखाउँछ। चित्र हीरा जस्तो देखिने भएकाले यसलाई diamond problem भनिन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: What the derived class actually receives
items.en: private is inherited but not reachable. Use protected if the child must touch it.
items.ne: private सर्छ तर छुन मिल्दैन। सन्तानले छुनुपर्ने भए protected राख्नुहोस्।

items.topic: The diamond problem and virtual base class
items.en: Multilevel. It is a chain: C from B, B from A. Every class here has exactly one parent — the chain simply has more than one level. Multiple means one class with two parents (class C : public A, public B), which is a different picture entirely. Count parents, not levels.
items.ne: Multilevel। यो शृंखला हो: C, B बाट र B, A बाट। यहाँ हरेक क्लासको एउटै बाबु छ — शृंखलामा तह मात्र धेरै छन्। Multiple भनेको एउटै क्लासका दुई बाबु हुनु हो। तह होइन, बाबु गन्नुहोस्।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Name the type of inheritance from the code What you will learn: to tell the five types apart quickly — the paper gives you code or a diagram and asks for the name, and multilevel versus multiple is where the mark is lost. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पाँच प्रकार छिटो छुट्याउन — परीक्षामा कोड वा चित्र दिएर नाम सोधिन्छ, र अंक multilevel र multiple बीचमै गुम्छ। How to use this Two counts settle almost every case. How many parents does any one class have? More than one → multiple. How many children does one base have? More than one → hierarchical. A chain where each class has one parent but there is more than one level → multilevel. Case 5 mixes two shapes on purpose, because a real question sometimes does. Read the reason for how to answer when a diagram is not purely one type. दुई गणनाले प्रायः सबै केस मिलाउँछन्। कुनै एउटा क्लासका कति बाबु छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → multiple। एउटा base का कति छोरा छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → hierarchical। हरेकको एउटै बाबु तर धेरै तह भएको शृंखला → multilevel। केस ५ मा जानाजान दुई आकार मिसिएका छन्। Constructor and destructor order — asked very often {{dia:ctorOrder}} One object, three constructors. Base first going down, derived first coming back up. एउटा अब्जेक्ट, तीन कन्स्ट्रक्टर। बन्दा base पहिले, नष्ट हुँदा derived पहिले। The rule in one line When a derived object is created, the base class constructor runs FIRST, then the derived constructor. Destructors run in the exact reverse: derived destructor first, then base destructor. derived अब्जेक्ट बन्दा पहिले base को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्छ, अनि derived को। डिस्ट्रक्टर ठ्याक्कै उल्टो — पहिले derived, अनि base। Example 4 Proving the order — predict this output before you read it #include <iostream> using namespace std; class A { public: A() { cout << "A constructor" << endl; } ~A() { cout << "A destructor" << endl; } }; class B : public A { public: B() { cout << "B constructor" << endl; } ~B() { cout << "B destructor" << endl; } }; int main() { B obj; // only ONE object is created return 0; } This is the promise in the title — so keep it. One object, four lines of output. Write all four down in order before opening this. The destructor order is not the constructor order, and that is the exam question. शीर्षकमा गरिएको वाचा यही हो — त्यसैले पूरा गर्नुहोस्। एउटै object, चार लाइन output। खोल्नुअघि चारै लाइन क्रम मिलाएर लेख्नुहोस्। destructor को क्रम constructor को क्रम होइन, र परीक्षाको प्रश्न त्यही हो। Output A constructor B constructor B destructor A destructor Four lines from one object. The base is built first (you cannot build the first floor before the ground floor) and destroyed last. एउटै अब्जेक्टबाट चार लाइन। base पहिले बन्छ (भुइँतला नबनाई पहिलो तला बन्दैन) र अन्तिममा भत्किन्छ। Practise it — the help comes away

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Inheritance
items.ne: इनहेरिटेन्स — गुण सर्ने प्रक्रिया

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.topic: The diamond problem and virtual base class
items.en: What you will learn: to tell the five types apart quickly — the paper gives you code or a diagram and asks for the name, and multilevel versus multiple is where the mark is lost.
items.ne: तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पाँच प्रकार छिटो छुट्याउन — परीक्षामा कोड वा चित्र दिएर नाम सोधिन्छ, र अंक multilevel र multiple बीचमै गुम्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: In overloading the compiler picks the correct function from the arguments before the program runs, so it is compile-time (static) polymorphism.
items.ne: Overloading मा कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट हेरेर प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै सही फङ्सन छान्छ, त्यसैले यो compile-time polymorphism हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Overriding means a derived class redefines a base class function, so a base and derived class — that is, inheritance — must exist.
items.ne: Overriding मा derived क्लासले base क्लासको फङ्सन पुनः लेख्छ, त्यसैले base र derived क्लास — अर्थात् inheritance — हुनैपर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: A virtual function tells C++ to decide at run time, by looking at the actual object the base pointer points to.
items.ne: virtual फङ्सनले C++ लाई चल्दै गर्दा, base पोइन्टरले देखाएको वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेरेर निर्णय गर्न लगाउँछ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Overloading needs the same name with a DIFFERENT parameter list — different types, or a different number of parameters. Option 2 changes the types, so it is valid. Option 1 differs only in return type, which C++ rejects. Option 3 only renames the parameters, so the two are identical. Option 4 has two different names, so it is not overloading at all.
items.ne: Overloading लाई उही नाम तर फरक parameter सूची चाहिन्छ — फरक किसिम, वा फरक सङ्ख्या। दोस्रोले किसिम बदल्छ, त्यसैले मान्य छ। पहिलोमा return type मात्र फरक छ, जसलाई C++ ले अस्वीकार गर्छ। तेस्रोले parameter को नाम मात्र बदल्छ, त्यसैले दुवै उही हुन्। चौथोमा नाम नै फरक छ, त्यसैले overloading होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: If the compiler can tell which function will run just by reading the code, the decision is made early — static or early binding. That is overloading. When the decision can only be made while the program runs, using a virtual function through a base pointer, it is dynamic or late binding.
items.ne: कोड पढेरै कुन function चल्छ भनी compiler ले भन्न सक्छ भने निर्णय चाँडै हुन्छ — static वा early binding। त्यो overloading हो। Base pointer हुँदै virtual function प्रयोग गर्दा निर्णय प्रोग्राम चल्दा मात्र हुन सक्छ भने त्यो dynamic वा late binding हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Without virtual the compiler decides from the POINTER's type, not the object's, so Shape's version runs even though the object really is a Circle. Adding virtual to the base function is what defers the decision to run time and makes Circle's version run. This single keyword is the most examined point in the unit.
items.ne: virtual नभए compiler ले object होइन, pointer को किसिम हेरेर निर्णय गर्छ — त्यसैले object साँच्चै Circle भए पनि Shape कै संस्करण चल्छ। Base function मा virtual थप्दा निर्णय चल्ने बेलासम्म पर सर्छ र Circle कै संस्करण चल्छ। यस युनिटमा सबैभन्दा बढी सोधिने बिन्दु यही एउटा keyword हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Overloading, overriding, or neither?
items.ne: Overloading, overriding, कि दुवै होइन?

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Three checks, in order. Are the functions in ONE class or in a base and a derived class? Are the parameter lists the same or different? And if they are the same, is the base function virtual? Only the last one decides run-time behaviour.
items.ne: तीन जाँच, क्रमैसँग। फङ्सनहरू एउटै क्लासमा छन् कि base र derived मा? प्यारामिटर सूची उही छ कि फरक? र उही भए base को फङ्सन virtual छ? run-time व्यवहार अन्तिमले मात्र तय गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.ref: polykind · option "Neither — the base version runs"
items.en: Neither — the base version runs
items.ne: दुवै होइन — base कै संस्करण चल्छ

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: One class, one name, two different parameter lists — one argument against two. There is no inheritance here at all, and the compiler can pick the right function from the call itself, so this is compile-time polymorphism.
items.ne: एउटै क्लास, एउटै नाम, दुई फरक प्यारामिटर सूची — एक र दुई। यहाँ inheritance नै छैन, र compiler ले call आफैंबाट सही फङ्सन छान्न सक्छ, त्यसैले यो compile-time polymorphism हो।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Base and derived, the same name and the same empty parameter list, and the base function is virtual. The call goes through a base pointer, so the decision waits until the program runs and Circle::draw is what executes.
items.ne: Base र derived, उही नाम र उही खाली प्यारामिटर सूची, र base को फङ्सन virtual छ। Call base pointer मार्फत जाने भएकाले निर्णय प्रोग्राम चल्दासम्म कुर्छ र Circle::draw चल्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: It looks like the case above with one word removed, and that word is the whole mechanism. Without virtual the compiler decides from the POINTER type, which is Shape, so Shape::draw runs even though the object is a Circle. This is function hiding, not overriding.
items.ne: यो माथिको केसबाट एउटा शब्द हटाएको जस्तै देखिन्छ, र त्यो शब्द नै पूरै प्रविधि हो। virtual नभए compiler ले POINTER को प्रकार — अर्थात् Shape — बाट निर्णय गर्छ, त्यसैले वस्तु Circle भए पनि Shape::draw चल्छ। यो function hiding हो, overriding होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The parameter lists are identical and only the return type differs, which C++ does not accept — the compiler cannot tell from a call which one you meant. This will not compile, so it is not overloading, and with no derived class it cannot be overriding either.
items.ne: प्यारामिटर सूची ठ्याक्कै उही छ, फरक रिटर्न टाइपमा मात्र — C++ ले यो स्वीकार गर्दैन, किनभने call हेरेर compiler ले कुन चाहिएको भन्न सक्दैन। यो compile हुँदैन, त्यसैले overloading होइन, र derived क्लास नै नभएकाले overriding पनि होइन।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Dog::speak replaces Animal::speak with the same signature, so it is overriding and the derived version runs. Note that it runs here because the object type is known exactly, not because of virtual — virtual only changes what happens through a base pointer or reference.
items.ne: Dog::speak ले उही हस्ताक्षरसहित Animal::speak लाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ, त्यसैले यो overriding हो र derived कै संस्करण चल्छ। तर यहाँ चल्नुको कारण virtual होइन, वस्तुको प्रकार ठ्याक्कै थाहा हुनु हो — virtual ले base pointer वा reference मार्फत मात्र फरक पार्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Three functions, one name, parameter TYPES different each time. Overloading does not require a different number of parameters — a different type, or even a different order, is enough for the compiler to tell them apart.
items.ne: तीन फङ्सन, एउटै नाम, हरेक पटक प्यारामिटरको प्रकार फरक। Overloading लाई प्यारामिटरको सङ्ख्या फरक हुनु जरुरी छैन — प्रकार फरक, वा क्रम मात्र फरक भए पनि compiler ले छुट्याउन सक्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Learn this whole tree — the branches, the other names, and what achieves each.
items.ne: यो पूरा रूख कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् — हाँगा, अर्को नाम, र कसले हासिल गर्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The compiler matches the call against each version's parameter list and picks the one that fits — all before the program runs.
items.ne: कम्पाइलरले कललाई हरेक संस्करणको प्यारामिटरसँग मिलाएर सही एउटा छान्छ — प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै।

items.ne: उही पोइन्टर, उही कल — तर दुई फरक जवाफ, किनकि virtual

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: Same person — different behaviour in different places. The name did not change; the situation decided the behaviour. That is polymorphism.
items.ne: उदाहरण — एउटै मान्छे, धेरै भूमिका। एउटै मान्छे घरमा छोरा, स्कुलमा विद्यार्थी, पसलमा ग्राहक र अस्पतालमा बिरामी हुन्छ। व्यक्ति उही, ठाउँ अनुसार व्यवहार फरक। नाम फेरिएन, अवस्थाले व्यवहार तय गर्‍यो — यही polymorphism हो।

items.en: Operator Overloading
items.ne: यसलाई static polymorphism वा early binding भनिन्छ। कुन फङ्सन बोलाउने भन्ने कुरा कम्पाइल गर्दै आर्गुमेन्टको संख्या र प्रकार हेरेर निर्णय हुन्छ। यो छिटो हुन्छ किनकि निर्णय पहिल्यै भइसकेको हुन्छ।

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp

items.subject: grade10/oop-cpp
items.en: The comments tell you which version each call matches. They do not tell you the numbers. Work out all three results before opening this — the third one is a circle, not a square.
items.ne: कुन call ले कुन version मिलाउँछ भन्ने comment ले भन्छ। सङ्ख्या भन्दैन। खोल्नुअघि तीनै नतिजा निकाल्नुहोस् — तेस्रो चाहिँ वृत्त हो, वर्ग होइन।

items.en: A Base pointer is holding a Derived object, and show() is not virtual. Commit to one line of output. Most people answer with the type of the object; without virtual, C++ answers with the type of the pointer.
items.ne: Base pointer ले Derived object समातेको छ, र show() virtual छैन। एउटै लाइन output भन्नुहोस्। धेरैले object को प्रकार भन्छन्; virtual नभए C++ ले pointer को प्रकार भन्छ।

items.en: Virtual override — the computer looks at the object the pointer actually points to, while the program is running. Run-time. Same call, different output.
items.ne: Overloading: कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट गनेर प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै छान्छ — compile-time। Virtual override: पोइन्टरले देखाएको वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेरेर चल्दै गर्दा छान्छ — run-time। उही कल, फरक आउटपुट।

items.ne: लिडमा दिइएका तीन जाँच क्रमैसँग गर्नुहोस्। एक क्लास कि दुई? एउटै क्लास भए overloading मात्र हुन सक्छ। प्यारामिटर उही कि फरक? फरक भए overloading; उही भए पुनर्परिभाषा हेर्दै छ। त्यसपछि मात्र virtual

items.ne: Overloading र Overriding, अनि Compile-time र Run-time — यी पूरै विषयकै सबैभन्दा बढी सोधिने प्रश्न हुन्।
